tei:titleStmt.tei:title: gyi/rjes 'brel khyad don sogs gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈dper brjod ni/brāh+ma ṇa/si rnam bcad/gong du dgag pa'i na bzhagan brāh+ma ṇaḥ/na ny ar
gyi/rjes 'brel khyad don sogs gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈dper brjod ni/brāh+ma ṇa/si rnam bcad/gong du dgag pa'i na bzhagan brāh+ma ṇaḥ/na ny ar

tei:div.tei:p: gyi/ rjes 'brel khyad don sogs gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / ༈dper brjod ni/ brāh+ma ṇa/ si rnam bcad/ gong du dgag pa'i na bzhagan brāh+ma ṇaḥ/ na ny ar bsgyur/ a brāh+ma ṇa/ bram ze ma yin pa'o/ ༈yang nā ka te/ mkhas pa'am snyan ngag mkhan/ na kha/ sen mo/ / ༈na k+ṣatra/ skar ma/ na ku la/ sre meng*/ na dī chu bo zhes pa la sogs pa na yig de 'dra'i rigs ni/ ming de dag gi thog mar rang bzhin du gnas pa yin te/ dgag pa'i na ny ma yin pas a yig tu bsgyur ba med do/ /༈an swa re/ dbyangs la an'o/ /tshig gang la dgag pa'i na ny 'jog rgyu'i tshig gi yi ge'i thog ma de dbyangs yin la/ de'i sngon du nany bzhag pa'i tshe/ pha rol dbyangs de mthong bas dgag pa'i na yig an ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dper brjod/ a shwa'i sgra la nga si āt a n+ya si/ td drangs/ a shwā dan+yaḥrta las gzhan pa'o/ /rnam dbye bsubs/ a n+ya gyi don/ na sngon du bzhagan des pha rol dbyangs a mthong pas an du gyur/ r dbyangs med a la drangs/ a na shwaḥ/ ka lā par dbyangs la yi ge ldog par bya'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'di gzugs gcig cing dgos don yang gcig mod kyi/ sgrub tshul ches mi 'dra'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ dharma ṭā bi ru d+dha si/ dharmeṇa bi ru d+dhaḥ/ zhes pa yin zer yang*/ chos kyis gzhan bcom par 'gro bas/ phyis a dharma dang 'gal bar 'gyur bas gnyis pa'i am ster ba yin no/ /rnam dbye yal/ bi ru d+dha bsubs te/ don na ny thog mar bzhagan ar bsgyur si a dha maṃ/ chos 'joms so/ ༈gra ha ngas/ a bhā ba si/ gra ha ṇa s+yā bha baḥ/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ a bha ba'i don na ny thog mar bzhagasi/ a gra ha ṇaṃ/ gza' 'dzin mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes so/ /de na dgag pa'i na ny rkyang pa'i don ni/ tshig grogs kyi dbang gis med pa dang ma yin pa gang rung la 'jug kyang*/ med pa tsam dang*/ ma yin pa tsam kho na ste tshig gi brjod tshul ni med par dgag pa'i tshig go

/don ni ma yin dgag shas che ste/ bram ze ma yin zhes brjod pas rigs gzhan 'phangs pa'i phyir ro/ /med ces brjod na yang med pa'i gzhi go bar 'gyur bas so/ /gzhan pa dang 'jig pa dang mi 'byung ba'i don la na ny bkod pa ni/ tshig dgag tshig yin yang*/ don sgrub pa kho nar shes par bya'o/ ༈tsār+the dwan+d+waḥ/ de'i don la zlas dbye ba'o/ /'dir mi zad pa'i tsa yig ni spyi la 'jug pa'i de zhes bya ba'i don te/ de yang las gnyis la bya ba gcig 'jug pa phan tshun gnyis ka'am/ cig shos kyis gcig la phan 'dogs pa'i don la tshig sdud byed pa ni/ zlas dbye ba'am/ gnyis gnyis pa'i tshig sdud do/ /de la spyir gnyis gnyis 'dus pa la/ dngos po la 'dus pa dang*/ blos 'dus pa gnyis yod/ dang po mtha' gcig tu dgos par ma nges/ gang blos bsdus pa de tshig gis kyang bsdu bar byed pa yin pas/ ༈de yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ 'du ba dang bral ba de'i don dang*/ 'byor ba dang bral ba de'i don dang*/ gcig gcig sbyor ba de'i don dang*/ kun du sdud pa de'i don te bzhi'o/ ༈de ltar bzhi las gcig la gcig sbyor ba dang*/ ༈kun du sdud pa ni/ bya byed nus pa'i phyir/ zlas dbye ba'i tshig sdud kyi yul yin la/ ༈ snga ma gnyis dang 'brel ba'i don la ni/ bya byed stong pa'i phyir/ gnyis gnyis pa'i tshig sdud kyi yul ma yin no// ༈de las muts+tsha ya zhes pa/ gnas skabs gzhan du kun las btus par bsgyur mod kyi/ 'dir ni sa ma tshogs pa yin la/ tsa ya shor pa'i don la 'jug pas/ dus snga ma'i skabs na phyi ma ma skyes/ phyi ma skyes tsa na snga ma zhig pa'i phyir/ dus bsgrigs pa'i bya ba shor ba lta bu yin/ de yang skyes bu gcig gis dbang phyug gi bstod pa klog pa na/ bla ma'i yon tan 'don pa med cing*/ de 'dod pa na cig shos mi 'byung bas/ dbang phyug dang bla ma ste las su bya ba gnyis la/ bya byed 'don pa gcig byed po mi gcig gis dus gcig tu grub pa med do/

/'di ni dus snga phyi 'dur mi rung bas/ snga phyi'i las gnyis bya ba gcig gis mi 'grub pa la/ de ltar 'grub tshul gyi ngag bkod du mi rung ba'i don no/ ༈gnyis pa ni/ rig pa don du gnyer ba'i slob ma gcig gis/ slob dpon gyi don du grong nas slong mo blangs te 'ong ba dang*/ ba lang gi khyu skongs te 'ong ba/ dus gcig la mi 'grub ste/ las bsod snyoms la bya ba blangs te 'ong ba dang*/ las ba lang gi khyu la bya ba 'ded cing 'ong ba ste/ las gnyis phan tshun dus mnyam du yod srid kyang*/ bya ba gnyis dus mnyam du sbrel bar mi nus te/ 'di ni yul phyogs su mi 'byor ba'i rgyu mtshan las yin pas/ a n+wa tsa ya/ zhes pa'i a n+wa phan tshun dang*/ tsa ya ma 'grig cing shor ba'i don no/ /ba lang gi khyu dang bsod snyoms kyi dngos po dus mnyam yin srid kyang*/ yul du mi 'byor zhing 'dzangs ring bas/ skyes bu gcig gis bya ba gnyis por dus gcig tu mi 'grub bo/ /de 'dra'i don la yang bya byed gcig tu sbyor bar ston pa'i tshig sdud sbyor du i rung ngo*/ /de la 'du bral ni/ bsdu byar rlom pa dngos po gnyis med na lta ci smos/ gcig yod kyang gcig med nas sdud rgyu ma byung ba yin/ 'byor bral gnyis ka yod kyang las so so dang bya ba so sor song nas sdud mi thub pa'o/ /don 'di dag kyang shin du phra ba'i phyir/ lag len du 'debs la dka' zhing*/ spu ris phyed pa'ang dkon par snang ngo*/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ zlas dbye la dbyangs nyung ngu dang gtso bo dang i yig u yig mtha' can dang por tshig phrad do/ /zhes 'byung*/ de yang zlas dbye ba'i tshig sdud kyi skabs 'dir/ tshig thog ma gnyis la dbyangs mang nyung 'dra na der zad/ mang nyung yod na dbyangs nyung ba thog mar 'god/ de yang tshig de gnyis kyi don la mchog dman med pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ mchog dman yod na mchog thog ma dang dman pa rjes su bya/

'on kyang gcig tu ma nges pas/ yang na dbyangs mang nyung dang*/ yang na don mchog dman gyi dbang du byed pa gang rung gis chogade dag kyang tshig snga ma'i mtha' la i yig dang u yig gang rung yod na/ tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa yang mang du 'jug go zhes pa'i don no/ ༈dper brjod rnams ni rim pas/ pa ṭu si tsa/ gup+ta si tsa/ zhes pa bzhag/si gnyis rnam bcad/ de gnyis tsa mthong bas sha re re/ so so drangs/ pa ṭush+tsa gu p+taṣ+tsa/ mkhas pa yang sbad pa yang ste/ mkhas pa tshig mi smra ba'i don no/ sh gnyis rnam dbyi yin/ tsa gnyis rjes 'brang yin/ de rnams phyis/ mthar dang po'i gnyis tshig au byin/ au la au pha rol dbyi/ pa ṭu gup+tau/ mkhas pa sbas pa dag/ces pa ste/ tshig dang po u yig mtha' can gyi dpe ste dbyangs snga phyi grangs mnyam pa'o/ /༈ag+ni si tsa mā ru ta si tsa/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs/ ag+nish+tsa mā ru tash+tsa/ me dang rlung yang zhes so/ /rnam dbye rjes 'brang bcas phyis/ au byin/ ag+ni mā ru tau/ me rlung dgatshig dang po i yig mtha' can dbyangs nyung ba'i dpe'o/ ༈bhok+tṛ si tsa bho gya si tsa/ si dang po ā ru song*/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ si phyi ma sngar bzhin/ bhok+tā tsa bho gya sh+tsa/ longs spyod pa po ni longs kyang spyod do/ /zhes so/ /rkyen sogs phyis/ bhak+tṛ bho gyau/ longs spyod can longs spyod byed/ 'di tshig dang po dbyangs nyung ba yin na'ang ṛ mtha' yin/ tshig phrad kyis ṛ mtha' i dang mtshungs pa'o/ ༈s+t+rī si tsa pu ru ṣa si tsa/ īp mtha' la si phyis/ s+t+rī tsa pu ru ṣash+tsa/ bud med dang skyes pa'o/ /rkyen sogs dbyi/ au/ s+t+rī pu ru ṣau/ bud med skyes pa dga'adi yang i mtha' tshig dang po dbyangs nyung ba'i dpe'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ dha bash+tsa kha dī ra sh+tsa/ shug pa dang seng ldeng yang ngo*/ rkyen sogs phyis/ au/ dha ba kha dī rau/ shug pa seng ldeng dga'adi ni a mtha' can yin yang*/ tshig dang po dbyangs nyung ba'i dpe'o/

༈yang lung drangs pa/ zlas dbye la lha yi tshig dang po'i ring po'o/ /zhes 'byung bas snga phyi'i tshig gnyis kyis don lha brjod par byed na/ tshig snga ma'i mtha' ring por 'gyur la/ yang ag+ni la sogs pa las/ so ma la sogs pa'i ṣa nyid do/ /zhes 'byung bas/ tshig phyi ma'i thog ma na sa 'am sha'i yi ge yod na/ ṣa yig nyid du 'gyur ro/ ༈ag+ni sh+tsa so mash+tsa/ me lha dang zla ba yang*/ sh+tsa phyis/ ag+ni so ma zhes 'byung ba'i ni ring por bsgyur/ sa ṣa ru bsgyur au/ ag+nī ṣo mau/ ༈de bzhin du/ in+d+ra sh+tsa bṛ ha spa ti sh+tsa/ dbang po dang phur bu'o/ /rkyen phyis/ mthar au ī mtshungs 'dra/ drā ring po/ in+d+rā bṛ haspa tī/ dbang po'i drung na phur bu dag /ces so/ 'di ni thog ma'i tshig mtha' ring por song yang*/ phyi ma'i thog ma sha yig dang sa yig ma yin na/ ṣa yig tu mi 'gyur ba'i dpe yang yin/ gtso bo'i tshig thog mar brjod pa'i dpe yin no/ /de dag ni gcig gcig sbyor ba'i don can te/ dngos po de dag phan tshun du yod pa/ phan tshun gnyis kar phan gdags bya 'dogs byed kyi 'brel ba can nam/ yang na gcig phan bya dang cig shos phan byed kyi don yin la/ 'di rnams kyi mthar rnam dbye gnyis tshig kho na 'jug pa las/ 'dir mtshon byed rnams dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig gi rkyen au sbyar ba yin no/ ༈yang lung drangs pa/ kun du sdud pa la gcig dang lngan par 'byung ba yang na'o/ /zhes bshad te/ kun sdud kyi skabs 'dir tshig sdud grub pa'i mtha' la/ gcig gi don dang ldan par byung ba ste/ si sogs gcig tshig gi rkyen rnams stair ba'am/ yang na zhes pa mang tshig dzas la sogs pa byin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan dngos po mang po yin pa'i phyir mang tshig kyang rung la/ bsdu bya mang yang 'dus pa'i ngo bo ni gcig yin pa'i phyir gcig tshig gtso bor 'jug go /de yang*/ sha sha dzas tsa ku sha dzas tsa pa lā sha dzas tsa bzhagarkyen gyi dz rnams phyis/

a rnams 'dra ba la ring po'o/ /s rnams rnam bcad/ de rnams sh drangs/ sha shā sh+tsa ku shā sh+tsa pa lā shā sh+tsa/ ri bong ni ku sha dang pa lā sha'i yang*/ zhes pa'o/ /rkyen sogs phyi mthar dzas sbyar na/ sha sha ku sha pa lā shāḥ/ yang na si am sha sha ku sha pa lā shaṃ/ ri bong rtswa ku sha shing ḍha ka rnams tshogs/ zhes pa'am/ ri bong ku sha shing ḍha ka 'di na yod/ ces pa lta bu ste/ shing ḍha ka'i grib ma la ku sha'i gseb tu ri bong nyal ba lta bu/ de gsum 'tshogs pa'i don yin/ ༈yang lung drangs pa/ a n+ya la sogs pa rnams kyi rnam dbye dbye zhing dang po'i tshig la saka ྄ā ga ma'o/ a n+ya si tsa a n+ya si tsa/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ a n+yash+tsa a n+yash+tsa/ rkyen sogs phyis/ a n+ya dang po'i mthar sak ā ga ma bzhagak rjes 'brel/ a brjod don/ s rnam bcad/ de u a u la o'o/ ot kyi mthar a n+ya phyis/ si am/ a n+yo3n+yaṃ/ gzhan dang gzhan dag go ༈de bzhin du/ pa rash+tsa pa ra sh+tsa/ zhes pa la rkyen phyis/ snga ma'i mthar sak rnam bcad/ de sr song*/ pha rol po'i steng du drangs/ si pa raspa raṃ/ phan tshun zhes bya'o/ /yang na de gnyis kar yang*/ phan tshun dang*/ gcig la gcig dang*/ gzhan dang gzhan nam/ gzhan gyis gzhan la/ zhes pa'i don du tshig grogs kyi dbang gis ci rigs par 'jug go ༈a ka twe dwe gu dwan+d+wo/ phyogs gnyis pa dang*/ zlas dbye la gcig nyid do/ /zlas dbye'i phyogs gcig kun sdud dang*/ phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba phal cher la rnam dbye dang po 'jug cing*/ bsdu ba 'di gnyis la yang ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur ba mang po yod ces pa ste/ īp mtha' sogs ma gtogs so/ ༈ saṃ khyā burbo dwi guḥ/ grangs thog ma can ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /dngos po gang zhig grangs kyi ming dang 'grel ba de'i tshe/ grangs kyi sgra thog mar sbyar bas/ brjod pa bde zhing tshig rngam brjid can du 'gyur ba ni/ ngag gnyis pa'i phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba'o/

/sa mā ha re at īp dwi guḥ /phyogs gnyis pa'i mnyam du 'dus pa'i at la īp'o/ /sa mā ha ra zhes pa ni/ gong zlas dbye'i skabs su kun sdud du bsgyur la/ 'dir mnyam du 'dus par bsgyur bar bya ste/ phyogs gnyis pa'i zhes dmigs gsal mdzad pa ni/ at la īp ster dgos pa'i sa mā ha ra'i don 'di zlas dbye'i skabs kyi sa mā ha ra de ma yin/ phyogs gnyir pa rang gi skabs kyi'o zhes pa'i don no/ /des na phyogs gnyis pa'i tshig sdud la/ grangs sngon du 'jog pa'i grangs de dang ldan pa'i dngos po rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i don la 'jug par 'gyur zhing*/ tshig sdud zin pa'i mthar/ a yig mtha' can yin na bud med kyi rkyen īp ster dgos la/ gzhan la ni ma yin no/ ༈de yang*/ da shan/ drug pa'i ām/ grā ma ām ām gnyis kar la num/ n mtha' phyis/ nām la ring*/ drangs/ nā 'og ma ṇā/ da shā nāṃ grā mā ṇāṃ sa mā hā ra/ grong sde bcu rnams 'khris 'khris su 'dus pa'o/ /zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /rkyen rnams phyis/ mtha' īp/ i a phyis/ drangs/ da shan gyi n phyis/ da sha grā mī/ zhes pa grub ste/ tshig sbyor gyi don rnams 'di la tshang*/ ༈yang pañtsan dzas ag+ni dzas dzas dang po dang n mi snang*/ phyi ma dz phyis/ rtags mtha' e/ e a yr song*/ g+na a y'i a la drangs/ y rkyen gyi a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ 'jug tu sa mā hri ta zhes pa sbyar/ ag+ni'i a 'dra ring*/ pañtsa g+na yaḥs mā hri ta/ me lnga 'dus pa'o/ /rkyen sogs phyis/ mthar si 'jigapañtsā g+nī grub bo/ ༈pañtsan.ām go ām ām snga ma la nuṭ/ rtags mtha'i n phyis/ drangs/ nām la ring*/ go'i o ab drangs/ pañtsā nāṃ ga baṃ sa mā hā raḥ/ ba lang lnga rnams mnyam por tshogs pa'o/ /rkyen sogs pañtsa go si si yal/ ma ning nyid las thung ngu nyid do/ /o u ru song*/ pañtsa gu/ ༈īp kyi dmigs gsal ni/

tra yā ṇāṃ pha lā ṇāṃ sa mā hā raḥ/ 'bras bu gsum rnams gcig tu tshogs pa'o/ /sngar bzhin phyis pas/ tri pha la 'di a mtha' yin pas īp yong thang ba la/ mi 'byung ste/ 'jig rten dang bstan bcos kun las 'bras bu gsum la tri pha la zhes zer gyi tri pha lī ru naṃ (nam )yang ma grags pa'i phyir ro/ /des na skabs 'dir ྄īp dang don mtshungs pa'i āp ster/ mtshungs 'dra/ tri pha lā grub/ ༈ ba hu pṛ hī ra n+yān+the/ gzhan gyi don la 'bru mang po'o/ /tshigs snga phyi gnyis po so sos/ dngos su brjod pa de ma yin pa la/ tshig snga phyi gnyis po de'i don dang 'brel ba'i don gzhan dngos su ma brjod pa zhig brjod bya'i gtso bor byed pa'i tshig sdud ni/ 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba zhes bya'o/ ༈de la dbye na/ de ma yin pa'i yon tan can dang*/ de'i yon tan can gyi 'bru mang po gnyis so/ /dang po'i dper brjod ni/ ba hu si dha na si/ si dang po 'jigaphyi ma am/ de la ya s+ya don yin pas sbyar/ ba hu dha naṃ ya s+ya/ gang la nor mang po yod pa/ /zhes so/ rnam dbye rnams phyis/ s rnam bcad/ ba hu dha naḥ/ nor mang po'o zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ a sti/ 'di mi zad pa yin pas rnam dbye'i bya ba mi 'jug pa'i dbang du byas na rnam dbye ster mi dgos/ 'jig pa'i dbang du byas na si byin nas 'jig dha naṃ ya s+ya sngar bzhin sbyar bas/ nor yod pa gang gi zhes so/ / rnam dbye rjes 'brang can phyis/ si rnam bcad/ isti dha naḥ nor yod pa'o/ ༈gnyis pa ni/ lam+ba au kar+ṇa.au/ rkyen au gnyis ni/ o au la au'o/ zhes mtshams sbyar/ lam+bau kar+ṇauya s+ya/ rna ba gnyis ring po dag gang gi phyis/ si rnam bcad/ lam+ba kar+ṇaḥ/ rna ba ring po zhes so/ /dper brjod de rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ nor mang po'i zhes pas nor tsam dang mang po tsam la mi go bar/ don gzhan bdag po skyes bu go ste/ skyes bu de yang nor mang po dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir/

dngos su ma brjod kyang brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pas de dang dngos su brjod pa'i tshig gnyis kyi don de dag 'brel ba ni yin no/ /yang nor yod ba zhes pa la/ dngos su brjod pa'i yod pa tsam dang nor tsam ma yin gyi/ dngos su ma brjod pa'i nor gang la yod pa'i mi de brjod bya'i gtso bor 'gyur bas/ don gzhan gtso bo'o/ /'di dag ni de ma yin pa'i yon tan te/ bdag po de'i yon tan nor de/ yon tan can bdag po'i lus sems kyi cha shas su med pas/ yon tan de yon tan can de ma yin pas na/ de dang ngo bo tha dad pa'i yon tan ldan pa'o/ ༈rna ba ring po zhes pa la yang dngos su brjod pa'i rna ba tsam dang*/ ring po tsam ni brjod bya'i gtso bo ma yin/ rna ba ring po gang la yod pa'i srog chags de go bar nus shing brjod bya'i gtso bo yin no/ /srog chags de tshig gnyis po de dngos su ma brjod pas don gzhan zhes bya/ 'di ni de'i yon tan can gyi dpe ste/ yon tan rna ba ring po de yon tan can srog chags de'i lus kyi cha shas yin pas/ yon tan can de las ngo bo tha dad du med pa'i phyir/ de'i yon tan can zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du shes rab chen po zhes pa yang*/ shes rab dang ldan pa'i gang zag gtso bor go nus shing*/ shes rab de yang skyes bu de'i shes pa'i cha shas yin pa'i phyir/ de dang ngo bo tha dad med pas de'i yon tan can no/ /'dir ngo bo gcig tha dad ces pa/ dbu tshad lta bu'i rig pas bzhag pa ma yin gyi/ 'jig rten grags pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa ste/ nor can mgron du bos na/ nor khyim bzhag ste/ bdag po rang nyid 'ong gi /nor sleb mi 'ong ba dang*/ rna ba ring po can bos na ni/ rna ba ring po bzhag ste/ rna ba ring po can 'ong ba'i thabs med pa dang*/ shes rab can bos na/ shes rab shul du bzhag ste/ mi de 'ong ba'i lugs med pa lta bu ste/ re zhig lus sems kyi tshogs pa dang mi 'bral ba la de skad ces bya'o/

༈lung drangs pa 'bru mang po'i khyad par gyi bdun pa'i mtha' can dag la/ dang por ni pā ta'o/ /zhes so/ /bi she ṣa ṇa au lo hi ta di ak+ṣi au zhes pa bzhag/au dang po/ o au la au/ ngi a i la e/ au phyi ma ī/ num n ī la drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ/ ya s+ya bzhagabi she ṣa ṇau lo hi te ak+ṣi ṇī ya s+ya/ khyad par du dmar ba'i mig dag gang gi zhes pa'o/ /rkyen sogs phyis/ 'dra ring si/ lo hi tāk+ṣaḥ/ dmar ba'i mig /mig can brjod bya'i gtso bo'o/ / lo hi te/ zhes pa rnam dbye bdun ti mtha' can yin la/ khyad par can gyi tshig dang 'brel ba'i bdun pa'i mtha' de/ tshig dang po'i mtha' la yod pa'o/ / bdun mtha' yin na tshig dang po kho na la byed pa de/ 'bru mang po'i sbyir btang yin no/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ gṛ ha ngi ku sha la si/ gṛ he ku sha laṃ ya s+ya/ khyim dge ba gang gi/ phyis si gṛ ha ku sha laḥ/ dge ba'i khyim/ ༈ nen+d+wā du bha yash+tsa/ in+du sogs dag las kyang ma yin no/ /'dir dmigs gsal te 'bru mang po yin kyang*/ in+du'i rtags sogs la/ bdun pa'i mtha' can rjes su sbyor gyi /thog mar mi byed do/ in+du si she ṣa ra ngi yas+ya/ bzhag si rnam bcad ngi a i la ai/ in+duḥshe ṣa re ya s+ya/ gang gi gtsug tu zla ba/ phyis si/ in+du she ṣa raḥ/ gtsug na zla ba/ de la she ṣa ra zhes pa de sngar bdun pa byin pa'i gzugs yal kyang nus pa can yin pas/ sngon ma'i tshig tu yong thang ba la/ 'dir mi byed do/ /she ṣa ra in+du/ mi zer par/ she ṣa ra zhes pa 'jug tu sbyor dgos so/ ༈de bzhin du/ sogs khongs nas/ ji skad du/ 'khor lo'i lag can sogs la ma yin no/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas/ tsakra si pāṇa ngi yas+ya bkod/ si am/ ngi au/ ṭi phyis/ tsakraṃ pā ṇau ya s+ya/ gang gi lag na 'khor lo/ phyis si/ tsakra pā ṇiḥ/ lag na 'khor lo'o/ ༈pradzāme dha yo ra suk /pra dzā me dha dag la a suk'o/ 'bru mang po'i skabs 'dir/ pra dzā'i sgra dang*/

me dha'i sgra la/ mthar a suk rkyen du sbyar ro/ su pra dzā dzas ya s+ya/ zhes pa bzhag dz phyis/ a 'dra/ s rnam bcad/ su pra dzāḥya s+ya/ bzang po'i skye bo gang zhig phyis/ su pra dzā a suk k rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ i a'i phyis/ drangs/ si dbyi/ s rnam bcad/ a tu dang sa'i si la'o/ /dza ring por song*/ su pra dzā/ skye bo bzang po/ ༈dur me dhā dzas ya s+ya/ a 'dra/ s rnam bcad/ durme dhāḥya s+ya/ blo gros ngan pa gang gi /dur me dhā/ a suk/ as/ i a yi phyis/ drangs si dbye/ a tu dang zhes pas dhā ring*/ s rnam bcad/ durme dhāḥ/ ༈dharmā dan/ dharma las a na'o/ /'bru mang po'i skabs 'dir/ dharma'i sgra la rkyen an ster ro/ /su dharma si yas+ya/ si rnam bcad/ ha ba la u/ u la o/ su dharmo ya s+ya/ legs pa'i chos gang gi su dharma an/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si n yi u pa dhā si dang n phyis/ su dharmā/ ༈ a n+yār+the/ gzhan gyi don la'o/ /'bru mang po'i skabs 'dir sngar bud med kyi rtags su gyur pa/ ī ring po dang*/ ī ring po'i mtha' can dag /spyir btangs la thung ngur 'gyur te/ de yang dper mtshon na/ rū pa ba tī si bhār+yā si yas+ya/ si gnyis ni īp mtha' dang ap mtha' la phyis/ ru pa ba tī bhār+yā ya s+ya/ gzugs ldan chung ma gang gi phyis/ ru pa ba tī bhār+yā/ zhes pa yod pa'i yā tshig sdud kyi dbang gis thung ngur song*/ ༈su batra bā/ yang na skyes pa la bt do/ 'bru mang po'i skabs 'dir/ ba tī zhes pa bud med kyi rtags nyid la 'jog na/ ba tī'i īp mtha' rang gnas su 'jog༈ yang na pho rtags kyi tshig tu bsgyur bas/ ba tī'i āp phyis pas bt du bsgyur ro/ ༈mthar si rnam bcad/ rū pa ba tī bhār+yaḥ/ ༈yang na/ rū pa bad+bhār+yaḥ/ gzugs ldan chung ma/ ༈yang na zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis/ ba tī bt du bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar ma zad/ gzhan mang po la tshig phyi ma'i mtha' thung ngur bsgyur zhing*/

dang po'i mtha' la īp mi 'gog ste/ dper na/ kal+yā ṇī si pri yā si yas+ya/ gong bzhin/ ka l+yā ṇī pri yā ya s+ya/ dge legs mo dang mdza' ba zhes so/ yang na/ ka l+yā ṇī/ zhes pa dge ba ma/ don ni bha drā zhes pa ste/ bzang mo'i ming gi btags pa ste/ zla ba gang gi mar ngo'i tshes gsum dgu bcu bcu bzhi ste bzhi dang*/ yar ngo'i bzhi brgyad bcu gcig bco lnga ste bzhi'o/ /de ltar nyin zhag brgyad po mchod pa sogs kyi las la bzang zhing*/ rig pa sogs la mi mthun pa bskyed pa 'dod pa de rnams la grags so/ /pri yā ni phyogs te de gnyis sdoms pas phyogs kyi bzang mo zer/ gang ltar na'ang ngag bkod pa la/ si ni zhig zin/ yas+ya/ phyis te/ tshig sdud du byas pa na mtha'i yā thung ngur byed kyang*/ ṇī yi īp mi 'gog ste/ ka l+yā ṇī bri ya/ phyogs kyi dge ba ma'am/ dge ma mdza' mo zhes so/ ༈goḥ/ go yi'o/ go'i sgra la 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba dang bstun pa'i skabs 'dir yang*/ go sgra'i dbyangs mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge o ni thung ngu u yig tu 'gyur ro/ /pañtsan dzas go dzas yas+ya/ dzas dang po phyis/ n mtha' yal/ dzas phyi ma as/ go'i o ab/ b a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ des ya mthong*/ ha ba la u/ u la o/ pañtsa ga bo ya s+ya/ ba lang lnga po gang gi zhes ba lang gi bdag po'o/ phyis/ mtha'i dbyangs thung ngur bsgyur/ n mtha' mi snang si rnam bcad/ pañtsa guḥ/ gong du ba lang lnga phan tshun gyi don la/ si dbyi ba yin kyang*/ 'dir don gzhan la rnam bcad do/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ grangs dang su dang byā gh+ra la sogs pa'i tshig dang po can gyi sgra yi at dbyi'o/ /zhes 'byung ste/ 'bru mang po'i skabs kyi tshig snga phyi gnyis bsdus pa na/ tshig dang po la/ stong dang gnyis la sogs pa grangs kyi ming dang*/ nye bsgyur su dang*/ byā gh+ra la sogs pa'i tshig yod la/ de 'dra sngon du song ba'i sgra ste tshig phyi ma'i tshig mtha' la dbyangs a thung yod na mi snang bar byed do/

/sa ha sra si am pā da dzas dzas phyis/ as/ 'dra ring s rnam bcad/ ya s+ya sbyar/ sa ha praṃ pā dāḥya s+ya/ rkang pa stong phrag gang gi phyis/ da'i srog gi a yal/ si dbyi/ d t ru song*/ sa ha sra pāt/ grangs thog mar yod pa'i dpe'o/ sho bha na au pā da au ya s+ya bkod mtshams sbyar/ sho bha nau pā dau ya s+ya/ gang gi rkang pa dag mdzes pa dag go /phyis/ sho bha na mdzes pa zhes pa'i don nye bsgyur su bzhag /su pā da/ mtha'i a phyis/ si yal/ dt/ su pāt/ zhes pa grub/ ༈yang byā gh+ra si i ba pā da au ya s+ya bkod/ si 'jiga.i ba/ mi zad pa yin pas rnam dbye mi 'jug pa'am yang na 'juga.au mtshams sbyar/ byā gh+ra i ba pā dau yas+ya/ gang gi rkang pa dag stag dang 'dra ba/ zhes seng ge la sogs pa gzhan go ba'o/ phyis/ tshig phyi ma la yod pa'i a mtha' mi snang*/ si 'jug /d t/ byā gh+ra pāt/ ༈ji skad du shas la sogs pa'i dbyangs pha rol la pā da zhes par bsgyur ba yang ngo*/ /gong du byā gh+ra la sogs pa'i sogs khongs nas 'don pa yin kyang*/ ༈snga ma dang cho ga cung zad mi 'dra ba/ dwi'i sgra la ni 'bru mang po'i skabs 'dir/ rkyen si sogs lnga snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ shas man chad kyi dbyangs kyi rkyen rnams la/ pā da zhes pa'i pā ring po de thung ngur bsgyur ba ni khyad par ro/ /dwi au pā da au snga phyi gnyis ka mtshams sbyar/ dwau pā dau ya s+ya/ rkang gnyis gang gi phyis da'i a si 'jug /dt/ dwi pāt/ de ni si by-in pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ ༈gzhan rnam dbye dbyangs rnams dang phrad na/ t de ni slar yang d ru log /drangs/ dang po dang gnyis pa'i au gnyis la/ dwi pā dau/ ༈dzas la a drangs rnam bcad/ dwi pā daḥ/ ༈am la/ dwi pā daṃ/ dwi pā dau/ ༈shas/ sh phyis/ pā thung ngu/ t slar yang d/ a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ dwi pa daḥ/ rkang gnyis rnams la/ ༈ṭā byin na/ dwi pa dā/ rkang gnyis kyis/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /pa thung ngur bsgyur mi bsgyur gyi khyad ma gtogs/

sa ha su sogs snga ma rnams la'ang 'dra'o/ ༈da ni bar 'dir tshig sdud bshad zin pa lnga po de las/ mi zad pa phyogs gnyis pa ma gtogs/ gsum dang*/ spyi 'gro gcig ste/ de rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i rkyen gyi bya ba bshad pa ni/ ṭā ḍa kāḥ/ ṭa a ḍa ka rnams so/ /ji skad du/ ṭa yig de yi skyes bur shes/ /a yig zlas dbye 'dir yang ngo*/ /'bru mang dag la ḍa yig nyid/ /ka yig kun la rab tu 'jug/ces kyang 'byung ste/ skabs 'dir ṭa rkyen a rkyen ḍa rkyen ka rkyen te bzhi po 'di dag tshig sdud rnams la ci rigs par 'jug go/ ༈de las ṭa rkyen gyi dbang du byas nas/ a tsin+t+ya si ma hi mn si ya s+ya bkod/ si dang po rnam bcad/ ha ba la u sogs/ si phyi ma 'jugan yi u pa dhā/ n mtha' dbyi/ a tsin+t+yo ma hi mā ya s+ya/ gang gi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ zhes so/ /si phyis atsan+t+ya ma hi mn/ n mtha' phyis/ rkyen ṭa ṭ song ṭi phyis/ mo rtags kyi āp/ 'dra ba ring*/ si rnam bcad/ a tsi n+t+ya ma hi mā/ ༈no sā/ na yi yang na'o/ /n'i mtha' can gyi pha rol du ṭ'i rkyen byung na ṭi dbyi bar bya la/ ṭ rkyen du ma zad ya dang dbyangs kyi rkyen la de bzhin du byed de/ de yang rnam dbye rnams ma yin pa'i rkyen la'o/ /yang na'o zhes pa'i tshig gis yang na ṭu bsub par mi byed de/ u pa dhā mi snang bar byed pa'o/ ༈dper brjod ni/ a han ngas sā yasi/ zhes pa bzhag go/ ngasi ngas la a phyis/ h srog med/ n dang h dbyangs med rkyen gyi a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ si am/ a h+naḥsā yaṃ/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo'o/ /ji skad du/ bsdu ba byas pa la/ pha rol gyi sgra ni dang por tshig phrad do/ /zhes bshad pas/ bsdu bar bya ba'i tshig gnyis tshig sdud du byas na/ tshig rkang 'og ma gong du spo zhes pa'i don yin/ 'grel par yang*/ 'ga' zhig tu am la sogs pa'i mtha' can pha rol tu'o zhes/ de'i skyes bu'i tshig sdud kyi skabs 'dir/

tshig dang po'i mthar am la sogs pa'i rkyain byin pa'i nus pa yod na/ tshig dang po de phyi mar spo zhes bshad de de gnyis don gcig go de la am la sogs zhes pa ni/ dngos su na rnam dbye gnyis pa'i am man chad te/ 'dir ni de'i nang tshan ngas so/ /rnam grangs su na/ si am du bsgyur ba'ang am nyid yin pas/ am sogs la rnam dbye nyer gcig po thams cad 'byung ba'i skabs kyang yod do/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis/ sā ya gong dang*/ a han 'og tu spos ṭ rkyen byin/ ṭ phyis/ u pa dhā mi snang*/ rkyen gyi a la drangs/ a mtshungs 'dra/ si rnam bcad/ sā yā h+naḥ/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ a ha n ngas/ a pa ra si/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ ah+naḥ.a pa raṃ/ nyin mo gzhan no/ /phyis snga ma phyi mar bzhagaṭa u pa dhā phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ a parā h+naḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ ah+naḥm dh+yaṃ/ nyi ma gung ngo*/ /phyis phyi ma sngon du spos/ a mtshungs 'dra/ ṭa u pa dhā phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ma dh+yā h+naḥ/ de dag ni u pa dhā dbyi ba'i dper brjod yin/ ༈yang na ṭi dbyi bar bshad pa ltar na/ sā yā han gyi ṭi phyis pas/ sā yā ha ྄a h a la drangs si/ sā yā haḥ/ des rigs 'gre'o/ ༈yang snga phyi mi bsgyur ba'i dpe ni/ kapinuṭ ām rādzan si bzhaganā m la ring po/ drangs/ nra'i u pa hā mtha'i se dang n phyis/ ka bī nāṃ rā dzā/ mkhas chen nam/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi rgyal po'o/ /phyis ka bi rā dzan ṭa ṭ song a bzhagaṭi mi snang*/ dza rkyen gyi a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ka pi rā dzaḥ/ 'dir rkyain gyi ṭa yig ni rjes 'brel dang 'dra ba'i don yin zhes rjes 'brel dngos ma yin par 'dod do/ ṭa rkyen gyi bya ba yan chad byas nas/ bud med kyi don du/ rkyen īp byin/ i a la phyis/ drangs/ si 'jigaka pi rā dzī/ mkhas shing gsal ba mo'am/ snyan ngag rgyal mo'o/ ༈da ni a'i rkyen gyi mtha'i dper brjod bshad te/

rā dzan ām bzhaga.u pa dhā dza'i srog phyis/ n nyr song*/ ām la drangs/ rā dz+nyāṃ pur si/ u pa dhā ring*/ si phyis/ r rnam bcad/ pūḥ/ de ltar na/ rā dz+nyāṃ pūḥ/ rgyal po'i grong khyer/ 'dir ām mang tshig sbyor ba ni/ so so'i dgos kyi ming med par/ rgyal po zhes spyi ming yin pas/ de la mang tshig 'jug pa'i gnas skabs yod pas yin gyi/ grong khyer gcig la rgyal po mang po'i don ma yin pas/ rgyal po rnams kyi grong khyer zhes mi brjod do/ /phyis rā dzan pur/ n phyis/ rkyen a bzhagar dbyangs med de la drangs/ si am/ rā dza pu raṃ/ zhes pa grub bo/ ༈de bzhin du/ pats si tsa ma nas si tsa/ si gnyis mi snang tsa yik'o/ /k dang s shr song ba dag tsa so so'i steng du drangs/ pak+tsa ma nash+tsa/ ngag dang yid la byed pas kyang ngo*/ /phyis/ pak ma nas/ zhes pa bzhagak ni pa sde'i lnga pa ma yig mthong bas/ ka sde nyid kyi lnga pa ngr song*/ a rkyen byin/ de la s drangs/ si am/ pad+ma na saṃ/ grub bo/ ༈yang dak+ṣi ṇā ngi di sh ngi pa thin si/ ngi thog ma ām yaṭ su ṭ/ rtags mtha' thung ngur song*/ dak+ṣi ṇasy ām ces pa 'byung*/ drangs/ di sh zhes pa'i sh di la drangs/ pa thi'i i a/ pa than pa dang tha'i bar du/ nuṭ n nga ro/ slar yang*/ ṭi an ā ru song bas/ paṃ than pan+thā ru song*/si rnam bcad/ dak+ṣi ṇa s+yāṃ di shi pan+thā/ lho phyogs kyi lam mo/ phyis/ dak+ṣi ṇā pa thin/ a'i rkyen byin/ ṭi phyis th a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dak+ṣi ṇā pa thaḥ/ yang a hansi tsa rā tri si tsa/ si dang po phyis/ rtags mtha'i na s ru song*/ de sh yig tsa la drangs/ si phyi ma rnam bcad/ s ru song*/ de sh yig tsa la drangs/ a hash+tsa rā tri sh+tsa/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo yang*/ phyis/ a han rā tri/ n s de rnam bcad/ u a u la o/ mthar si am/ a'i rkyen byin/ ṭi yal/ drangs/ a ho rā traṃ/ ༈ ḍa rkyen gyi mtha' can dper brjod pa ni/

dwi au tsa tri dzas tsa/ dwi'i srog a ru o au la au'o/ /dwau tri tre ru bsgyur/ e ay'o/ /y dzas kyi a la drangs/ s sh ru song*/ drangs/ dwau tsatra yash+tsa/ gnyis dang gsum zhes bya ste/ grangs bgrang ba yin na lnga dang*/ dngos po brjod pa yin na gnyis tshan dang*/ gsum tshan gyi dngos po de dang de brjod par 'gyur te/ dbang phyug nus ma gnyis dang*/ snying stobs rdul mun gsum lta bu'o/ /phyis/ dwi tri ḍa'i rkyen/ ḍ phyis/ ṭi yal/ drangs/ dwi tra byung*/ dzas a mtshungs 'dra/ s rnam bcad/ dwi trāḥ/ ༈yang pañtsan dzas tsa ṣa ṣ dzas tsa/ zhes pa bkod/ dzas gnyis phyis/ n srog med mi snang*/ ṣ srog med ḍ/ pañtsa tsaṣa ḍā/ lnga dang drugazhes pa ste/ grangs bgrod na bcu gcig dang*/ dngos po brjod na 'byung ba lnga dang dbang po drug lta bu lnga tshan dang drug tshan du sbyar ba ston no/ phyis/ paṃtsanṣaṣa n phyis/ ṣ ḍ/ ḍa rkyen/ ḍa rjes 'brel/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ dzas a mtshungs 'dra/ s rnam bcad/ pañtsa ṣāḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ ba hu dzas/ rā dzan dzas/ yad ngi*/ na ga rī ngi/ zhes pa rnas bkod/ dzas snga ma'i nus pas/ e o dzas la'o/ zhes hu ho ru song*/ o ab/ so sor drangs/ m rnam bcad/ ba ha ba byung/ dzas phyi ma'i nus pas/ n'i u pa dhā ring po/ n dzas kyi a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ rā dzānaḥ/ zhes pa byung*/ ngi gnyis po ām ru bsgyur/ yad kyi ṭi a/ ām la yaṭ dang*/ suṭ rim pas sbyin/ drangs/ ya s+yāṃ byung*/ ngi ām phyi ma'i sngon du aṭ ā ga ma ster/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ a bzhag 'di'i nus pas/ ṭi dbyi ba dang u ru bsgyur ba bkag/rtags mtha'i ī ring po y dbyangs med du bsgyur/ de ā ga ma'i a la drangs/ ām gyi a dang mtshungs 'dra/ r srog med de la drangs pas/ na gar+yāṃ byung*/ de nas rnam bcad gnyis po u sogs mtshams sbyar/ ba ha po rā dzā no ya s+yāṃ na gar+yāṃ/ gang rgyal po mang po rnams kyi grong khyer du/

zhes par 'gyur/ rnam dbye rnams sgra ji bzhin du byas na mang po rnams rgyal po rnams gang la grong khyer du/ zhes pa yin na'ang bod skad la mi bde'o/ phyis/ ba hu rā dzan/ rkyen ḍa byung*/ ḍa song*/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ bud med kyi rkyen āp byin/ mtshungs 'dra mthar na ga rī sbyar ro/ ba hu rā dzā na ga rī/ 'dir dzā dang rī zhes gnas dang gnas pa po'i don las/ gnas la don stengs nas mo rtags 'jug la/ gnas pa po la 'brel pa'i sgo nas mo rtags 'jug pa'o/ ༈ da ni ka'i rkyen mthar sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/ ba hu dzas/ e o dzas la'o/ /u or song*/ o a b/ so sor drangs/ s rnam bcad/ ma ha baḥbyung*/ kar+tṛ dzas/ ṛ ār/ so sor drangs/ s rnam bcad/ de la ya s+ya sbyar/ rnam bcad u u la o/ pa ha paḥkartā ro ya s+ya/ gang gi bya ba'i las mang po'o/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ ba hu kar+tṛ rkyen ka si rnam bcad/ de'i rjes su don mtshon byed/ ka ṭa'am/ yā ga lta bu gang rung zhig bzhagab hu ka r+tṛkaḥka ṭaṃ/ rtsa lhas kyi bya ba mang po byed do/ /ba hu ka r+tṛ ko yā gaḥ/ mchod sbyin gyi bya ba mang po byed do/ /karma dha ra yastu l+yār+the/ mnyam pa'i don las 'dzin pa'o/ /snga phyi'i tshig gnyis kyi don/ dngos po gcig la mnyam par 'jug pa'i don can gyi tshig sdud ni/ las 'dzin pa'i bsdu ba zhes bya bar grags so/ /nī la si tsatatsi ut+pal si tsa/ si snga phyi am bar pa phyis/ nī laṃ tsa ta du t+pa laṃ tsa/ sngon po yang de ut+pal yang ngo*/ /'dir tshig gnyis don gcig la mnyam par 'dus pa ni/ gzhi mthun bsdu ba'i tshig la zer te/ dngos po gcig sngon po yang yin/ ut+pal yang yin zhes pa lta bu'o/ /mtshams sbyar/ nī lot+palaṃ/ ut+pal sngon po'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ rak+tā si/ āp mtha' la si 'jug tsabri a das/ si au/ ṭi yal/ d sru song*/ ha sa īp si phyis/ s rnam bcad/ a saḥbyung*/

la tā zhes pa pri/ la tā si dbyi tsa/ mtshams sbyar/ rak+tā tsā sau la tā tsa/ dmar po yang 'di 'khril shing yang zhes so/ /phyis/ rak+tā zhes pa'i āp mtha' thung ngur bsgyur tā la si 'jugarak+tā la tā/ 'khril shing dmar po'o/ ༈yang puṃs si s de a sung du bsgyur/ ng rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ puṃ gyi nga rom/ a la drangs/ ma dang s'i bar du num/ nas as ma hat kyi dhi min pa la ring po zhes pas/ mā si dang rab sbyor mtha'i s phyis/ n rjes su nga ro/ mthar rkyen sak ā ga ma bzhagak rjes 'brel/ a brjod don/ pha rol tu tsa bzhagas shr song ba drangs/ lu paṃsh+tsa byung*/ a das/ asaḥ gong bzhin/ ko ki la/ si tsa/ de rnams mtshams sbyar bas/ pu maṃsh+tsā sau ko ki lash+tsa/ sau yang de ni khu byug kyang ngo*/ phyis/ puṃs ྄ko ki la/ si rnam bcad/ sngar gyi sbyor ba'i dzas (spyir btang )ltar na rab sbyor mtha'i s dbyi ba thob kyang*/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ skyes pa'i rab sbyor dbyi ba ma yin te kha pa la'o/ /zhes 'byung bas s dbyangs med mi dbyi ste ka'i steng du 'dren/ puṃ sko ki la sha/ kha byug pho'o/ /des las 'dzin pa'i sde gcig tu tshogs pa de bshad zin te/ ༈da ni sngar ma bshad pa'i nyer mkho kha skong gi rnam 'gyur dag brjod do/ /nām+nash+tsa kṛ tā sa mā saḥ/ ming la yang kṛt bsdu ba'o/ ༈ming gi tha mar kṛ tan+ta'i rkyen sogs rab tu sbyor ba dang*/ ༈yang zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis nyer bsgyur dang*/ ༈ti sogs dang sbyor ba la yang*/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba 'byung zhes so/ ༈'di nas brtsams te/ kā la ba naṃ gi bar de'i skyes bu'o/ /pra kar+ṣa ṭā bā da si/ pra kar+ṣe ṇa bā daḥ/ phul du byung ba'i smra ba'o/ /phyis pra bā daḥ/ 'dir pra ni nyer bsgyur yin/ bā da ni kṛt kyi mtha' can no/ ༈kum+bha gnyis pa'i am/ a phyis/ m nga ro/ ka ro ti i ti sbyar/ kum+bhaṃ ka ro tī ti/

buṃ pa byed pa po'o/ phyis/ kum+bha kā raḥ/ byed pa po'i don gyi kā ring po dang*/ rnam bcad ni si'i rjes so/ /'dir kum+bha zhes pa ming yin/ ka ro ti zhes pa ti sogs kyi mtha' can no/ /'dir kum+bha kār zhes pa bsgyur na/ bum bzo ba ces pa yin yang*/ dngos ni rdza mkhan gyi ming ngo*/ /des na ming de rang gi 'jug pa'i yul la/ ma khyab khyab zhes kyi skyon gnyis dang ldan yang*/ 'jig rten grags pa'i tshad ma yin no/ ༈ sa hā deḥsā diḥ/ sa ha la sogs pa rnams sa la sogs pa'o*/ /'dir sa ha'i sogs khongs nas/ saṃ dang*/ ti ras sogs dang*/ sa'i sogs khong nas/ sā dh+ri dang*/ sa mi dang*/ ti ri la sogs pa'o/ /de yang sa ha la sogs pa rnams/ sa la sogs par bsgyur ba'i don no/ /sa ha pu tre ṇa brta te/ bu dang lhan cig tu 'dug go phyis/ si rnam bcad/ sa ha pu tra ཿzhes pa yod pa'i sa ha ni sa nyid du bsgyur bas/ sa pu tra zhes pa'o/ ༈lung drangs pa/ sa ha saṃ ti ras rnams kyi sa dh+ri sa mi ti ri rnams te/ a tsa pha rol la'o/ /zhes 'byung ste/ sa ha a ts zhes pa bzhags ha zhes pa sa dh+ri ru bsgyur/ ats'i a mthong bas iy ru song*/ dha ྄r y gsum dbyangs med brtsegs pa de/ ats'i a la drangs pas/ sa dh+yats byung*/ si byin/ ts'i gong du num/ si phyis/ rab sbyor gyi ts yang phyis/ n ny ru song*/ tsa yi ku'o/ ny yang d ru bsgyur/ sa dh+yd/ grogs mchog go ༈de bzhin du/ sam ats sa mir song*/ iy drangs si num/ si dang ts phyis/ n ny ny ngs myang*/ yang dag pa'o/ ༈yang ti ras/ ats/ ti ras zhes pa ti ri ru bsgyur/ iy/ drangs/ si num/ phyis/ n ny ng ru song*/ tir+yang/ dud 'gro rgyags po'o/ ༈lung drangs pa/ dman pa dang nyung ngu'i don dag la/ ku ni/ ka ta la sogs pa ste/ de'i skyais bu la'o/ /zhes 'byung zhing*/ ku zhes pa dman pa'i tshig ni/ ngan pa dang chung ngu'i don gnyis kar la 'jug/de yang skabs thob kyi so sor 'jug pa yin gyi

/tshig gcig gis dngos po gcig la/ don gnyis cig car 'jug nus pa ni ma yin no/ /ngan pa dang nyung ngu'i don gnyis ka la ku zhes pa ni/ ka tā dang*/ ka dang*/ ka ba zhes pa gsum gang rung du bsgyur kyang rung*/ don gnyis la ā de sha gsum gsum gyi dbye bas drug go dpe kha gcig las mdo 'di nyid kyi tshig yin pa'i dbang du byas te/ koḥkat/ ku la kat do/ /zhes pa'ang 'byung ste/ dpe phal cher la med zer te gnyis la mthong ngo*/ ༈de yang*/ ku uṣ+ṇa zhes pa tshar gsum bzhagaku thog ma kat du bsgyur/ tra d/ d u la drangs/ mthar i am/ ka du ṣa/ ༈ku bar pa kā zhes par bsgyur/ u la o/ si koṣ+ṇaṃ/ ༈ku phyi ma ka ba zhes par bsgyur/ u la o/ si/ ka bo ṣ+ṇa/ ༈de gsum kar yang don gcig drod chung ngu zhes pa yin/ i ṣa ar+tha/ ste chung ngu'i don no/ /tshig grogs kyi dbang gis drod la ngan pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa nyung ngo*/ ༈de bzhin du ku la ba ṇa zhes pa gsum la rim pas/ ka dal ba ṇaṃ/ kā la ba ṇaṃ/ ka pa la ba naṃ/ de gsum kar yang lan tshwa ngan pa ste/ tshwa lhad can la yang 'jug/lan tshwa nyung ngu la yang 'jug go ༈pu ru ṣe bā/ skyes bu la yang na'o/ skyes bu'i don la ku zhes pa sbyar ba de ni/ mi bsgyur bar ku nyid du 'jog pa'am/ kat sogs su bsgyur gdam kha yin no/ /mdo tshig 'di dpe phal cher la 'dug cing*/ 'di yod pa la dpags na/ gong du ku la kat'o/ /zhes pa yang yod pa 'thad te/ gzhan du na yang na'o zhes pa'i gzhung 'di la/ bsnyegs med par 'gyur te/ sa ha sogs la ni sbyor du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /ci ste na/ dman pa dang chung ngu sogs kyi mdo la bsnyeg go snyam na/ de ni mdo 'di'i tshig ma yin te/ drang srong ka ta'i bu'i gzhung las drangs pa'i lung yin pa'i phyis ro/ ༈'dir dper brjod ni/ ku pu ru ṣa si rnam bcad/ ku pu ru ṣaḥ/ zhes pa kho na la bzhag ste rnam 'gyur ma byas kyang legs la/

yang na/ kat+pu ru ṣa/ kā pu ru ṣaḥ ka ba pu ru ṣaḥrnams su bsgyur kyang rung ste/ skyes bu ngan pa zhes pa'i don yin gyi chung ngu'i don la mi 'jug go gong du smos pa'i lan tshwa lta bu la yang*/ skabs thob kyi res nyung ngu dang*/ res ngan pa la 'jug go/ /kā la ba naṃ zhes pa'i tshig lan gcig po de/ nyung la ngan pa la mi 'jug go/ ༈dan+ta'i da tṛ ste da tṛ dang da sha dang dhā rnams pha rol la ṣa ṣ kyi u nyid te tshig phyi ma la sogs par yang ṭu nyid do/ /zhes 'byung ste/ 'di ni 'bru mang po'o/ /de yang ṣaṣ kyi sgra la dan+ta mtha' ru sbyar na*/ dan+ta de ni da tṛ ru bsgyur dgos shing*/ de lta bu'i da tṛ dang*/ da shan te ming gnyis po de dang dhā zhes pa'i rkyen rnams gang byung yang*/ ṣaṣ kyi mtha' brten ṣ dbyangs med ni u ru 'gyur/ tshig phyi ma'i ta sde'i yi ge ni ṭa sde'i yi ger 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i don yin/ ༈dper brjod/ ṣaṣ la dzas byin pa phyis/ ṣaḍ/ ḍ ṭ/ dan+ta la dzas/ a 'dra ring*/ s rnam bcad/ ṣaṭadan+taḥya s+ya/ so rnams drug gang gi /zhes pa ste ngag go phyis/ ṣaṣ dan+ta zhes pa bzhag/dan+ta da tri ru bsgyur/ ṣ u ru song*/ ṭa nyid do zhes pas/ da yang ḍa ru bsgyur/ si ṭi phyis/ t'i gong du num/ ṣa uḍan ྄t si/ zhes pa byung*/ u la o/ si yal/ ta mi snang*/ ṣo ḍa n/ so drug pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ ṣaṣ kyi mthar da shan sbyar/ ṣ u da ḍa u la o/ mthar dzas byin na phyis/ na 'jig ṣo ḍa sha/ si byin na/ n phyis/ rnam bcad/ ṣo ḍa shaḥ/ gnyis ka bcu drug gi don no/ /'on kyang snga ma mang tshig ste grangs su bgrang ba la 'jug la/ phyi ma gcig tshig ste dngos po tsam mo/ ༈de bzhin du/ ṣa ṣa la rkyen dhā zhes pa byin/ ṣ u/ dhā ḍhā/ u la o/ dzas phyis/ ṣo ḍhā/ 'di la ni yang na ṣ ḍ ru bsgyur/ drangs/ ṣaḍ+ḍhā/ drug rnams zhes so/ yang bṛ hat ām bed num ām pa ti si/

zhes pa bzhag/sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ bṛha tāṃ bedā nāṃ pa ti/ rig byed rnams kyi bdag po chen po ste/ phur bu'o/ de la rig byed ces pa ni/ skabs 'dir rig pa sna tshogs pa'i ming yin gyi/ rig byed bzhi kho na la mi zer ro/ dbyi/ bṛ hat pa ti si/ ta s ru bsgyur/ si rnam bcad/ bṛ haspa tiḥ/ ṣo ḍa shaḥ ṣo ḍ+ḍhābṛ haspa tiḥ/ zhes pa'ang de'i skyes bu'o/ ༈ /yang ma hat si tsa bzhagaha dang t'i bar du num/ n+s ap ma hat kyi dhi min pa la ring po'o/ /ha ring por song*/ si dang*/ t phyis/ n nga ro/ /sak ā ga ma/ s sh ru song ba tsa'i steng du drangs/ ma hāṃ sh+tsa/ zhes pa byung*/ a das si/ /gong bzhin a sau ru bsgyur/ ī shwa ra si tsa/ ma hāṃ sh+tsa sau ī shwarash+tsa/ phyis/ ma hat ī shwa ra/ si tshig snga ma'i ṭi ar song*/ a i la e/ ma he shwa raḥ/ 'di ni zlas dbye ba'o/ /'dir lung drangs pa/ ma hat kyi ṭi ni a nyid te bsdu ba la yin no/ /zhes 'byung bas ma hat kyi sgra la tshig sdud zin ma thag tu/ ṭi a yig tu bsgyur nas mtshams sbyor ba yin no/ ༈yang ji skad du/ ta d+yo'i sgra ni d+yā bā ru bsgyur te bsdu ba byas pa la yin no/ /zhes kyang bshad de/ d+yo si tsa bhū mi si tsa/ d+yo'i o ni au/ d+yaush+tsa bhū mish+tsa/ phyis/ d+yo bhū mi/ tshig dang po d+yo ni/ d+yā bā zhes par bsgyur/ bhū mi au ī/ d+yā bā bhū mī/ nam mkha' dang sa dag go /de yang zlas dbye'o/ ༈a luk+kā tsi t/ 'ga' zhig tu dbyi ba ma yin no/ /'dir rgya skad du/ ā kṛ ti ga na zhes pa kun byed pa'i tshogs pa zhes so/ kun byed pa ni rnam dbye la sogs pa mi bsdu par 'jog pa nyid yin/ de 'dra'i rigs mang po rnams la de'i tshogs pa zhes bya/ 'ga' zhig tu zhes pas/ dgos pa med na rnam dbye dbyi bar mi bya la/ mtha' gcig tu ma yin te/ tshig sdud kyi dgos pa yod na mi snang bar byed do/

kṛt mtha' dang de phan sogs la yang 'di lta bu yod la/ 'di yang tshig sdud kyi nang tshan du bshad pas/ dmigs gsal la rnam dbye mi sdud pa yin gyi /rjes 'brang gi tshig rnams dbyi dgos so/ ༈dper brjod ni/ kṛ tshar ngasi? ātra muk+tasi/ t nr song*/ kṛ tsharā n+muk+taḥ/ dka' tshegs kyis grol lo/ ༈sto ka ngasi? āt muk+tasi/ ta ྄n ru song*/ stokān+muk+ta ཿ/ tshegs chung ngus grol lo/ apa ྄sup yo ni si/ sup kyi p phyis/ si rnam bcad/ ap+su yo niḥ/ chu'i skye gnas te nya'o/ /u ras ngi ng dbyi/ s i la drangs/ lo mn si n'i u pa dhā si dang n phyis/ drangs/ u ra si lo mā/ brang gi spu'o/ ༈hri t ngi spṛshsi/ t d ru song ngi i la drangs/ si 'jug/sh k ru song*/ hri de spṛk /snying dga' ba'o/ /de gnyis la si 'phyid pa byung yang*/ gsal byed mtha' la dbyi ba yin/ n phyis pa yang si'i nus pas n mtha' dbyi ba yin gyi /de dag tshig sdud kyi sgo nas phyis pa ma yin pas/ rnam dbye dbyi ba'i bsdu ba mi byed pa'i dper brjod du bshad pa dang mi 'gal lo/ ༈kan+ṭhadi kā la si/ mtshams sbyar/ kan+ṭhe kā laḥ/ mgrin nag ste lha drag po'i ming ngo*/ ༈bātsa ྄ngas yuk+t-isi/ ng phyis/ ts a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ u o mtshams sbyar/ bā tso yuk+tiḥ/ ngag rigs pa dang ldan pa'o/ ༈di sh ngas/ daṇ+ḍasi/ sh a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ de u mtshams sbyar/ di sho daṇ+ḍaḥ/ yul phyogs kyi dpya khral/ ༈pa sh+yata ྄ngas ha ra si/ t dbyangs med a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ u sogs byed*/ pa sh+ya to ha raḥ/ yang na/ pash+ya la brta ma na'i rkyen tas byin/ s rnam bcad/ pha rol tu ha ra bzhagarnam bcad u sogs 'dra/ pa sh+ya to ha raḥ/ lta bzhin du rku ba'o ste gser mgar gyis gser rku ba lta bu'o/ /de la pa sh+yat zhes pa ni/ mig gis blta ba'i don ming du grub pa yin/ de la ngas byin pas/ tshig tu grub/

yang pa sh+ya kho na lta ba'i byings/ de la rkyen tas byin pas tshig tu grub bo/ /de gnyis po sgrub tshul mi gcig kyang gzugs 'dra zhing don la khyad par med do/ /'dir dper brjod dngos su smos pa rnams rnam dbye mi dbye ba shas che la/ gzhan yang de 'dra'i rigs can mang du yod pa rnams de'i skyes bu'i tshig sdud la spyir btang dang dmigs gsal gyi khyad par ro/ ༈ji skad du/ shā ka pār+thi ba la sogs pa rnams kyi tshig dbus ma dbyi'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ tshig gsum yod pa'i nang tshad shā ka dang*/ pār+thi ba'i dbus kyi tshig dbye ste/ shā ka si pri yasi pār+thi bsi/ si gsum rnam bcad do/ /shā kaḥ pri yaḥpār+thi baḥ/ ldum bu ni mthun pa'i sa gzhi la byung*/ zhes pa ste/ de yang*/ shā kaḥdang*/ pri yaḥdang*/ pār+thi baḥste tshig gsum yod pa las dbus ma pri yaḥphyis/ snga ma'i rnam bcad kyang dbyi ba shas che/ shā ka pān+wi baḥ/ ༈de ba si/ pū dza ka si/ brah+ma ṇa si/ si gsum rnam bcad do/ bar ma u sogs/ de ba pū dza ko brah+ma ṇaḥ/ lha mched pa'i bram ze'o/ /de la tshig bar ma/ pū dza ko phyis pas/ de ba brah+ma ṇaḥ/ de dag la sogs pa gzhan yang ngo*/ /don gcig tu gnas pa la/ rnam dbye dang gcig tu bsdu ba shas che ba las/ spyir btangs dmigs gsal gyi rnam dbye phra mo rnams ma 'dres par shes par bya'o/ ༈ā de sh+tsa dwaṃ dwe/ zlas dbye la dang po yang ngo*/ /'di nas/ du hi tā pa trau bar/ gcig gcig sbyor ba'i zlas dbye'o/ /zlas dbye ba'i tshig sdud kyi rigs 'ga' zhig la/ tshig snga phyi gnyis kyi dang po dbyi ba yang yod do/ /dper brjod ni/ mā tṛ si tsa/ pi tṛ si tsa/ si gnyis ka ā/ ṭi gnyis phyis/ drangs/ mā tā tsa pi tā tsa/ ma dang pha yang ngo*/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis/ mā tṛ pi tṛ zhes byung ba'i tshig dang po mā tṛ phyis/ pi tṛ la gny-is tshig au/ ṛ ar du song*/ so sor drangs pas dngos su/

pi ta rau ste/ pha dag zhes pa las med kyang*/ don pha ma dag go ༈ /shwa shru sh+tsa shwa su ra sh+tsa/ rgyug mo dang gyos po yang ngo*/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis༈ shwa shru shwa su ra/ zhes pa'i tshig dang po/ shwa shru phyis/ phyi ma la au byin/ ra dang mtshams sbyar/ shwa su rau ces pa grub/ dngos su gyos po dag zhes pa las med kyang*/ don gnyis kar go'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ du hi tṛ si tsa pu tra si tsa/ su gong ma ā ṭi phyis/ drangs/ si phyi ma rnam bcad sh/ du hi tā tsa pu tra sh+tsa/ tsha mo dang bu yang ngo*/ /tshig sbyor ba'o/ /rnam dbye sogs dbyi/ du hi tṛ pu tra/ zhes pa'i tshig dang po/ du hi tṛ phyis/ pu tra au mtshams sbyar/ pu trau/ bu dag zhes pa ste/ don tshig sbyor ba dang 'dra'o/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ zlas dbye la rit mtha' rnams kyi tshig dang po'i ā yig yang na'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /de'i dbang du byas te/ zlas dbye'i tshig sdud kyi skabs su/ tshig gnyis kyi snga ma la mtha' na yod pa'i ṛ yig de ā ring por bsgyur te/ mtha' gcig tu ma yin/ yang na ṛ yig rang du gnas pa'ang srid/ bshad ma thag pa ltar phal cher tshig dang po rdzogs par bsub pa nyid do/ ༈mā tṛ sogs kyi ngag sngar bzhin sgrubs pas/ mā tā tsa pi tā tsa/ zhes pa'o/ de nas rnam dbye phyis te/ mā tṛ pi tṛ/ dang po'i tṛ+-i yig gi mtha' ā yig tu bsgyur/ mthar au/ ṛ ar drangs/ mā tā pi ta rau/ ༈de bzhin du/ du hi ta la'ang ngag sngar bzhin bkod/ phyis du hi tṛ pu tṛ/ tshig dang po'i mtha' ṛ ā ru bsgyur/ mthar au mtshams sbyar/ du hi tā pu trau/ de gnyis la tshig phyi ma ṛt mtha' yin min gyi khyad yod pa'i dpe'o/ ༈yang ji skad du/ zlas dbye la sarba sogs nyid la yang na'o/ /zhes kyang bshad te/ 'di ni kun sdud kyi zlas dbye'o/ /de yang zlas dbye'i skabs kha gcig tu/ sarba sogs kyi rtags la sarba sogs nyid kyi lugs so/

/yang na a thung mtha' can gyi lugs kyang rung ngo*/ /zhes pa'o/ /dper brjod ni/ bar+ṇa dzas tsa ā shra ma dzas tsa ita ra dzas tsa zhes bkod/ dzas dang po gnyis dz phyis snga phyi gnyis su mtshams sbyar/ phyi ma dzas ī'o/ /snga phyi thams cad mtshams sbyar/ bar+ṇāsh+tsa shra māsh+tse ta re tsa/ rigs rnams dang spyod par gnas pa rnams las gzhan rnams kyang ngo*/ /phyis/ bar+ṇa dang*/ ā shra ma dang*/ i ta ra rnams bkod/ de rnams mtshams sbyar/ mthar dzas ī'o/ /i la e/ bar+ṇā shra me ta re/ ༈yang dzas kyi dz phyis/ a 'dra ring*/ s rnam bcad/ bar+ṇā shra me ta rāḥ/ rigs spyod gnas gzhan zhes bya'o/ ༈de la rigs zhes pa ni rigs bzhi yin/ spyir ā shra ma dang tir+tha zhes pa don gcig /bsti gnas dang mu gnas su bsgyur ro/ /'dir ā shra ma ni spyod gnas pa ste/ spyod pa snga ma snga ma bor nas phyi ma phyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /de la sngon gyi bram ze rnams/ dang por bram ze'i rigs tsam ste khyim pa phal ba yin la/ de'i tshe rigs kyi chos la nyams pa dgos so/ /de nas spyod gnas pa ni/ lo bcu drug lon pa phyin chad nas skabs shig bram zer bsgrubs/ brah+ma tsā ri te/ na tshod dang po la tshangs par spyod pas gnas so/ /de nas lo bzhi bcu lhag pa nas/ gṛ ha s+thā zhes pa khyim na gnas pa ste bag ma len zhing rigs skyed par byed do/ /bu gcig skyes nas/ bā na bras+thā/ khyim spangs nas nags su gnas te/ gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs te gtsug phud bzhag/skra gzhan bregs te/ nags na bu smad dang bcas kyang 'khrig sbyor bdun spangs te/ tshangs par spyod de 'di ni drang srong gi gnas pa'o/ /de nas de ka la gnas pa'am yang 'dod na bu smad spangs nas/ pa ri bra dza ka ste rab tu byung ba kun tu rgyu byed do/ /phyi ma 'di spyod pa sngon ma gsum rim pas rgyud mi dgos pa shas che mod/ bzhi rim byed pa srid pa'i dbang du byas pa ste 'di ni/

a shra ma ste khyim na mi gnas pa'i phyir mi gnas pa ste rab tu byung ba'i don yang yin/ yang na ā shra ma ste/ spyod pa mchog la kun tu gnas pa'o/ /gzhan gsum po la yang spyod pa snga ma rnams la ma gnas pa dang phyi ma la gnas pas/ ā shra ma dang*/ ā shra ma'o/ de yang bram ze dang san+ya shi rnams kyi 'dod pas/ rigs gzhan rnams kyi rab tu byung ba ni/ dge sbyong gzhan dag yin la/ bram ze ni kun tu rgyu kho na la rab tu byung dgos na/ gang bram ze zhi ba pa'am nyi ma pa la sogs par rab tu byung na/ rigs kyi chos kyang ma yin la/ mi gnas pa'i chos kyang ma yin pas/ rigs dang mi gnas pa las gzhan pa zhes 'dogs pa'o/ /zhes 'dod do/ /'di 'dra'i rigs phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' dang brda chad kyi dper brjod/ dur phan dag na yang mang du yod te/ bod dag gis de dang de'i lugs ma shes par tom chol du bsgyur ba dag snang ngo*/ ༈da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ ji skad du/ 'bru mang po la yang tha dad par byed pa'i dbus kyi tshig dbyi ba yang ngo*/ /zhes 'byung ste/ 'dir tha dad par byed pa zhes pa'i skad dod/ bai yā dhi ka ra ṇa zhes pa yod/ de yang 'grel bshad las/ tha dad pa'i don la nges par gnas shing yod pa'i rnam dbye tha dad pa'i mtha' ni/ bai yā ti ka ra ṇa'o/ /zhes 'byung ste/ tshig sdud byed rgyu'i tshig gong 'og gsum sbyar ba gcig la/ tshig dang po'i don las tshig tha ma'i don ngo bo gzhan yin zhing*/ gnyis kar rnam dbye'i mtha' can yin pa gcig dgos/ 'on kyang snga phyi gnyis po 'brel ba dang ldan pa'i tshig ni/ skabs 'dir gzhan du byed pa zhes bya ste/ 'di 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba yin yang gzhan don byed pa la/ tshig snga phyi gnyis kyi 'brel ba ston pa'i tshig dbus ma dbyi bar bya'o/ ༈haṃ sa das ྄ga ma na si i ba ga ma na si yad ngas ྄zhes bzhagangas gnyis po s+ya re/ si gnyis po am re/ a phyis/ m rjes su nga ro yat kyi ṭi a/

haṃ sa s+ya ga ma na mi ba ga ma naṃ ya s+ya/ ngang pa'i 'gros dang 'dra ba'i 'gros gang gi zhes byung tshig gi sbyor ba'o/ /s+ya gnyis dang*/ nga ro gnyis rnam dbye yin pas phyis/ ga ma na gnyis kyi sngon ma dang*/ ya ni rjes 'brang tsam mam don tsam yin pas phyis haṃ sa dang*/ i ba dang*/ ga ma na zhes pa'i tshig gsum po bsdus te gnas pa la/ tshig dbus ma/ i ba zhes pa 'dir mi snang bar bya ste/ mthar bud med kyi rkyen āp sbyar/ haṃ sa ga ma nā/ zhes grub ste/ ngang pa'i 'gros ma/ zhes pa'o/ /de'i don ni ngang mo nyid la yod pa'i 'gros ston pa ma yin te/ ngang pa'i 'gros dang 'dra ba'i 'gro tshul yod pa'i bud med ston no/ /de la tshig dang po'i don ni ngang pa rang gi 'gros yin la/ phyi ma ni de las gzhan pa bud med kyi rkang 'gros yin no/ /de gnyis ngo bo tha dad yin pas tha dad du byed pa'i tshig zhes bya/ 'on kyang i ba zhes pa bsgyur na 'dra ba zhes pa'i tshig gis de gnyis 'brel med ma yin par 'brel ba can du bsgrubs te/ dpe don gyi 'brel ba'i sgo nas don gcig tu sbyar ro/ ༈nye ba'i tshig gan+dha sogs kyi i yig go zhes kyang bshad te/ ku mu da ngas gan+dha si/ i ba gan+dhasi/ yad ngas zhes pa bkod/ si snga ma phyis/ phyi ma rnam bcad ha ba la u sogs/ ya'i ṭi a/ ngas gnyis s+ya/ ku mu da s+ya gan+dha i ba gan+dho ya s+ya/ ku mu da'i dri dang 'dra ba'i dri gang gi zhes pa ste dag go /de nas rnam dbye sogs phyis/ ku mud i ba gan+dha zhes 'byung ba'i/ tshig dbus ma i ba zhes pa phyis/ tshig phyi ma'i mtha' dhi'i srog gi a ni i yig tu bsgyur/ si rnam bcad/ ku mu da gan+dhiḥ/ ku mud kyi dri ldan no/ ༈dik saṃ khye saṃ dz+nya yāṃ/ phyogs dang grangs kyi ming can la'o/ /de yang las 'dzin pa'i bsdu ba'i skabs su/ phyogs kyi sgra'i ming can dang grangs kyi sgra'i ming can tshig dang por yod la/

pha rol kyi tshig kyang de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i gzhi mthun par yod pa'i don la/ dang por ngag bkod nas/ phyis tshig sdud byed pa sogs mi dgos te/ thog ma nyid nas tshig sdud kho nas chog go /phyogs dang grangs kyi ming can yin yang mnyam par 'jug pa'i don ma yin pa dang*/ mnyam du 'jug pa can yin yang*/ phyogs grangs ma yin pa la ni/ ngag 'god pa'am/ tshig gi sbyor ba yod pa nyid de gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ ༈'dir ni dper brjod na/ dak+ṣi ṇa ag+ni si rnam bcad/ 'dra ba ring po/ dak+ṣi ṇāg+niḥ/ lho phyogs kyi me zhes so/ /de la me yang yin lho phyogs can yang yin pa mnyam du 'jug pa ste/ gzhi mthun pa'ang yin pa la phyogs kyi ming can gyi dpe'o/ /lho phyogs kyi me ni/ ba ḍa bā ag+ni ste/ rgod ma kha'i me'o/ ༈yang sap+tan grā ma dzas/ n mtha' phyis/ dzas kyi a mtshams sbyar/ s rnam bcad/ sap+ta grā māḥ/ grong sde bdun zhes pa ste/ gzhi mthun pa grangs kyi ming can gyi dpe'o/ ༈de ltar na/ mi zad de'i skyes bu dang*/ /zlas dbye 'bru mang las 'dzin pa/ /ngag gnyis pa ste bsdu ba drug /las 'dzin pa dang ba gnyis pa/ /de'i skyes bur bsdu ba yod/ /de ltar na bsdu ba drug gam bzhi rnams kyi spyir btang dmigs gsal rnams dang*/ tshig dang po dbyi ba dang*/ dbus ma dbyi ba dang*/ dang po bsgyur ba la sogs pa rnam 'gyur gyi khyad par rnams so sor ma 'dres pa dang*/ gdam nga sogs kyi bye brag la mkhas par bya'o/ de ltar na brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi gzhung las/ tshig sdud kyi don rags pa tsam bshad zin to// ༈ /da ni de phan gyi rkyen 'jug tshul bshad de/ abat+ye.aṇ/ bu rgyud la aṇ'o/ /a ba t+ya zhes pa bu'i rigs kyi ming yin la/ de'i don du rkyen aṇ la sogs pa ster/ ༈de yang 'di ltar/ u pa gu la ngas byin/ a bat+ya/ la si byin/ u pa gu ngas a bat+yas zhes pa byung*/ ngid la'o zhes pas i e dang u o ru 'gyur bas/

gu go ru song*/ ngasi? ngas kyi a dbyi bas/ u pa gos s rnam bcad/ si am du bsgyur/ am gyi a phyis/ u ba goḥ.a ba t+yam/ rnam bcad r/ u ba gor ba t+yam/ zhes pas bā kye ste ngag tu grub/ tshig sdud dang rkyen dag la'o zhes pas rnam dbye phyis/ drug pa'i dang po ngas kyi 'gyur ba'am rnam bcad phyis/ de phyis pas go yang gu nyid du log /si'i rnam 'gyur m yang dbyi/ u pa gu a bat+ya/ zhes pa byung*/ bu rgyud la aṇ zhes/ a ba t+ya phyis/ de'i don gyi rkyen aṇ bzhag/aṇ gyi ṇ/ ṇ yig 'phel ba'i don tsam yin pas dbyi/ ā di swa ra s+ya nyiṇa ti tsa bṛ d+dhiḥ/ nyṇ zhes pa la'ang dbyangs dang po 'phel ba'o/ /zhes ny dang ṇ rjes 'brel gyi rkyen byung ba na ming de la yod pa'i dbyangs thog ma de 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ 'dir dbyangs yig dang po thog ma u yig de 'phel ba au ru 'gyur ro/ /au ba gu a zhes pa byung*/ bo ྅ bya swa re/ u o'i ya dang dbyangs la ap'o/ /bu rgyud kyi skabs 'dir/ ya pha rol dang dbyangs pha rol du yod la/ rtags mtha' ru u yig dang o yig yod na/ u'am o ap tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir pha rol dbyangs dang rtags mtha' u yin pa/ u apa tu 'gyur/ pra dbyangs med a la drangs/ au pa ga ba byung si byin rnam bcad/ au pa ga baḥb lang rdzi'i rigs kyi bu/ u pa gu a bat+ya/ zhes pa yan chad go ba che ba'i phyir/ ngag bkod pa'am tshig tu sbyar ba'i rtsa songs byas pa yin/ skabs kyi gzhung don aṇ sbyin pa man chad yin no/ /'di la ba ra ṇa si'i sgra mkhan po phyis byung da lta'i bar gyi gzhung 'di 'chad pa mang bo zhig a bat+ya/ zhes pa bu rgyud kyi skad dod kyang yin mod rkyen yin pas de thog mar bkod nas/ slar aṇ la sogs par bsgyur par 'dod/ 'og gi iṇ ṇ+ya sogs kyang a bat+ya'i lus 'gyur yin zer ro/ /de lta bu 'di'i 'grel bshad/ puñdza rā dza na yod zer/

sgra mdo gzhan 'ga' re'i lugs la'ang yod pa ni 'dug /bdag gi bsam pa ltar na/ 'dir gzhung rang las kyang*/ a bat+ya zhes 'byung ba/ bod skad du bu rgyud la zhes pa bdun pa'i gcig tshig yod kyi/ a bat+ya s+ya zhes pa lta bu/ bu rgyud kyi zhes drug pa'i rnam dbye med pa dang*/ 'grel bar yang*/ nā m+no3bat+yār+the aṇ prat+ya yo bha ba ti/ zhes pa byung bas/ de bsgyur na/ ming las bu rgyud kyi don la aṇ rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /zhes par byung gi ming las bu rgyud zhes pa aṇ gyi rkyen du 'gyur ro zer ba lta bu mi snang bas 'di'i lugs la'ang spyi dang 'dra bar/ a pa t+ya kyi don du grub pa la aṇ ster ba nyid yin no snyam mo/ /yang 'dir/ a bat+ya la si byin ba'i rjes/ abat+yaṃ aṇ du bsgyur ba dang*/ si phyis nas/ a bat+ya kho na a ṇ ru bsgyur ba gnyis kyang phyi ma 'thad do/ ༈de bzhin du/ ba sheṣ+ṭha dang*/ go ta ma lta bu/ ngas s+ya gzhan 'dra/ bu rgyud la a ṇ/ ny ṇ la dbyangs dang po 'phel ba'o/ /bā shiṣ+ṭha a/ gau ta ma a/ 'di dag a'i mtha' yin pas/ ya dang dbyangs la ap mi thob/ /i a dag gi dbyi'o/ /zhes pas/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ rkyen gyi a drangs/ si rnam bcad/ bā shiṣ+ṭhaḥ gnas 'jog gi bu/ gau ta maḥ go ta ma'i bu/ ༈ṛ u ra ṇi/ aṇ la ṛ u r'o/ ṛ mtha' la aṇ byung na ṛ yig u r ru 'gyur te/ dper na/ mā tṛ a/ mā tur ru 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /de rtsa ba nas cung zad slangs te brjod na/ ṣa ṣ ām/ mā tṛ ām/ a bat+ya si/ zhes bzhaga.ām gnyis kyi gong du nuṭ/ ṣ yi ḍ zhes pas ṣ dbyangs med ḍ ru song*/ ḍ yi ṇ zhes pas ḍ ṇ ru song*/ ṣa ṇn ām/ mā trin ām/ a bat+yas/ zhes pa'o/ ṣa ṭu las ṣa ṭu'o/ zhes p naṃ? na zhes pa yod pa'i tshur rol ṭa sde ṇ yig mthong bas pha rol ta sde n yig ṭa sde ṇ yig tu song*/ nām la'o zhes pas/ tṛ'i ṛ ring por gyur/

ṣa ra ṛ zhes sogs nām ṇām/ si am/ a phyis/ rim pas drangs/ ṣaṇ+ṇāṃ mā tṝ ṇāṃ a ba t+yaṃ rnams kyi drug rnams kyi bu/ zhes pa'am/ ṣaṇ+ṇā m+mā treṇā ma ba t+yam/ zhes dag tu grub pa'o/ /rnam dbye rnams tshig sdud dang rkyen dag la'o zhes pas phyis te/ ām phyis pas/ lugs can med pas lugs kyang med do/ nu ṭ kyang dbyi/ ḍ ṇ sogs kyang log ste/ ṣaṣ rang du log/tṛ yang tṛ ru log/ṣaṣ mā tṛ a ba t+ya/ a ba t+ya phyis/ aṇ/ nyṇ 'phel ba/ ṣa'i ḍ/ ḍ ṇ/ aṇ la ṛ ur'o zhes pa skabs don 'di yin te/ tṛ'i srog ṛ ur ru song*/ ṣāṇ+mā tu ra/ si rnam bcad/ ṣāṇ+mā turaḥm drug gi bu ste gzhon nu gdong drug go/ 'dir ṣa'i ḍ ṇ ru bsgyur ba'i tshig ni/ /ji skad du/ 'ga' zhig na dzha sa rnams nya ma ru 'dod do/ /zhes pa 'grel bar drangs so/ ༈at.i nya nṛ? ṣeḥ/ at las drang srong min pa la iny'o/ /a yig mtha' can drang srong gi bu rgyud ston pa min par gzhan gyi bu rgyud ston pa drang srong gi ming ma yin pa/ gzhan gyi ming la iny rkyen du 'gyur te/ ny ṇ la yang dbyangs dang po 'phel ba zhes pa'i ny rjes 'brel ni 'di lta bu'o/ /de ba dat+ta ni skyes bu gang ci yang rung ba tsam zhig mtshon pas/ drang srong gi sgra ma yin pa'i a mtha'o/ /gong du u pa gu yang drang srong min mod u mtha' can no/ /de ba dat+ta s+ya a bat+yaṃ/ rnam dbye phyis/ a ba t+ya phyis/ iny sbyin/ ny ni 'phel ba'i don dbyi/ nyṇ zhes pa la yang sogs 'phel ba/ dai ba dat+ta i/ i a dag gi dbyi'o/ /ta'i a phyis/ rkyen dang sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ lha sbyin gyi bu zhes pa lha sbyin ni gang yang rung ba'i spyi ming yin no/ dai ba dat+tiḥ/ cho ga de ka shrī dha ra la sbyar/ shrai dha riḥ dpal 'dzin gyi bu zhes te dpal mo'i bdag po ni/ /dpal 'dzin te lha khyab 'jug yin/ /de'i bu'o/

/n+yā ya na ṇe yaṇ+ṇī yā gar+ghan ḍā tri s+t+ri pi tra shwa srā de sh+tsa/ garga/ ṇa ḍa/ a tri/ bud med kyi/ pi tṛ/ ṣ+wa sṛ la sogs pa rnams las ṇ+ya ā yan ṇ/ e yaṇ/ ṇī ya yang ngo*/ /sogs pa zhes garga sogs re re la sbyor te/ garga sogs la ṇ+ya/ ṇa ḍa sogs la ā ya naṇ/ a tri sogs la e yaṇ/ bud med kyi pi tṛ swa sṛ sogs la ṇī ya zhes pa rnams bu rgyud kyi rkyen du ster te/ ༈gargas+ya a ba t+yaṃ/ rnam dbye dang*/ a pa t+ya phyis/ ṇ+ya bzhag/ṇ phyis ya/ ny ṇ zhes pa la yang sogs/ thog ma'i ga ring po/ gār+g+ga ya/ i a'i dbyi'o zhes pas/ mtha'i a phyis/ ya'i steng du drangs/ gārgya/ si rnam bcad/ gārgyaḥ/ de bzhin du/ bāt+saṇ+ya/ bātas+yaḥ/ la sogs shin du mang po'o/ ༈na ḍa s+ya a pa t+yaṃ/ na ṇa ā ya naṇ/ ṇ phyis/ /na ḍa'i nā ring po/ i a dbyi/ nā ḍā ya naḥ/ drang srong na ḍa'i bu tsa ra ā ya naṇ/ yang de dang 'dra ba las ṣa ra ṛ sogs/ tsā rā ya ṇaḥdrang srong tsa ra'i bu/ a mu ṣa ā ya naṇ la'ang de dang 'dra bas/ ā mu ṣā drang srong che ge mo'i bu ya ṇaḥ/ ༈a tri la pha rol e yaṇ/ ṇ 'phel don/ a tri'i a ring po/ ā tri i phyis/ ā tra e ya/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ā tre yaḥrgyun shes bu/ ༈de dang 'dra bar gaṅga e yaṇ/ gāṅge yaḥlha mo gaṅgā'i bu/ ༈ka pi e yaṇ/ kā me bu yaḥspre'u'i/ ༈ma hī e yaṇ/ mā he yaḥsa'i bu ste mig dmar/ de dag gi rtsa slong byed na snga mas rigs 'gre ba las/ gaṅgā la ngas byin na/ ngid rnams kyi yaṭ'o/ zhes yaṭ/ gaṅgā āḥyā a tri ngas/ ngid la'o zhes pas/ tri'i i e ru song*/ ngasi ngas kyi a phyis/ a treḥzhes 'byung ba ni khyad par ro/ ༈ka pi a tri dang 'dra/ ༈ma hī ni nā dī dang 'dra ste/ ma hī la ngas byin/ aṭ ma hī a as byung ī ya/ mah y a as/ 'dra ba ring*/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ ma h+yāḥ/ zhes 'byung ngo*/ ༈pi tṛ la ngas/ ṛ t la nga'i u'o zhes pas as us su song*/

de ḍis yin/ ḍis la ṭi dbyi/ pi tuḥzhes pa 'byung ste/ de nas sāsṛ ngas gong dang 'dra/ swa suḥ/ ༈de dag la a bat+ya si/ si am/ am kyi a phyis/ s ṣ ru bsgyur/ pi tuḥṣ+wa su ra ba t+yaṃ/ zhes ngag tu grub/ a ba t+ya phyis/ ṇī ya 'bri/ ṇā 'phel ba'i don/ rkyen phyis/ bi tṛ swasṛ ī ya/ dbyangs dang po sogs/ pa tṛ ru song*/ sa ṣa/ sṛ'i ṛ r drangs si rnam bcad/ pai tṛ ṣ+wa yaḥpha'i sring mo'i bu swī/ mā tṛ ṣ srī yaḥma'i ming po'i bu/ ༈bud med kyi rtags la yang aṇ 'ga' zhig tu'o/ /zhes gzhan las bshad pas/ bhu mi a ba t+ya phyis/ bhu mi aṇ ṇ phyis/ dang por 'phel ba/ ṭi phyis/ si rnam bcad/ bhau maḥsa'i bu ste mig dmar/ ༈lu gwa hu twe kā tsit/ mang po 'jig ste 'ga' zhig tu'o/ /skabs 'gar mang tshig byin pa la aṇ sogs 'jig ste drang srong dang drang srong ma yin pa thams cad la 'dra'o/ /garga ṇ+ya/ ṇ phyis/ ya yang dbyi bas dang por 'phel ba med/ dzas byin/ dz phyis/ 'dra ba ring bo/ gargāḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ a tra yāḥ/ rgyal po lus 'phags kyi bu'i don la/ bi de hāḥ/ 'di rnams la ngag tu byed pa la yang mang tshig dgos/ /phyis pas rting la rjes mi mngon yang dang po/ a pa t+ya ni/ zhes pa yod/ dzas shas shi ru byed/ num ster/ rtags mtha' ring po'o/ drang srong gi dper brjod garga atri/ drang srong min ba'i dper brjod bi de ha'o/ ༈de ba te da mar+the/ lha dang 'di'i don la'o/ /lha'i don te lha'i phyir du bshams pa'i don dang*/ lha yang mi ldog nas lha'i 'gro ba tsam la mi bya ste bsten pa'i lha'i don yin no/ /lha'i 'gro ba ma yin kyang bsten pa de la lha zhes zer ro/ /'di zhes pa yang mngon du gyur pa 'di yi rdzas la sogs pa yin pa'i don no/ /de 'dra ba'i lha'i don dang*/ 'di'i don la yang aṇ rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /༈dper brjod ni lha'i don la/ in+d+ra si/

de ba tā si/ yad ngas ha bi zhes pa bzhag si snga ma rnam bcad/ ha ba las u a u la o/ si phyi ma āp mtha' la phyis/ yad/ t+yad sogs la ṭi a /ngas s+ya/ in+d+ro de ba tā ya s+ya ha bi/ dbang po lha gang gi /zhes pa ste dbang po zhes pa gang yin na bsten pa'i lha dbang po/ gang gi ni gang dbang po'i don du dmigs pa'i ha bi ste sby-in sreg gi sreg rdzas so/ /de ba tā phyis/ aṇ ya s+ya/ ha bi don tsam yin pa dang rnam dbye si phyis/ in+d+ra aṇ/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dbyangs dang po sogs/ i la 'phel ba e/ i a yi dbyi/ drangs/ ain+d+ra si/ de am/ a phyis/ ain+d+rāṃ/ dbang po'i don gyi mchod rdzas so/ ༈des rigs bsgres te/ so ma si/ de ba tā si/ yad ngas/ se mo de ba tā ya s+ya/ zhes pa'i ngag tu grub/ de ba tā a ṇ ru bsgyur/ gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ sau myaṃ/ ༈'di'i don la/ de ba dat+ta er+thasi/ i dm si/ si dang po am/ a dbyi/ ar+tham/ si phyi ma ma ning ngam gsal byed mtha' la phyis/ de ba dat+tār+tha mi i dm ṭi a thob kyang 'dir mi byed/ i dm phyis/ aṇ/ ṇ brjod don/ si phyis/ ar+tha yang phyis/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a dbyi/ drangs/ si am/ a phyis/ dai ba da ṇaṃ/ gos la sogs pa ste/ lha sbyin gyi don du bzhag pa'i gos lta bu'o/ /༈kra tsi t dwa yoḥ/ kha cig tu gnyis ka la'o/ /ag+ni ma ru t la/ aṇ byin/ tshig sngon ma ag+ni dang*/ phyi ma ma rut yin pa las/ spyir btang la tshig gnyis don gcig la bsdu dgos pa'i rigs la/ tshig dang po kho na'i dbyangs dang po 'phel ba yin mod/ dmigs gsal la gnyis ka'i dbyangs dang po gnyis 'phel ba yin pas/ skabs 'dir ag+ni a dang*/ ma rut gyi ma'i srog gi a gnyis 'phel ba ā ru 'gyur ro/ āg+ni mā ru t a si drangs/ si am/ a phyis/ m nga ro/ āg+ni mā ru taṃ karmā/ me la rlung gi las byed/ zhes so/ ༈ su hṛd.a ṇ 'dir su dang hṛd ni tshig so so yin pa'i phyir/

su'i u 'phel ba au dang*/ ha'i ṛ ni 'phel ba ār du 'gyur/ d a la drangs/ si am a phyis/ sau hārdaṃ/ su bha ga/ ṇ+ya/ su ni nyer bsgyur bha ga'ang ming ste so so yin/ su dang bha la 'phel ba/ rkyen gyi ṇ rjes 'brel/ i a las dbyi drangs si am/ gong bzhin/ sau bhā gyaṃ/ ༈'dir 'grel par lung drangs pa dngos po'i don la a ṇ'o/ /zhes pa ni/ dper na su hṛd yid dga' ba'i don yin la/ aṇ byin pas khyad chos yid dga' ba de dang ldan pa'i khyad gzhi dngos po sny-ing nye ba'i gang zag de go bar 'gyur bas/ sau hārda ni mdza' bshes so/ ༈aṇ kho na ma yin te/ ṇ+ya ster ba'i dpe ni/ sau bhā gya'o/ /'di dag tu rkyen si byin pa ni mtshon byed te/ phal cher la rnam dbye thams cad ster te/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur rnams la'ang go bar bya'o/ ༈ /ṇi to bā/ ṇi ta la yang na'o/ /ṇit zhes pa ni ṇ rjes 'brel gyi rkyen rjes 'brel phyis zin pa'i ming ngo*/ de yang mtshon byed te/ m rjes 'brel phyis pa la mit dang*/ k rjes 'brel phyis pa la kit dang*/ ṭ rjes 'brel phyis pa la ṭit dang*/ ny rjes 'brel phyis pa la nyi t zer ba sogs go bar bya'o/ /de la 'dir/ a dzasi/ gosi/ yad ngas/ zhes pa bkod/ si phyi ma byung bas/ go yi o au/ si gnyis ka rnam bcad/ rnam bcad snga ma u ru song*/ mtshams sbyar/ phyi ma r/ yad kyi ṭi a/ ngas s+ya/ a dzo gaur+ya s+ya/ nor dang sa gzhi ldan pa gang zhes pa byung*/ rnam dbye rnams phyis/ a dza go de nyid dbang phyug chen po'i ming yin la/ de la aṇ sbyin/ a la 'phel ba byed mi byed gdam kha yin/ go'i o ni ab drangs/ si am 'dra/ ā dzag baṃ/ a dza ga baṃ/ zhes pa 'dam khar grub ste/ dbang phyug chen po'i phyag gi gzhu'i ming ngo*/ ༈de bzhin du/ ku mu da ngas/ gan+dha si i ba ga na dha si yad ngas/ ngas s+ya gnyis/ si am/ si phyi ma rnam bcad u/ yad kyi ṭi a/

ku mu das+ya gan+dha mi ba gan+dho ya s+ya/ ku mu da'i dri dang 'dra ba'i dri gang gi /zhes byung ba don ni/ gang gi dri kun mu da'i dri dang 'dra ba/ zhes pa'i don no/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis/ ku mu da gan+dhi aṇ/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ ku la 'phel ba byed mi byed gdam kha/ iy rkyen gyi a la drangs/ bud med la āp'o/ /p rjes 'brel ā 'dra ba'i yi ge kau mu da gan+dh+yā/ ku mu da gan+dh+ya/ ku mu da'i dri dang 'dra ba yod pa'i bud med dang*/ ku mu da'i dri ldan mi gcig gi bu dang*/ skabs 'gar ku mu da'i ba thag las mched pa'i myu gu la yang*/ ku mu da ma las byung ba'i phrug gu'am bu'i don tshang bas/ bu rgyud kyi don gyi aṇ 'jug go /des na 'dir aṇ bu dang*/ bud med gnyis ka la 'jug pa'o/ ༈shwa su ra ngas/ i dm si/ zhes pa bzhag /ngas s+ya/ i dm si dang bcas pa a yam du bsgyur/ mtshams sbyar/ shwa su ra s+yā yaṃ/ tshig sbyor ro/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis/ swa shwa su ra ṇ+ya ṇ rjes 'brel/ i a yi dbyi/ drangs 'phel ba/ swā shwa su r+ya/ zhes pa grub bo/ si pha rol du grā ma/ si gnyis ka rnam bcad/ rnam bcad dang po u/ mtshams sbyar/ shwā sur+yo grā maḥ/ gyos po'i khyim nas 'ongs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈biṣ+ṇu si i dm ṇ'i srog gi u or song*/ si rnam bcad/ r mtshams sbyar/ biṣ+ṇo ridaṃ/ si'i rjes dang i dm phyis/ ṇo ṇur log go /de la aṇ sbyin/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ u ab/ so sor drangs pas/ baiṣ+ṇa ba/ si am sngar bzhin/ baiṣ+ṇa baṃ/ khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brang ba 'di'am/ khyab 'jug pa 'di zhes bya'o/ ༈go si i dm si rnam bcad/ r drangs/ go ri daṃ/ si sogs phyis/ ṇ+ya sbyin/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ o ab so sor drangs/ si am/ ga byaṃ/ ba byung 'di zhes bya'o/ ༈ku la s+ya i dm/ s+ya man chad phyis/ ṇ+ya sbyin/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ i a'i dbyi/ drangs/ si am/ ku l+yaṃ/

'di'i rigs zhes so/ ༈yuṣ+mad ṇī ya ming de nitwad zhes par bsgyur/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ asmadṇīya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ rtags te md zhes par bsgyur/ gnyis ka la si am/ ༈twa dī yaṃ/ khyod kyi'o/ ༈ma dī yaṃ/ nga'i 'o/ ༈go sogs bzhi po 'di la ṇit kyi rkyen byin bas/ dang por 'phel ba spyir btang la thob kyang 'di rnams dmigs gsal yin pas mi byed do/ ༈tsa tu sh+tsa lo paḥ/ tsa tur gyi tsa dbyi'o/ /tsa tur rtags la/ de phan gyi rkyen gyi ya'i rkyen dang*/ dbyangs kyi rkyen gang byung kyang*/ thog ma tsa yig dbyi bar bya ste/ tsa turṇ+ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ tsa dbyi/ r ya la drangs/ si am/ tur+yaṃ/ ya'i rkyen gyi dper brjod do/ ༈tsa tur ṇī ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ tsa phyis/ r i la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ tu rī yaḥ/ dbyangs rkyen gyi dper brjod do/ /don ni tsa tur nyid la gnas te/ bzhi po rnams so zhes pa'o/ ༈a n+ya s+ya da k/ /a n+ya gyi da k'o/ /a n+ya gyi sgra la de phan gyi dbyangs rkyen pha rol du byung na/ bar du dk ā ga ma ster te/ rtags la dk ā ga ma ster/ a n+ya dk ṇī ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ k rjes 'brel/ a n+yad ī yaṃ/ i a phyis/ drangs si am/ a n+ya dī yaṃ/ gzhan gyi phyir/ zhes so/ ༈dk gyi rkyen a n+ya kho na la yin gyi gzhan la ma yin pa'i dpe ni/ ar+dha dzar ta ṇī ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ ta'i a phyis/ drangs/ si ar+dha dza ra tī yaṃ/ phyed rgas pa ste/ dar yol 'di'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ ༈kā ra kā kri ya yuk+te/ byed po dang bya ba'i sbyor ba la'o/ /byed pa po dang bya ba sbyor ba dang*/ byed pa po dang byed pa sbyor ba dang*/ byed pa dang las sbyor ba dang*/ byed po las dang bya ba gsum sbyor dang*/ byed po las dang byed pa gsum sbyor dang*/ byed po las dang bya byed bzhi sbyor ba ste/ dbye ba drug po de la sngar bshad pa'i rkyen rnams 'jug go

/bya ba'am byed pa gnyis ka'am gang rung cig med na ni/ byed po dang las sbyor ba'i tshig tsam yod kyang don nges pa dkon la/ las kyi tshig med kyang byed po dang bya byed gang rung 'brel ba dang*/ byed po tshig med kyang*/ bya ba dang byed pa gang rung dang las 'brel ba dang*/ gsum ka tshogs pa gnyis dang*/ bzhi car yod na don gsal bar ston pa'i phyir/ de dag gi khyad par phyed par bya'o/ /kuṅku me na rak+taṃ bas+t+raṃ zhes pa bzhag /kuṅku me na/ gur gum gyis zhes pa ste/ byed pa po'i tshig go /rak+ta ni dmar por btsos pa ste bya ba'i tshig go/ bas+t+ra ni gos te gang la bya ba'i yul lo/ /des na/ gur gum gyi dmar ba'i gos zhes pa ste/ gur gum gyi tshos btab pa'i gos kha dog dmar ba'i don no/ /me na'i in ni ṭā yi rjes yin pas rnam dbye dang*/ rak+ta sogs don tsam yin pas phyis/ kuṅku ma aṇ bzhag /ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ mtha'i srog phyis/ drangs/ si am/ kauṅku maṃ/ gur gum gyis btsos pa'i gos zhes so/ ༈ma thu rā la ngas dang yṭa sbyin pas/ ma thu rā ya as byung*/ 'dra ba ring s rnam bcad/ pha rol du ā ga ta bzhag pas/ ma thu rā yāḥ.ā ga ta/ bcom brlag nas 'ongs so/ /yāḥ sogs phyis nas/ ma thu rā aṇ/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang po 'phel ba/ i a sogs/ si/ mā thu raḥ/ ༈grā ma ngi bha baḥng phyis/ i la e/ grā me bha baḥ/ rnam dbye'i rjes sogs phyis/ grā ma ṇ+ya dbyangs dang po 'phel bar gdod nas yod pas gsar du 'gro rgyu med/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ste grā myaḥ/ grong sde na yod do/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈dhu raṃ ba ha tī ti/ raṃ gyi klad skor ni si'i rjes so/ /tī ti zhes pa/ ti i ti mtshungs 'dra byas pa'o/ de bsgyur na/ 'phang lo 'dren pa po'o ste shing rta 'dren pa glang ngo*/ /dhur e yaṇ/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ 'phel ba/ r drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dhau re yaḥ/ yang na dhur ṇ+ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/

drangs si dhūr+yaḥ/ ༈ke ne ye kāḥ/ ka ī na i ya i ka rnams so/ /'dir dngos po la sogs pa'i don/ ka dang īn dang*/ i ya dang*/ i ka ste rkyen bzhi po de dag ster ba las/ de rnams la ṇit kyi ming 'dogs mi 'dogs rnam par rtog pa ste gdam ga'o/ /de la ṇit kyi ming can du byas na/ dang por 'phel ba byed la/ ṇit kyi ming ma btags na de mi byed do zhes thog mar go bar bya dgos so/ /'dir bha ba ar+tha ste 'byung ba'i don zhes pa/ bskyed cing skyes pa'am/ nang nas phyir byung ba lta bu ste/ de ltar na 'byung tshul de lta bu'i don la/ rkyen bzhi po de rnams 'jug cing*/ 'grel par/ bha bā d+yar+tha ste 'byung ba la sogs pa zhes/ sogs khongs smos yod pas don gzhan la'ang 'jug go ༈kar+ṇā ṭa di bha ba si/ d phyis/ a i e/ si rnam bcad/ kar+ṇā ṭe bha baḥ/ yul kar+ṇāṭar skyes pa'am/ kar+ṇā ṭa las 'ongs pa'i don no/ /don de nyid la/ kar+ṇā ṭa ka zhes pa cha gnyis bzhag/ka'i rkyen de ṇit yin pa'i phyogs la/ dang por 'phel ba byed/ cig shos la 'phel ba med/ ka'i mthar si rnam bcad do/ kār+ṇā ṭa kaḥ/ kar+ṇā ṭa kaḥ/ zhes pa gdam kha ste/ 'di la yul der skyes pa'i skad dod bdun pa gnas gzhi'i rkyen ji lta bu dang*/ skyes pa dang byung ba'i skad dod bha ba lta bu dngos su med kyang*/ de phan gyi rkyen/ ka yig sbyar ba kho na las/ der skyes pa'am de nas 'ongs pa don du 'gyur ba yin te/ de phan gyi rkyen phal cher 'di 'dra'i rigs so/ /dper na bod skad la yang*/ rgya gar ba zhes brjod na/ rgya gar du skyes pa'i gang zag gam skyes pa min yang de nas 'ongs pa gang rung go ba bzhin no/ ༈grā ma ngasi ā ga ta si/ ta tra dzā ta si bā/ zhes pa bzhag/ngasi āt/ mtshungs 'dra/ t d ru/ d a la drangs/ si snga ma rnam bcad/ de s drangs/ si phyi ma rnam bcad u/ de ltar mtshams sbyor bas/ grā mā rā ga tasta tra dzā tā+o bā/

grong sde las 'ongs shing der skyes pa nyid do/ /zhes pa'o/ /don de la/ grā ma ī na bzhag/thog ma 'phel bar gdod nas grub pas ṇit yin min rtsi mi dgos/ /ma'i srog phyis drangs/ si rnam bcad/ grā mī ṇaḥ/ ༈grā ma ṇ+ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ ma'i a phyis/ drangs/ si grā myaḥ/ ༈sa dh+raya' ya btags yin ya min/ ts ī na/ dha'i ya btags ni tshig phrad kyi sgrub pas/ ī ring por 'gyur/ ts yig rkyen gyi ī la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ sa dh+rī tsi naḥ/ mthun pa'i grogs po/ ༈sa mya ts ī na/ tshig phrad kyis/ ya btags ī ru bsgyur/ ts drangs/ si/ sa mī tsī naḥ/ dngos po bzang mo'am mdog dbyibs legs pa'o/ /tir+ya ts ī na/ tshig phrad kyis r+ya zhes pa rash zhes bsgyur/ ts ī la drangs/ sh ts la drangs/ si ti rash+tsī naḥ/ dud 'gro rnams 'ongs zhes pa'o/ ༈ya lo pash+tsa/ ya dbyi ba'ang ngo*/ /ka n+ya gyi sgra la sogs pa mang po zhig la/ u pa dhā la ya yig yod na dbyi bar bya ste/ 'di la yaṭ ster dgos pas/ ka n+ya yaṭ ngasi/ dzā ta si/ ya as/ 'dra ring*/ s rnam bcad/ si rnam bcad/ ka n+ya yāḥdzā taḥ/ bu mo las skyes pa zhes pa ste/ bu mo gzhon nu ma khyo med kyi nal bu'o/ /don de la ka n+ya ī na/ ṇi t kyi ming can la dang por 'phel ba dang*/ ya dbyi ba'ang ngo zhes/ mdo 'dis na'i ya btags phyis/ i a'i dbyi/ rkyen la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ kā nī naḥ/ ༈pu ṣ+yaṭā yuk+tasi/ 'di pho rtags yin pas/ ṭā i na/ pu ṣ+ye ṇa yuk+taḥ/ skar ma rgyal dang 'dus pa ste/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i don yin/ don de la/ pu ṣ+ya aṇ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ mdo 'dis ya btags phyis/ i a dbyi/ rkyen gyi a la drangs/ si/ pau ṣaḥ/ rgyal gyi zla ba rang gi ming yin/ ༈yang po ṣa/ mo rtags kyi rkyen īp sbyin/ pau ṣa īp p rjes 'brel/ i a dbyi/ drangs pas/ pau ṣī/ zhes pa grub ste/ rgyal gyis nya ba ste/

rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs te yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga pa'o/ ༈ /yang mo rtags kyi rkyen īp spangs te/ de phan gyi ī na byin na/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs na ṇa si/ pau ṣī ṇa/ rgyal gyis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ pur+ṇa mā sa la/ aṇ sbyin pas/ paur+ṇa mā sa/ de la īp gyi rkyen sbyar bas/ paur+ṇa mā sī/ zla ba nya gang ba'am zla ba rdzogs pa ste/ yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga pa'o/ ༈'dir 'phros don nyer mkho bshad na/ ma ghā ṭā yuk+tasi/ 'di mo rtags āp mtha' yin pas rtags mtha' e/ e ay/ ma gha yā yuk+taḥ/ zhes tshig sbyor ro/ /rnam dbye'i rjes sogs phyis ma ghā aṇ/ dang por 'phel ba/ rtags mtha'i srog phyis/ drangs/ si mā ghaḥ/ mchu'i zla ba/ ༈mā gha īp/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ drangs/ mā ghī/ yang na ī na byin/ ma ghī naḥ/ mchus nya ba'i tshes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ phalgu ṇa la yang tshig sbyaur de dang 'dra/ aṇ sbyar bas/ phālguṇa/ dbo'i zla ba/ ༈de la īp sbyar bas/ phālgu ṇī/ ī na byin na/ phālgu ṇī na/ dbo yis nya ba'o/ ༈de kho na ltar/ tsi tra aṇ/ tsai tra/ nag pa'i zla ba'o/ tsai tra īp/ tsai trī/ yang na ī na/ tsai trī ṇa/ nag pas nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi shā khā aṇ/ bai shā kha/ sa ga'i zla ba'o/ ༈bai shā kha īp/ bai shā khī/ yang na/ ī na/ bai shā khī na/ sa gas nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ dzeṣ+ṭha aṇ/ dzaiṣ+ṭha/ snron gyi zla ba'o/ ༈dzeṣ+ṭha.īp/ dzaiṣ+ṭhī/ yang na/ ī na/ dzaiṣ+ṭhī na/ snron gyis nya ba'i tshes so/ ༈chu stod sogs zla ba gsum gyi ming*/ rgyal dang 'dra bar pho rtags yin/ tshig sbyor gyi skabs su/ ṭā i na byed/ gzhan 'dra ste/ a ṣā ḍha aṇ/ ā ṣā ḍha/ chu stod kyi zla ba'o/ ༈ā ṣā ḍha īp/ ā ṣā ḍhī/ yang na/ ī na/ ā ṣā ḍhi na/ chu stod kyis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ shrā ba ṇa/ aṇ/ shrā ba ṇa/ gro bzhin zla ba'o/ ༈shrā ba ṇa/ īp/ shrā ba ṇī/ yang na ī na/ shrā ba ṇī na/

gro bzhin gyis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ bha dra pa da/ aṇ/ bhā dra pa da/ khrums stod kyi zla ba'o/ /bhā dra pa da īp/ bhā dra pa dī/ yang na/ ī na/ bhā dra pa dī na/ khrums stod kyis nya ba'i tshes so/ ༈tha skar gyi skad dod/ a shwi nī/ zhes pas mo rtags īp mtha' yin pas/ tshig sbyor gyi skabs/ rtags mtha'i ī ni y ru bsgyur/ ṭā'i ā la drangs pas/ ashi n+yā yuk+taḥ/ zhes pa dgos/ a shwī nī aṇ/ dang por 'phel ba/ rtags mtha'i ī ring po phyis/ drangs/ ā shwi na/ tha skar gyi zla ba'o/ /༈ā shwi na/ īp/ ā shwi nī/ yang na/ ī na/ ā shwi nī na/ tha skar gyis nya ba'o/ ༈kṛ ti kā mo rtags te tshig sbyor ma ghā'i skabs dang 'dra/ kṛ ti kā aṇ/ kārti ka/ smin drug gi zla ba'o/ ༈kārti kā/ īp/ kārti kī/ yang na/ ī na/ kārtikī na/ smin drug gis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ mṛ ga shi ra/ 'di pho rtags yin/ tshig sbyor rgyal gyi skabs dang 'dra/ mṛ ga shi ra aṇ/ mārga shi ra/ mgo'i zla ba'o/ ༈mārga shi ra īp/ mārga shi rī/ yang na/ ī na/ mārga shi rī na/ mgo yis nya ba'i tshes so/ zla ba dang tshes kyi rtags mthar/ si rnam bcad sogs rnam dbye sbyar na bya ba rdzogs pa yin la/ zla ba'i skad dod kyi mthar/ īp dang ī na ster ba'i sngon du/ rnam dbye'i rjes yod na phyis aṇ gyi rjes yod yod pa de ka la ster dgos te/ nya ba'i tshes ni zla ba de nyid kyi nang sel yin pas so/ /'on kyang skabs 'di'i i a dbyi ba de ni/ aṇ gyi a dbyi ba de nyid yin mod kyi/ ī yi rkyen dang sbyar bas aṇ gyi dod thub ī rkyen gnyis po ṇ rjes 'brel ma yin kyang*/ dang po'i 'phel ba ma nyams par gnas so/ /de yan chad kyis ka dang ī na 'phros don dang bcas pa song*/ ༈ī ya'i rkyen gyi bya ba mtshon byed ni/ k+ṣa tra ī ya/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si/ k+ṣa trī yaḥ/

yang na aṇ byin/ dang por 'phel ba/ gzhan 'dra/ k+ṣā traḥ/ gdugs dang ldan pa'am/ dpa' bos bskor ba zhes bya ste rgyal po'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ shu kra ngi bha ba shu kre bha ba/ ngi sogs dbyi/ shu kra ī ya/ si am/ shu krī yaṃ/ a ṇa ྄sbyar na/ si rnam bcad/ shau kraḥ/ ༈in+d+ra ī ya/ in+d+rī yaṃ/ aṇ sbyar na/ ain+d+raḥ/ dbang po'i tshogs pa'o/ ༈i ka'i rkyen gyi bya ba ni/ ak+ṣabhis/ ngi bya te/ ak+ṣairdi bya te/ bhis sogs phyis/ ak+ṣa ai ka thog mar 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ā k+ṣa kaḥ/ rab tu gsal ba'i mig go ༈shab+da ngi bha ba/ shab+de bha ba/ ngi sogs phyis/ shab+da i ka/ 'phel ba/ mtha' phyis/ drangs/ si/ shāb+di kaḥ/ sgra'i nang nas zhes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ be da ngi bha baḥ/ be de bha baḥ ste rig byed kyi khongs nas 'byung ba'o/ /'byung ba'i don la i ka ste/ be da i ka gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ bai di kaḥ༈tarke bha ba/ rtog ge'i nang na yod pa zhes tshig tu sbyar ba yin/ tarka.i ka gong bzhin/ tarki kaḥ/ ༈ t+ya ta nau/ t+ya dang ta na dag go /kim la sogs pa dang*/ ad+ya la sogs pa rnams la sngar bshad pa ltar gyi 'byung ba la sogs pa'i don du/ t+ya gyi rkyen dang tan'i rkyen ster te/ kim 'gyur ba'i/ ku tra la/ t+ya sbyar bas/ ku tra t+yaḥsi rnam bcad/ ༈ku taḥl t+ya sbyar bas rnam bcad kyi s ta la drangs pas/ ku tas+t+yaḥsi rnam bcad/ ci yang rung ba la zhes pa'o/ ༈ta tra la/ t+ya sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ ta tra t+yaḥ/ der de la zhes so/ ༈a d+ya la/ ta na sbyar si/ a d+ya ta naḥ/ de ring byung ba/ ༈sa dā la/ ta na sbyar bas/ sa dā ta naḥ/ rtag tu byung ba/ ༈h+yaḥl ta na sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ s drangs/ h+yasta naḥ/ kha sang zhes pa'o/ ༈swār+the pi/ rang gi don la yang ngo*/ /sems can du gtogs pa'i skyes bu rang so so'i dngos po brjod pa la/ rang gi don zhes bya ste/ de la'ang sngar bshad pa'i rkyen de dag ci rigs par 'jug go /dpen na/

de ba dat+ta si e ba bzhagasi phyis/ de ba dat+ta e ba/ lha sbyin 'di'o zhes sam/ 'di ni lha sbyin no/ /zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /de ba dat+ta ka dang por 'phel ba/ si rnam bcad/ dai ba dat+ta kaḥ/ ༈tsa twā ra bar+ṇa e ba/ rigs bzhi po 'di rnams zhes pa ste/ de'i don la/ tsaturbar+ṇa ṇ+ya/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si am/ tsā turbar+ṇ+yaṃ/ ༈tso ra/ e ba/ rkun mo 'di zhes pa'i don/ tso ra aṇ/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ tsau raḥ/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ aṇ ī na dag gi yuṣ+mad asmad dag ta ba ka la sogs pa'o/ / zhes 'byung bas tshur rol yuṣ+mad dang asmad la/ pha rol aṇ dang ī na'i rkyen gang byung yang*/ yuṣ+mad ta ba ka dang*/ yuṣ+ma ka gang rung du 'gyur la/ asmad ma ma ka dang*/ asma ka gang rung du 'gyur/ zhes pa ste/ ༈yuṣ+mad dang*/ asmad kyi pha rol tu/ aṇ re re bzhagayuṣ+mad ta ba ka dang*/ asmad ma ma kar bsgyur/ gnyis ka la dang por 'phel ba dang*/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si am/ ༈tā ba kaṃ/ ༈mā ma kaṃ ༈yang īn byin na yang sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra bas/ tā ba kī naḥ/ ༈mā ma kī naḥ/ ༈yang*/ yuṣ+mad kyi rnam 'gyur yu ba yo dang*/ asmad kyi rnam 'gyur/ ā ba yo la so sor aṇ re re bzhagayuṣ+mad/ yuṣ+māka dang*/ asmad asmā ka ru bsgyur/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ༈yauṣ+ma kaḥ/ ༈āsmā kaḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ yu ba yo dang*/ a ba yo la/ ī na byin/ sgrub tshul snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈yaush+mā kī na/ ༈āsmā kī naḥ/ ༈bat+tu l+ye/ bt mnyam pa la'o/ /mnyam pa ste phan tshun 'dra ba'i don la/ rkyen bt sbyor ba yin te/ dper brjod na/ tsan+d+re ṇa sa dṛ shaṃ mu khaṃ/ zla ba dang mtshungs pa'i gdong zhes pa ste tshig sbyor ro/ /tsan+d+ra ba ta rkyen du byin/ /mthar mu kha bzhag go /bt kyi td d nr bsgyur/ drangs/ si am/ tsan+d+ra ban+mu khaṃ/ zla ba 'dra ba'i gdong ngo*/
