༈de bzhin du/ gha ṭe na sa dṛ shaṃ u da ri/ bum pa dang 'dra ba'i lto ba/ zhes pa ste de'i don la/ i na dang sa dṛ shaṃ phyis te/ bt rkyen du byin/ t d ru bsgyur/ drangs pas/ bha ṭa ba du da raṃ/ ༈bhā be ta twa yaṇ/ gyur pa la ta twa yaṇ'o/ rgya skad du bhā ba zhes pa skabs thob kyi don mang po la 'jug kyang*/ 'dir gyur pa zhes pa mtshan nyid kyi don no/ /yang rang bzhin du yod par gyur pa'am khyad chos su yod par gyur pa'i don te/ tsha bar 'gyur pa me/ gsher bar 'gyur pa chu/ zhes pa dang*/ nog lkog shal can du yod pa ba lang*/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar na mtshan nyid kyi don la/ rkyen ta dang twa dang yaṇ rnams 'jug go ༈brāh+ma ṇa s+ya bhā ba/ bram ze la yod pa'am/ bram ze'i mtshan nyid de/ tshangs skud can mthong ste/ bram zer 'dug ces pa lta bu'o/ /prāh+ma ṇa rkyen ta sbyar/ āp byin/ mtshungs 'dra/ prāh+ma tā bram zer gyur pa'am/ bram zer 'dug ces pa'o/ de yang ta mtha'i rtag tu bud med kyi rtags so/ /zhes pas rkyen ta yig la bud med kyi āp ster dgos/ ༈twa yaṇ ma ning nyid do/ /zhes pas rkyen de gnyis byin na ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur/ brāh+ma ṇa la rkyen twa sbyar/ si am/ brāh+ma ṇa twaṃ/ ༈brāh+ma ṇa la rkyen yaṇ byin/ ṇ rjes 'grel/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si am/ brāh+ma ṇ+yaṃ/ ༈de bzhin du/ su ma nas/ yaṇ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si am/ sau ma na s+yaṃ/ ༈de bzhin du/ su bha ga yaṇ/ sau bha gyaṃ/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi du ṣa yaṇ/ bai du ṣ+yaṃ/ ༈yang 'grel bar/ mnyam par tshogs pa la ta yi yon tan yang ngo*/ /zhes bshad pas/ tri ām/ sa mā hā ra/ de la nuṭ byin/ i ay ru bsgyur/ tra yā ṇāṃ sa mā hā ra/ gsum po rnams mnyam par tshogs pa/ zhes pa ste/ rig byed gsum mam/ me gsum mam/ yon tan gsum tshogs pa lta bu ste/ gang ci yang rung ba gsum tshogs pa'o/

/rnam dbye sogs phyis pas tri ru log/de la rkyen ta yig sbyar/ bud med kyi āp byin pa na/ mnyam 'dus kyi don yin pas/ rkyen tā ring po'i nus pa la/ tri'i i yig ni yon tan e yig tu 'gyur ro/ /tre tā ces pa grub/ bod skad du/ gsum tshogs pa ste/ gsum ldan gyi dus la/ tre tā yu ga zer ba bzhin no/ ༈de bzhin du/ dza na nuṭ ām/ sa mā hā ra/ /si de dag sbyar bas/ dza nā nāṃ sa mā hā raṃ/ skyes bo mang po rnams mnyam par 'dus pa/ zhes pa'o/ /tshig gi sbyor ba de'i don la dza na la ta'i rkyen sbyar/ mo rtags kyi rkyen āp/ dza na tā zhes pa grub/ a thung gi yon tan ni a thung yin pas rnam 'gyur med do/ ༈yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ las rnams la yang yaṇ'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ brāh+ma ṇa s+ya karman si/ zhes pa bzhagasi dang rtags mtha'i n phyis/ bram ze'i las zhes pa'o/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis/ brah+ma ṇa la yaṇ byin/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si am/ brāh+maṇ+yaṃ/ ༈yang rā dz+nya i dm karma/ rgyal po'i las 'di zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /de rnams phyis te/ rā dzan yaṇ/ cha gnyis bzhag/n yi yang na'o zhes pas/ lugs gcig la n srog med dza'i srog a dang bcas pa phyis/ dz ya la drangs/ si rā dz+yaṃ/ ༈lugs cig shos la n dbyangs med ya la drangs/ gzhan 'dra/ rā dza n+yaṃ/ ༈lo hi tā de r+ḍi di mn/ lo hi ta la sogs pa'i i mn ni ḍit to/ /lo hi ta la sogs pa'i rtags la mtshan nyid du rkyen i mn ster te/ i mn la ḍit kyi tha snyad 'jog cing*/ ḍit ces btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ ṭi dbyi ba'i phyir ro/ /lo hi ta s+ya bha ba/ dmar po'i mtshan nyid te/ dmar po rang la yod pa'i ngang tshur te mtshan nyid don chos la 'jog pa dang go ba gcig go /lo hi ta/ i mn ṭi phyis/ ta i la drangs/ si/ u ba dhā ring po/ si phyis/ na yang phyis te/ lo hi ti mā/ ༈de bzhin du/ a ṇu ngas bha ba si nga ldan la u o/

ngas kyi a phyis/ s rnam bcad/ r drangs/ a ṇor+bha baḥ/ phra mo'i mtshan nyid ces pa'i don la/ a ṇu i mn ḍi ta la ṭi/ drangs/ si/ u pa dhā/ si dang mtha'i n phyis/ a ṇi mā/ ༈ṛ ra i ma ṇi/ ṛ'i ra i mn la'o/ ṛ yig dang por yod pa'i rtag la i mn gyi rkyen sbyar na/ ṛ yig ni ra srog ldan du 'gyur ro/ ༈pṛ thu ngas bha ba/ pṛ thor+bha ba/ rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid/ ces so/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis nas/ pṛ thu i mn bzhag pa'i srog gi ṛ phral/ ṛ ra srog ldan/ p dbyangs med ra la drangs/ ṭi phyis/ mthar si/ n'i u pa dhā si dang na phyis/ pra thi mā/ ༈dṛ ḍhi i mn/ dra ḍhi mā/ brtan pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya/ de bzhin du/ mṛ du i mn/ mra di mā/ 'jam po'i rang bzhin zhes so/ ༈ba ho rlo po bhū tsa ba hoḥ/ ba hu yi ba hu las dbyi zhing bhu yang ngo*/ /ba hu'i sgra la pha rol tu i mn gyi rkyen byung na/ rkyen gyi i yig mi snang bar 'gyur zhing*/ ba hu nyid yongs rdzogs bhū ring por bsgyur ba yin no/ 'grel par ba hu'i phyi ma rnams kyi zhes dang/ i mn la sogs pa'i zhes 'byung bas/ i man du ma zad rkyen du ma la yang ngo*/ ༈de yang*/ ba hu i mn zhes pa bzhag go /ba hu'i nus pas rkyen gyi a phyis/ de'i nus pas ba hu zhes pa bhu ring por bsgyur/ mthar si/ u pa dhā ring bo/ rnam dbye dang ṇ phyis pas/ bhu mā/ mang po rnams kyi mtshan nyid ces bya'o/ ༈'grel bar/ ba hu'i gnas su zhes 'byung ba ni/ ba hu phyis nas de'i shul du bhu bzhag ces pa'i don no/ /a s+t+yar+the ma tup/ yod pa'i don la ma tup'o/ gang gi'am gang la yod pa de'i don la/ ma tu p kyi rkyen ster ba yin no/ /p rjes 'brel/ u yig ni num ster dgos pa'i don yin/ go ma tup/ p rjes 'brel/ u dgos don/ u dang ṛ dag gi num mo/ zhes pas ma dang t'i bar du num ā ga ma byin/

go mn tra si zhes pa byung*/ a tu dang sa'i si la'o zhes pas mā ring por bsgyur/ si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' las t yang phyis/ go mān/ zhes pa grub/ de'i don ni tshig sbyar ba la/ go a s+ya e ste i ti/ 'di'i ba lang yod pa nyid do zhes pa ste/ lha sbyin gyi ba lang yod zhes pa lta bu/ bdag po dang 'brel ba yod pa dang*/ lhas na ba lang yod ces pa lta bu gnas gzhi'i don gnyis ka ston to/ skabs don so so'i dbang gis so/ /ba lang 'di zhes pa ni mngon gyur gyi sgra yin/ ba lang yang yin 'di yang yin pas gzhi mthun bsdu ba yin no/ ༈yang go ma tup/ p rjes 'brel/ u rtags don/ go ma ta/ i k sbyin/ k rjes 'brel/ drangs/ go ma ti/ don snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈de bzhin du/ shrī a s+ya astī ti/ zhes pa'am/ shrī bi d+ya te ya s+ya dpal yod pa gang gi zhes pa'am/ gang la yod pa'i dpal zhes pa'o/ /de'i don la/ shrī ma tup bzhaganum mā ring po si phyis/ shrī mān ta/ rab sbyor mtha' la t yang phyis te/ shrī mān/ ༈yang na shrī dang*/ ma tup/ bzhagashrī mat du song*/ īk k rjes 'brel/ shrī ma tī/ ༈a i kau ma twar+the/ ma tu'i don la a dang i ka dag go /'dir ma tu'i don zhes pa/ ma tu dang dgos don gcig pa'i don te/ gong bzhin yod pa'i don nyid la sbyor ro/ ༈bai dza yan+ti bid+ya ti ya s+ya/ do shal yod pa gang gi'am gang la zhes pa'o/ /bai dza yin+ta a zhes pa bzhaga.i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ bai dza yan+taḥ/ ༈yang mā ya ika yang i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ mā yi kaḥ/ sgyu ma can yod ces sam/ nor can yod ces pa'o/ ༈mān+to pa dhā dwa twi nau/ mā dang a'i mtha'i u pa dhā las ba ta i n dag go ma yig mtha' can dang*/ ma yig u pa dhā yod pa dang*/ a yig mtha' can dang*/ a yig u pa dhā yod pa ste/ rtags mtha' bzhi po de la ba tu dang*/ in'i rkyen ster te/ 'dir ba tu zhes pa u ni gong bzhin num ster ba'i don yin pas phyis te/

rkyen bt nyid do/ /rkyen 'di dag kyang yod pa'i don nyid te/ ༈dper brjod na/ bha go bi d+ya te ya s+ya/ skal ba yod pa gang la zhes pa ste/ ga'i na ro ni si rnam bcad u'i rjes yin no/ /na ro sogs phyis te/ bha ga ba t zhes bzhagab dang ta'i? bar du num bā ring po/ si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' t yang phyis/ bha ga bān grub/ bcom ldan nam/ skal ldan nam/ legs ldan te/ a mtha' la rkyen bt ster pa'i dper brjod do/ ༈de bzhin du/ dha na bit+ya te ya s+ya/ gang la nor yod pa zhes bya'o/ /dha na in/ i a phyis/ dha nin/ si nī ring po/ si phyis nā mi'i mtha' la n phyis/ dha nī/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ k+ṣā trī/ daṇ+ḍī/ kāmī/ da mī sogs kyang sgrub tshul de khas sgrub/ ༈sha ma si bi t+ya te ya s+ya/ si rnam bcad/ u rtags mtha' o/ sha mo bi d+ya te ya s+ya/ gang la zhi ba'i ngang tshul yod pa zhes so/ /na ro man chad phyis te/ sha ma la in byin no/ /sha ma in/ i a phyis/ drangs/ sha min/ mthar si/ u pa dhā ring po/ si phyis/ nā mi'i mtha' las n yang phyis/ sha mī zhes pa ste/ a mtha' la rkyen in ster ba'i dpe'o/ ༈yang dṛ ṣa ṭ pha rol du/ ba t ṭ da ྄ ru song*/ ba la drangs/ mo rtags kyi rkyen īp byin/ ta dbyangs med ī ring po la drangs/ dṛ ṣa dwa tī/ sa gzhi yod pa'o/ /'di ni a u pa dhā yod pa la/ rkyen bt phyin pa'i dpe yin/ ༈kim bt zhes pa bzhagasi/ ba dang t'i bar du num/ u pa dhā ring po/ si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' la ta/ ki m+bān/ m yig mtha' can gyi dpe'o/ ༈yang lak+ṣ+mī ba tra si? num/ u ba dhā ring*/ si dang rab sbyor mtha' phyis/ lak+ṣ+mī bān/ ma u pa dhā'i dpe'o/ ༈ta ḍi dā di bh+yash+tsa/ ta ḍi t la sogs pa rnams las kyang ngo*/ /ta ḍi t la sogs pa'i sgra la yang*/ ba t dang i na'i sgra sngar bzhin 'jug go /ta ḍi t ba t t ba la drangs pas/ ta ḍi twa t/

si nu sogs sngar bzhin/ ta ḍi twā n/ rlung ngam dbang po yod ces so/ /de bzhin du/ ma ru t ba t/ ma ru twa t/ si nu sogs sngar bzhin/ ma ru twān/ rlung yod pa'o/ ༈e tat kim yad tad rnams las so/ /zhes 'byung bas/ tshad ston pa'am sa mtshams gcod pa'i don la/ e tat la sogs pa bzhi pa de rnams la/ bt kyi rkyen sbyin par bya ste/ yat+ta do rā/ yad tad dag la ā'o/ yad dang tad kyi mthar bt kyi rkyen byin pa na/ ṭi ste rtags mtha' ni ā yig ring por 'gyur ro/ ༈yad bt de tsam zhes pa bzhagayad kyi srog dang mtha' brten ta sbrags pa ā ring bor bsgyur/ si num sogs sngar bzhin sbyar bas/ yā zhes so bān gang tsam/ ༈tad bta ྄tad kyi ṭi ā ring por gyur/ si num sogs sbyar ba sngar bzhin/ tā bān de tsam/ ༈kimaḥkir+yash+tsa/ kim ni ki ste ya yang ngo*/ /kim gyi sgra la bt kyi rkyen sbyar ba na/ kim nyid ki ru bsgyur ba dang*/ rkyen bt kyi ba yig ni ya yig tu 'gyur ro/ /kim bt kim ni rkyen bt mthong bas ki zhes par/ bsgyur zhing*/ de mthong bas bta ྄kyi ba ya yig tu bsgyur/ ki ya t zhes pa byung*/ de la si nu sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ ki mān/ ci tsam pa'o/ ༈ā ish+tsai ta do bā/ ā dang i'ang e tat dag la'ang na'o/ /e tat kyi sgra la ni/ bt kyi rkyen byin na/ yang na ṭi ni ā ring por bsgyur ba dang*/ yang na i ru bsgyur ba yin la/ ā dang i'ang zhes pa'i 'ang gi sgras ṭi kho na ai yig tu bsgyur ba ma yin gyi/ e tat yongs su rdzogs pa ir bsgyur ba dang*/ rkyen gyi ba ya yig tu bsgyur ba'ang yin no/ ༈e tat bt zhes pa tshar gnyis bzhagagacig gi ṭi ā ring bor bsgyur bas/ e tā bt byung*/ de la si num sogs sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ e tā bān/ ༈cig shos la e tat zhes pa i ru bsgyur/ rkyen gyi ba ya ru song*/

i yat ces pa byung*/ si num sogs sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ i yān zhes pa'o/ ༈tun dā de ri laḥ/ tun+da sogs la i la'o/ /tun+do a s+ya asti/ 'di yi lte ba yod pa zhes bya ba ste/ yod pa'i don ni dngos po'o/ /yang tun+da bya ma tshur bsgyur ba'ang yod/ do zhes pa si'i rjes so/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis te/ tun+da la i la zhes pa rkyen bzhaga.i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ tun+di laḥ/ ༈tun+da la sogs pa'i khongs na/ spyir mang po yod mod kyang*/ 'dir dper brjod ni/ ud ra'i sgra ste/ ud ro as+ya asti/ 'di yi gsus pa'i dngos po zhes so/ /u da ra i la/ ra'i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ u da ri laḥ/ ༈aun+na t+ye dan+tā du raḥ/ aun+na dan+tā las u r'o/ 'dir un+na ni mtho ba/ dan+ta ni so ste/ aun+na te dan+ta ni/ ches mtho ba'i so ste/ so ring zhing sbom pa'o/ tshig sbyor ni de kho na yin mong*/ yang un+na dzas/ dan+da dzas/ a s+ya bzhaga.un+nāḥdan+tāḥ.a s+ya/ 'di'i so mtho ba zhes pa'ang yod do/ /de rjes dan+ta la ur gyi rkyen byin/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si/ dan+turaḥ/ ༈shrad+dhā derluḥ/ shrad+dhā la sogs pa la lu'o/ shrad+dhā bi d+ya te ya s+ya/ dad pa dang ldan pa gang gi zhes pa'o/ /shrad+dhā ces pa li rkyen lu sbyar/ si/ shrad+dhā luḥ/ tshig sbyor dang sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra ba las/ ༈ni drā luḥ/ gnyis dang ldan pa/ ༈kṛ pā luḥ/ brtse ba dang ldan pa/ ༈lungs drangs pa/ as mā yā me dhā srak rnams las yod pa'i don la bin'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ as kyi mtha' can dang*/ mā yā dang*/ me dhā dang*/ /srak ces pa'i sgra rnams la yod pa dngos po'i don du/ rkyen bin thob pa yin te/ ༈de yang*/ ta pa la as byin/ i a phyis sbyar bas/ ta bs/ zhes pa byung*/ tshig sbyar ba'am ngag ni shrad+dhā dang 'dra/ ta bs/ bin s dbyangs med pa la drangs/ si/ n'i u pa dhā ring po/ nā mi'i mthar n dang si phyis/

ta ba swī/ dka' thub can nam sdom ldan no/ ༈de bzhin du/ mā yā la bin rkyen du byin/ si/ u pa dhā ring*/ n dang si phyis/ mā yā bī/ sgyu ma can nam 'byor pa can no/ ༈me dhā la yang sgrub tshul de kho nas/ me dhā bī ste blo gros can no/ ༈srak la yang de dang 'dra ba las/ pha rol dza ba mthong ba'i nus pas/ kg ru bsgyur/ ba yi steng du drangs/ de nas si sbyin/ srag+bī/ 'phreng ba dang ldan pa'o/ ༈bā tso g+mi niḥ/ bā tsa la g+mi ni'o/ bāts'i sgra la dngos po'i don du rkyen g+mi ni 'jug ste/ bāts g+mi ni zhes pa bzhagarkyen gyi g yig ni rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ na'i i yang rjes 'brel dbyi/ bātsa ྄min zhes pa byung*/ ts ni pha rol ma yig mthong bas k ru gyur/ k g ru song*/ rkyen gyi ma'i steng du drangs/ bāg min sin yi u pa dhā/ si dang n phyis/ bā g+mī/ smra brjod can no/ ༈ā lā ṭau kut+si ta bhā ṣī ṇī/ ngan pa'i tshig smra ba la ā la āṭ dag go /bā tsa zhes pa la ā la zhes pa'i rkyen sbyar/ si rnam bcad*/ bā tsā laḥ/ smra ba ngan pa can te rdzun chen po/ ༈yang bāts zhes pa la rkyen ā ṭa sbyar ba yang*/ bā tsā ṭaḥ/ ces te don dang sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra'o/ ༈ī ṣa da pa ri sa mā bhau kalpa de sh+ya de shī yāḥ/ yongs su rdzogs par ma tshang ba la/ kalpa de sh+ya de shi ya rnams so/ /klog pa la sogs pa dgos pa'i bya ba gang yin de phal cher yongs su rdzogs zin/ lhag ma cung zad ma tshang ba'i bya ba dang ldan pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i don la/ rkyen kalpa zhes pa dang*/ de sh+ya dang*/ de shī ya rnams 'jug go ī ṣaṭ a pa ri sa māp+taḥsarba dz+nyaḥ/ ṭ ḍ ḍ d ru song*/ drangs pas/ ī ṣa da 'ong*/ yongs su rdzogs pa las cung zad ma tshang ba'i thams cad shes/ zhes pa ni ngag go /ī ṣa sogs phyis/ sarba dz+nya bzhag ste/ kalpa zhes pa'i rkyen dang sbyar/ si/ sarba dz+nya kalpaḥ/

༈de bzhin du/ tshig sbyor 'god pa'i skabs/ yang pa ṭu ī ṣaṭ un zhes pa'o/ /pa ṭu la rkyen de sh+ya sbyar/ si pa ṭu de sh+yaḥ/ cha shas tsam nyams shing phal cher la mkhas pa'i don no/ ༈yang pa ṭu'i tshab tu ka bi ste ngag go /ka bi la de shī ya sbyar si ka bi de shī yaḥ/ ma rdzogs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan no/ ༈prā shaṃ sā yāṃ rū paḥ/ kha bsgyur ba la rū pa'o/ /mi mkhas pa la mkhas par rdzus pa la sogs pa/ yon tan dang mi ldan pa yon tan dang ldan par 'chos pa/ dper na rtog ge'i gzhung lugs klog dang byas pa tsam la/ rtog ge par khas 'che ba dang*/ gzhung tshigs bcad gcig kho na shes pa la gzhung rdzogs par shes so zhes rdzu ba ni kha bsgyur ba ste/ 'dir pra sha stau bai yā ka ra ṇoḥ rdzus ma'i brda sprod mkhan po zhes bya'o/ /de'i don la/ bai yā ka ra ṇa la/ rkyen rū pa sbyar/ si/ bai yā ka ra ṇa rū paḥ/ ༈kut+sa yaṃ pā shaḥ smra ba ngan pa la pā sha'o/ /kut+si to bai yā ka ra ṇo/ brda sprod pa rdzun du smra ba zhes pa'o/ /bai yā ka ra ṇa la pā sha sbyar/ si bai yā ka ra ṇa pā shaḥ/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ kut+si to a bhi ṣak/ smra ba ngan pa tshig rtsub can no/ a bhi ṣak la pā sha sbyar si a bhi ṣak+pā shaḥ/ ༈kut+si to bai yā ka ra ṇo ba hu/ brda sprod pa tshig ngan smra ba mang po'o/ /ba hu la pā sha sbyar/ si/ bā hu pā shaḥ/ ༈bhu ta purbe tsa ra ṭ/ sngon dus shes pa la tsa ra ṭ'o/ /purbaṃ dṛṣ+ta bi d+ya te ya s+ya/ sngon dus shes pa gang la yod pa zhes pa'o/ /dṛṣ+ta tsa ra ṭ ṭ rjes 'brel/ si rnam bcad/ dṛṣ+ti tsa raḥ/ ༈prā tsur+ya bi kā ra pra dhā n+yā di ṣu ma yaṭ/ spyi bungs dang*/ rnam 'gyur dang*/ rang dbang du byed pa sogs rnams la ma yaṭ'o/ /nang bar ston mo byed rgyu'i zas spyi spungs mtshan mo g.yos pa dang*/ rdza so gtong ba sogs bzo'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ gzhan gyi ngag la rag ma lus par bya ba rang blos byed pa'i gtso bo la sogs pa rnams kyi don la/

rkyen ma yaṭ 'jug go /an+na ma prā tsa ra ba smin ya dz+nye/ lha mchod kyi zas spyi spungs 'di la zhes so/ ༈an+na zhes pa la rkyen ma yaṭ sbyar/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ si rnam bcad/ mthar ya dz+nya zhes pa bzhaga.an+na ma yo ya dz+nya/ mchod sbyin gyi zas btsos pa'i spyi bungs zhes so/ ༈yang mṛ ta bi ka ra gha ṭ/ sa'i rnam 'gyur bum pa zhes so/ /mṛt la rkyen ma yaṭ/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ t srog med ni ma mthong bas nr song*/ drangs/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ mṛn+ma yo gha ṭaḥ/ ༈s+t+ri pra dhā n+ya ma s+ya s+t+rī ti/ khyim bdag mo bud med 'di yod pa'o/ zhes so/ /s+t+rī ces pa la rkyen ma yaṭ byin/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ si rnam bcad/ mthar dzāl+ma si bzhag /s+t+rī ma yo dzāl+maḥ/ zhes pa ste/ dzāl+maḥbud med rang thag gcod mkhan gyi don yin la/ ma yaṭ kyi rjes ma yo zhes pa kho na/ spyi bungs dang*/ rnam 'gyur dang*/ las yod kha shed can ma rnams la skabs thob dang tshig grogs tha dad pa'i dbang gis so sor 'jug go ༈yang pūr+ṇe na a mṛ ta tsan+d+raḥ/ gang ba'i zla bas bdud rtsi spro/ zhes pa ste/ ngag go /a mṛ ta la ma yaṭ/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ a mṛ ta ma yaḥ/ zhes 'byung*/ amṛ ta ma yash+tsan+d+raḥ/ zhes so/ skabs 'dir/ de rig byed kyang klog pa de la 'dir aṇ'o/ /zhes bshad do/ zhes 'grel bar lung drangs te/ de yang gong du dper brjod la/ bai yā ka ra ṇa zhes lan mang du byung ba de la 'phros don brjod pa ste/ de yang brda sprod shes par ma zad rig byed kyang bklags shing shes pa la khyad par mchog gi don du aṇ gyi rkyen ster dgos zhes pa'o/ /de la byā ka ra ṇaṃ a dhī te be ta be ti bā/ brda sprod la bklags shing rig byed kyang rig pa/ zhes pa ste ngag bkod pa'o/ /na san+dhi y+bor+yuṭ tsa/ ma yin te mtshams sbyor gyi y b dag i uṭ kyang ngo*/ /de la dper mtshon na/ byā ka ra ṇa'i ming la sgra dang rig byed gnyis ka shes pa'i don du sgrub pa la/

byā ka ra ṇa'i sgra la dang*/ rta bzang po ste/ swa shwaḥ/ zhes pa'i sgra la/ rgyud bzang la dngos su 'gro dang gzugs 'dzom pa'i don du sgrub pa la/ aṇ byin pa'i tshe/ rkyen de byin ma thag dang por 'phel ba byed pa ma yin te/ ā ring po nyid 'phel bar gdod nas grub pa yin gyi gsar du 'phel ba byar med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thog mar yi ge rab sbyor rab tu phye zhing phral/ de nas yi ge i yig gam u yig yod pa'i i y dang u br bsgyur ba'i mtshams sbyor byed/ de rjes ā ga ma ster te y yin na sngon du iṭ dang*/ b yin na sngon du uṭ ster/ de'i rjes su aṇ gyi ṇ rjes 'brel gyi nus pa las/ dbyangs dang po 'phel ba yang byed do/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ ༈de la byā ka ra ṇa aṇ zhes pa bzhag /'dir byā zhes pa/ bi dang ā rab tu sbyor ba yin pa las/ de gnyis phral zhing phye nas rim pa ma 'chol bar bi gong du bzhag/bi ā ka ra a zhes so/ /bi'i srog gi i ni y dbyangs med/ y'i gong du iṭ ā ga ma bzhag/ṭ rjes 'brel/ b iy ā ka ra ṇa a zhes pa byung*/ de yan chad du 'phel ba mi byed/ skabs 'dir bya ste/ ny ṇ rjes 'brel gyi nus pa las/ dbyangs dang po i ni/ e ka sha can du 'phel ba byed/ so sor drangs pas/ bai yā ka ra ṇa a zhes so/ /i a phyis/ ṇa a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ bai yā ka ra ṇaḥ/ legs par grub/ ༈de dang 'dra bar b yig dang uṭ yi dper brjod ni/ so bha no3shwa/ gzugs dang 'gros gnyis ka phun sum tshogs pa'i rta'o/ /don de nyid la/ a shwa zhes pa'i sngon du/ nyer bsgyur su bzhag de gnyis mtshams sbyar/ mthar si rnam bcad/ rta bzang ngam rta mchog go /swa shwaḥtaṃ be de ti/ rta mchog der rig go /zhes pa rgyud bzang po go ba ste ngag go /de yang swa shwa aṇ zhes pa bzhag /ṇ rjes 'brel/ swa ni su dang a rab sbyor yin pa las/ de gnyis so sor phral te su gong du bzhag

/sa'i srog gi u phral nas b ru bsgyur/ de'i sngon du uṭ bzhag ṭ rjes 'brel/ s u b a shwa a zhes pa byung*/ de yan chad du 'phel ba mi byed/ skabs 'dir bya ste/ ṇ rjes 'brel gyi nus pas/ u ni o kai sha can du bsgyur/ s au dang b a la drangs/ shwa'i srog phyis/ rkyen gyi a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ sau ba shwaḥ/ zhes pa grub ste/ kha cig 'di la bu rgyud kyi don du aṇ byin na/ rta mchog gi rgyud dang*/ dngos po'i don du byin na 'gros gzugs 'dzom pa'i rta zer ba'ang yod tede/ re re la de tsam mi dgos pas/ ngag sbyor gyi skabs las kyang go nus te gnyis ka tshang ba'i don yin no/ ༈i to dzā tār+the/ skyes pa'i don la it dag go /'dir skyes pa ni phyi rol kyi dngos po ma yin te/ ngo tsha skyes pa dang*/ dga' ba skyes pa dang*/ bkres ngal skyes pa sogs sems dang tshor ba'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /don de la i ta'i rkyen ster te/ ladz+dza.i ta i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ladz+dzi taḥ/ ngo tsha skyes pa/ ༈sgrub tshul de kho nas/ tri pa i ta si/ tri pi taḥ/ tshim pa skyes pa/ ༈de bzhin du/ k+ṣu da i ta si k+ṣu di taḥ/ bkres ngal skyes zhes pa'o/ ༈ta ra ta me yaswiṣ+ṭhāḥprakar+ṣe/ ta ra ta ma ī ya su iṣ+ṭha rnams khyad 'phags la'o/ /dngos po khyad par du 'phags pa la phul du byung ba'i don du/ rkyen ta ra dang*/ ta ma dang*/ ī ya su dang*/ iṣ+ṭha zhes pa rnams 'jug ste/ dper na/ a ti sha ye na kṛṣ+ṇaḥ/ ches shin du nag po zhes so/ de'i don du/ kṛṣ+ṇa dang rkyen ta ra bzhagasi rnam bcad/ kṛṣ+ṇa ta raḥ/ ༈a ti sha ye na shuklaḥ/ phul du byung ba'i dkar po'o/ /shukla la rkyen ta ma sbyar si/ shukla ta maḥ/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ ī ya su dang iṣ+ṭha dag ḍit nyid do/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rkyen de gnyis la ḍi t kyi ming 'dogs te/ dgos pa ni ṭi dbyi ba'o/ /ī ya su zhes pa'i sa'i u ni num ā ga ma ster ba'i don te/

ya dang s'i bar du num mo/ /dper brjod ni/ a ti sha ye na la ghuḥ/ ches yang ba'am/ ches nyung ba'i don no/ /la ghu ī ya su/ u dgos don/ la ghu ī yas zhes pa byung*/ ṭi phyis/ gha ī la drangs*/ mthar si/ u dang ri dag gi nu m'o/ zhes pas rkyen gyi ya dang s'i bar du num'o/ n+sa āp m+ta hata kyi dhi min pa la ring po'o/ /zhes pas ya ring por gyur/ ha sa īp sogs kyis si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' la s yang phyis/ la ghī yān/ zhes pa grub bo/ /cho ga de kho nas/ ༈pā pa ī ya su/ pā pī yān/ ches sdig pa can/ zhes so/ ༈mo rtags su sgrub pa la ni/ la ghu ī ya su bzhag u rjes 'brel/ ṭi phyis/ gh drangs/ mthar rkyen īp byin/ pra rjes 'brel/ la ghī ya sī/ shin du yang ba mo/ ༈yang pā pa la/ ī ya su byin/ ṭi phyis drangs/ mthar īp ster te/ pā pī ya sī/ shin du sdig chen mo/ ༈la ghu iṣ+ṭha bzhag /ṭi phyis drangs/ si/ la ghi ṣ+ṭhaḥ༈pā pa iṣ+ṭha si/ pā pi ṣ+ṭhaḥ/ don snga ma dag dang gcig pas/ 'di thams cad la tshig sbyor du thog mar/ a ti sha ye na kho na sbyar ro/ ༈gurbā de riṣ+ṭhe mi ya su ga rā diṣ+t+ya lo pash+tsa/ gu ru la sogs pa'i iṣ+ṭha i ma ī ya su la gar la sogs pa ste ṭi dbyi ba ma yin pa yang ngo*/ gu ru'i sgra la sogs pa'i pha rol tu iṣ+ṭha dang*/ i mn dang*/ ī ya su ste rkyen gsum po de dag gang byung yang*/ gar du bsgyur ba la sogs pa ā de sha ni byed/ ṭi dbyi ba mi byed do/ /'di la skabs 'gar rtags mtha'i dbyangs dbyi ba yod kyang*/ ṭi dbyi ba ma yin te/ dper na/ gu ru zhes pa ma 'gyur ba'i skabs/ ṭi phyis na gur zhes par 'gyur yang*/ slar ā de sha byed dgos pas dang por ṭi phyis pa dgos med du 'gyur ba dang*/ gar du bsgyur nas ṭi phyis na/ mthar brten r dang ga'i srog gnyis ka yal bas g srog med 'ba' zhig lus yong ba/

grub pa'i gzugs ga rī ya dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ gi yan du thal bas so/ des na 'di ltar bya ste/ a ti sha ye na gu ruḥ/ phul du byung ba'i bla ma'o/ /don de la/ gu ru ī ya su zhes pa bzhag /gu ru gar du bsgyur/ r drangs/ si num/ /n+sa mtha' las ring po/ ha sa dang*/ rab sbyor las si dang s phyis/ ga rī yān/ ༈gu ru iṣ+ṭha gar du song*/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ga riṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ༈yang gu ru i mn zhes bzhag /gar du bsgyur/ drangs si n'i u pa dhā ring po/ si phyis/ nā mi mtha' las n phyis/ ga ri mā/ ༈'di gsum la yang na tshig sbyar ba la/ dang por gu ru ngas bha ba si/ zhes pa/ gu rur+bhā baḥ/ zhes par 'gyur te/ skal ba dang ldan pa'am legs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes bya/ 'dir gu ru'i sogs khongs nas mang po 'byung yang*/ mtshon byed ni/ ngag sbyor gyi skabs/ a ti sha ye na/ zhes pa la pri ya sbyar ba dang*/ s+thu la sbyar ro/ ༈pri ya ī ya su/ zhes pa bzhag/pri ya ni pra zhes par bsgyur/ a i la e/ pre yas si num/ n s mtha' la ring po ha sa dang rab sbyor las dbyi ste/ pre yān/ ༈yang gu ru'i sgra dran par bya/ pri ya iṣ+ṭha si la/ preṣ+ṭhaḥ/ pri ya i mn/ pra a i la e si n'i u pa dhā/ si dang*/ n dbyi/ pre mā/ phul du byung ba'i dga' ba'am snying nye ba'o/ ༈yang s+thu la ī ya su bzhag/s+thū la ni/ s+tha ba zhes par bsgyur/ i a las phyis/ drangs/ si num sogs gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ s+tha gī yān/ ༈s+thū la/ i ṣ+ṭha bzhagas+tha ba zhes par bsgyur/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si/ s+tha biṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ༈yang s+thu la i mn/ s+tha ba i a phyis drangs/ si n'i u pa dhā/ ha sa las si phyis/ nā mi las n phyis/ s+tha bi mā/ ches shin du sdom pa'o/ ༈ī lo podz+yā shab+dā dī ya saḥ/ dz+yā gyi sgra las ī yas kyi ī dbyi'o/ /bṛd+dha zhes pa'i sgra'i pha rol tu ī yas kyi ī yig ni dbyi ba dang*/ bṛd+dha ni dz+yā zhes par bsgyur ro/

/de la tshig sbyor ni/ a ti sha ye na bṛd+dhaḥ/ ches shin du rgyas pa'am/ ches shin du rgan po'o/ /de yang bṛd+dha ī yas zhes pa bzhagarkyen de'i nus pas bṛd+dha ni dz+yā zhes par/ ā de sha ste bsgyur bar bya'o/ /de 'gyur ba'i nus pas rkyen gyi ī ring po phyis/ si num u pa dhā ring*/ si dang s phyis/ dz+yā yān/ ༈pṛd+dha iṣ+ṭha bzhaga.a i la e/ si/ dz+yeṣ+ṭhaḥ/ dz+yā gyi sgra'i 'phros don/dīr+gha dang*/ pra sha'i sgra ni/ ā de sha byed pa la 'phros pa yin gyi /ī phyis par byed pa ni ma yin no/ /a ti sha ye na dīr+ghaḥ/ ches cher ring po'o/ /de'i don la dīr+gha ī yas bzhag/dīr+gha zhes pa ni/ drā gha zhes par bsgyur/ rkyen gyi ī la drangs/ si num sogs gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ drā ghī yān/ ༈de bzhin du/ dīr+gha iṣ+ṭha drā gha si/ drā ghi?ṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ༈yang a ti sha ye na pra shaḥ/ gtso bo phul du byung ba'o/ /pra sha ī yas bzhag/pra sha zhes pa ni/ shra ces par bsgyur/ a i la e/ si num sogs sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ shre yān/ ༈yang pra sha iṣ+ṭha bzhaga.a i la e/ si/ shreṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ༈ba ho riṣ+ṭheyiḥ/ ba hu'i iṣ+ṭha la yi'o/ /ba hu'i sgra la pha rol tu iṣ+ṭha'i rkyen byung na/ ba hu zhes pa bhū ring po dang*/ rkyen gyi i ni yi zhes par 'gro ste/ a ti sha ye na ba hu/ mang ba'i phul du byung ba'o/ /de'i don la ba hu iṣ+ṭha zhes pa bzhagab hu bhū ru song*/ rkyen gyi i yir song*/ si/ /bhū yiṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ༈skabs 'dir 'grel pa las lung drangs pa ni/ kim dang mi zad pa dang*/ kun tu bshad pa las kyang*/ ta ra ta ma dag gi ām'o/ zhes kha skong gi don du 'byung ste/ de'i don ni/ kim gyi sgra dang*/ mi zad pa'i rtags dang*/ kun bshad las 'byung ba'i ti sogs kyi rkyen gyi mthar/ ta ra'am/ ta ma'i rkyen byung na/ rkyen de'i mthar ām ā ga ma ster dgos so/ zhes pa ste/

de yang kim la sbyor na 'di ltar/ kim gyi mthar ta ra sbyar/ de'i mthar ām ā ga ma byin pas/ kiṃ ta rāṃ zhes pa dang*/ ༈kim gyi mthar ta ma zhes pa sbyar/ de la ām byin pas/ kiṃ ta māṃ/ zhes pa 'byung ste/ ām gyi a mtshungs 'dra mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ m dbyangs med gnyis rjes su nga ngor byed pa kho na'o/ de'i don ni cig yod dam/ ci yin zhes pa ste/ smad pa'am/ brnyas pa'i tshig la sbyor/ dper na/ mi de 'dra rgyal po ci yin zhes pa'am/ dbul po de 'dra la mdzod ci yod ces pa lta bu ste/ ga la yod dang*/ ga la yin zhes kyang bsgyur bar bya'o/ /mi zad pa la sbyor pa'i dper brjod ni/ ku taḥ ta ra/ āmra zhes pa bzhagarnam bcad des ta mthong bas sr song*/ ām mtshungs 'dra mtshams sbyar/ m nga ro/ ku tasta rā/ de'i don ni/ ku ta sta raṃ pa ra mā ṇa baḥ/ mchog tu phra ba zhes so/ ༈yang ku taḥta ma/ ām gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ ku ta sta māṃ/ zhes pa 'grub/ de'i don ni/ ku ta sta māṃ te ṣāṃ ā ram+bha ka twaṃ/ zhes pa ste/ de rnams rgya chung ngu nyid do/ /zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ uts+tsaiḥzhes pa la/ ta ra dang ta ma sbyar/ gnyis ka la ām byin/ bshad ma thag pa bzhin bsgrubs pas/ uts+tsai sta rāṃ/ ༈uts+tsaista māṃ/ zhes pa 'byung ste/ de dag gwa yan ti zhes pa dang sbyar/ skad gsangs mthon pos smra bar byed do/ /skad chen pos glu len par byed do/ ༈ti sogs kyi mthar sbyor ba'i dpe ni/ pa tsa ti ta ra ām/ pa ṭha ti ta ma ām/ gong bzhin/ ༈pa tsa ti ta rāṃ/ shin du 'tshed par byed do/ ༈pa ṭha ti ta māṃ/ ches klog par byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈kun tu bshad pa las kyang zhes pa'i/ kyang gi sgras kṛta rkyen gyi mthar yang*/ ta ra dang ta ma la ām ā ga ma ster ba yin yang zer ro/ ༈pa ri mā ṇe da gh+nā da yaḥ/ tshad la da gh+na la sogs pa'o/ /de la gang yang rung ba'i rgya dpangs dang*/ ring thung dang bong tshod dang*/

mchu zheng la sogs pa dang*/ chu'i zabs la sogs pa'i sa mtshams yongs su gcod pa dang*/ tshad ston par byed pa la/ dagh+nā dang*/ mā tra dang*/ dwa yas/ ༈zhes pa ste rkyen gsum po de rnams 'jug go /dngos po'i ngo bo bzang ngan gyi tshad ston pa lta bu'i tshad la ni rkyen 'di rnams mi 'jug cing*/ grangs kyi tshad dang dus kyi tshad ston pa la/ mā tra zhes pa mang du 'jugagazhan gnyis por res 'ga' cud zad tsam 'jug go ༈de yang dzā nu si pa ri mā ṇaṃ dza la si si dang po phyis/ phyi ma am/ a phyis/ dzā nu pa ri mā ṇaṃ dzalaṃ/ chu pus mo nus tsam zhes so/ /don de la dza nu'i mthar da gh+nā si am drangs/ dzā nu dagh+nāṃ/ ༈de bzhin du/ pu ru ṣa mā tra si am/ pu ru ṣa mā traṃ bṛ k+ṣa/ skyes bu dang mnyam pa'i shing*/ ༈yang shi ras dwa yas/ sdabyangs med rnam bcad/ de u/ de o/ mthar si am/ shi ro dwa ya saṃ daṇ+ḍa/ mgo bo'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i dbyug pa zhes so/ ༈yang 'grel bar lung drangs ba/ gnyis sam mang po rnams kyi yang gcig bkar ba la kim la sogs pa dag la ḍa ta ra dang ḍa ta ma dag go /zhes 'byung ste gnyis kyi nang nas gcig bkar ba'am mang po'i nang nas gcig bkar ba yin yang rung ste/ don de la kim la sogs pa ste/ sogs khogs nas yad dang tad la ḍa ta ra dang ḍa ta ma'i rkyen 'jug go /༈de yang kim ḍa ta ra zhes pa bzhagaḍ phyis a bzhagade ḍit yin pas ṭi phyis/ k srog maid a la drangs pas/ ka ta ra/ zhes pa byung*/ de'i mthar/ bha bt la drug pa'i os byin/ bha ba toḥkā ṇāḥ/ zhes pa gong du bzhag/bha ba toḥkā ṇā ka ta ra/ khyed gnyis las ka ṇa'i bu gang yin zhes pa ste/ gcigalas gcig bkar ba'i dpe'o/ ༈yang kim ḍa ta ma bzhag/ḍ song ṭi phyis/ drangs/ ka ta ma grub/ si rnam bcad/ ka ta maḥde'i mthar/ bha bt la drug pa'i ām/ bha ba tāṃ tān+t+ri ka si rnam bcad/ ka ta maḥ/ ma'i rnam bcad u sogs 'dra/ ka ta mo bha ba tāṃ tān+t+rikaḥ/

khyed rnams las sngags rgyud mkhan po su yin/ zhes pa mang po las gcig bkar ba'i dpe'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ yad la ḍa ta ra bzhagaḍ song ṭi phyis/ sbyar bas/ ya ta ra byung*/ ༈tad la ḍa ta ra bzhagaḍ song ṭi phyis/ drangs pas/ ta ta ra byung*/ ༈de bzhin du/ ḍa ta ma dang sbyar bas/ ya ta ma dang*/ ༈ta ta ma 'byung*/ don ni gang dang ci dang de la sogs pa'o/ ༈des na/ bha ba tor+ya ta rastārki kasta tar ung-igra ṇā tu/ khyed dag las gang zhig rtog ge mkhan po de ni smra ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'o/ /'di ni gnyis dang mang po las bkar ba thun mong ste khyad par can gyi don no/ / ༈saṃ khyā ya bi she ṣā a ba dhā ra ṇedwi tri bh+yāṃ tī yaḥ/ grangs kyi bye brag logs su bkol ba la dwi dang tri dag las tī ya'o/ /grangs kyi khyad par logs su bkol ba ni/ gzhan rnams kyi nang nas grangs de dang ldan pa bkol ba'i tshig ste/ gnyis po gsum po zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈de yang dwi dang tī ya bzhagasi rnam bcad/ dwi tī yaḥ/ gnyis po zhes bkar ba'am/ gnyis pa zhes gnyis dang ldan pa'i rtags can no/ /de la dwi ni gnyis yin/ tī ya'i nus pas bye brag zur du bkol ba'i don la/ gnyis po'am/ ldan pa'i rtags can la gnyis pa zhes par 'gyur ba yin/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri tī ya si/ tri'i i dang r ni dbyangs kyi ṛ ru bsgyur ro/ /tṛ tī yaḥ/ tṛ zhes pa gsum yin la/ de la tī ya sbyar bas gsum pa'am gsum po'o/ /'dir ra'i gi gu dbyangs ṛ ru bsgyur ba 'di la/ sam+p+ra sā ra ṇa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ ༈ṣaṭ tsa ru ros+thaḥ/ ṣaṭ dang tsa tur dag gi tha'o/ /de yang ṣa ṣa tha ni tshul rol gyi ṣa mthong bas ṭha ru song*/ /drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ṣaṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ༈yang tsa tur tha si r tha la drangs/ tsa tur+thaḥ/ ༈ka ti ka ti pa yā bh+yāṃ thaḥ/ ka ti dang ka ti pa ya dag las kyang tha'o/ /ka ti la tha sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ ༈ka ti pa ya la tha sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ ༈ka ti thaḥ/ ji tsam/ ༈ka ti pa ya thaḥ/

ji tsam byung*/ 'di grangs kyi rim pa min yang ji tsam zhes pa grangs la dmigs pa dang/ tha'i rkyen sbyor bar mtshungs pa'i phyir 'phros don no/ /dpe kha cig la tshig 'di 'og na yod do/ ༈pañtsa dermaḥ/ pañtsa sogs la ma'o/ de yang pañtsa nm si/ n mtha' phyis/ pañtsa maḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ sap+ta maḥ/ aṣ+ta maḥ/ na ba maḥ da sha maḥ zhes sbyar ro/ ༈e kā da shā der+ḍaḥ/ bcu gcig la sogs pa rnams la ḍa'o/ /bcu gcig gi skad dod e ka da sha'i sgra la/ rkyen ḍa byin/ ḍ rjes 'brel/ ṭi dbyi/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ e ka da shaḥ/ dwitraya ya btags yin ṣ+tānāṃ dwā tra yo3ṣ+tāḥ dwi tri aṣ+tan rnams kyi dwā tra yo aṣ+tā rnams so/ /dwi dang tri dang a ṣ+tan rnams ni da sha dang sbyor ba na rim bzhin dwa tra yo aṣ+tā rnams su 'gyur te/ de bzhin du bcu gnyis la/ /dwā da shaḥ/ ༈bcu gsum la tra yo da shaḥ/ ༈bcu bzhi la tsa turda shaḥ ༈bco brgyad la aṣ+ta da shaḥ/ ༈bcu dgu la na ba da shaḥ༈ biṃ shat+yā derbā ta maṭ/ nyi shu sogs la yang na ta maṭ'o/ biṃ sha zhes pa'i mthar/ rkyen ḍa ti bzhagaḍ rjes 'brel/ ṭi dbyi/ drangs/ biṃ sha ti/ nyi shu tham pa'o/ ༈yang na/ biṃ sha ti/ zhes pa de la/ rkyen ta ma bzhagasi rnam bcad/ biṃ sha ti ta maḥnyi shu kho na'am/ nyi shu tham pa'o/ ༈biṃ sha ti ḍa ti/ nyi shu la ḍa ti zhes pa'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas/ 'dir ḍ ti zhes pa ni/ rkyen ḍa kho na la ti ni pa ra smai skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig yin pas/ nyi shu'i don la rkyen ḍa byed do zhes pa'i don yin gyi rkyen ḍa ti ma yin par 'chad pa'ang lugs gcig go ༈'di ltar na/ biṃ sha ta la rkyen ḍa byin/ ḍ rjes 'brel/ ṭi phyis/ drangs pas/ biṃ sha'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ triṃ sha t la ḍa ti sbyar na gong bzhin sgrubs pas/ triṃ sha ti ste sum cu dang*/ de la ta ma sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ byas na/ triṃ sha ti ta maḥste sum cu tham pa zhes pa 'byung*/ ༈yang triṃ shad kho na la ta ma sbyar ba'ang yod/

༈yang triṃ shad la ḍa rkyen du byin/ sgrub tshul gong bzhin byas pas/ triṃ sha zhes pa'ang 'byung ste/ don sum cu tham pa'o/ ༈ sha tā dernait+yaṃ/ brgya la sogs pa la rtag tu'o/ /brgya'i skad dod sha ta la rkyen ta ma sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ sha ta ta maḥbargya tham pa'o/ /rtag tu'o zhes pa'i don ni/ ta ma kho na rtag tu sbyor gyi/ ḍa ti dang ḍa kho na'i rkyen rnams mi 'byung ngo*/ ༈sogs khongs nas/ brgya tham pa bzhin du grangs med kyi bar du'ang 'ba' zhig pa'i don la/ ta ma kho na 'byung ngo*/ /sa has ta maḥ stong tham pa dang*/ lak+ṣa ta maḥ'abum phrag dang*/ ko ṭi ta maḥbyed ba phrag ces pa ste/ des gzhan yang mtshon no/ ༈ saṃ khyā yāḥpra kā re dhā/ grangs rnams kyi rab tu dbye ba la dhā'o/ grangs kyi rab tu dbye ba ni tshan par bcad pa'i ming ste/ gnyis tshan gsum tshan la sogs pa yin la/ der ma zad kha zas gcig pu byin zhes pa lta bu'i gcig pi la yang thob cing*/ gcig las 'phros pa'i gcig gi sde tshan lta bu la nges par thob bo/ ༈de yang*/ dwi ces pa'i sgra la rkyen dhā sbyar bas/ dwi dhā/ ces pa gnyis sde tshan du bcad pa'i don no/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri dhā/ tsa tur+dha/ ces sogs te/ de tsam las rnam 'gyur gzhan gang yang med do/ gu ṇo ྅ ṇ bā/ yon tan la aṇ yang na'o/ gzhan la dngos po sbyin par gtong ba sogs kyi don dang 'brel na/ rkyen dhā byin pas rnam 'gyur yod de/ dbyangs dang po yon tan du 'gyur ro/ dwe dhā/ tre dhā/ de ltar yon tan du gyur zin pa la/ nges par aṇ gyi rkyen ster/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si am/ a song*/ dwaidh+waṃ/ trai dh+waṃ/ tsā tu r+dh+waṃ ces pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈kṛ yā yā ā bṛt+tau kṛ twas/ bya ba'i ched du kun nas 'jug pa la kṛ twas'o*/ /zas dus yang yang byed pa dang*/ thun du ma yod pa sogs lan mang du bskyar ba'i bya ba'i don la/

kṛ twas zhes pa'i rkyen ster ro/ pañtsa bā rān bhuṃ k+te/ lan lngar ltau za'o/ /zhes pa steng ngag go /don de la/ pañtsa kṛtwas zhes pa bzhagamatha'i s rnam bcad/ pañtsa kṛ twaḥ/ ṣaṭ-i?kra twaḥlan drug tu zhes pa'o/ ༈dwi tri bh+yāṃ suḥ/ dwi dang tri dag la su'o/ /dwi zhes pa dang*/ tri zhes pa la rkyen su zhes pa re re byin/ su'i u brjod don/ pha rol tu uk+ta zhes pa re re bzhagadwis uk+tase/ tris uk+ta si zhes byung*/ s srog med rnam bcad/ nā mi mtha' las r/ drangs/ si am/ dwi ruk+taṃ/ tri ruk+taṃ/ ༈ba hwā deḥshas/ ba hu la sogs pa la shas'o/ /ba hu ni mang po ste/ mang po zhes pa'i spyi ming ngam bzhi'am lnga la sogs pa mang po'i bye brag gi don la/ shas kyi rkyen byin na lan mang po'i don du 'gyur ro/ ba hu'i sogs khongs nas yang yang dang*/ bskyar ba dang*/ rjes su 'jug pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈'dir/ ba hu bā rān+tī ti/ 'di ni lan mang por ro/ /zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /de'i don la/ ba hu'i mthar/ rkyen shas bzhagas rnams bcad/ ba hu shaḥzhes so/ ༈ta yā ya ṭau saṃ khyā yāṃ/ ta ya a yaṭ dag gi grangs kyi ched du'o/ /grangs kyi ming la rkyen ta ya ṭ'am/ a yaṭ bzhag na/ grangs de dang ldan pa'i dngos po'i don te/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ ༈de yang*/ dwi'i mthar ta ya ṭa bzhagaṭrjes 'brel/ si am/ dwi ta yaṃ/ gnyis pa'am gnyis can zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri la ta yaṭ sbyar bas/ si am/ tri ta yaṃ ste gsum pa'am gsum can no/ ༈a yaṭ la ni 'di ltar byed de/ dwi'i mthar thog mar ta ya ṭ byin/ ta ar bsgyur nas a yaṭ'o/ /a de ni ḍi t yin la/ ṭi phyis pas dw dbyangs med du song*/ drangs/ si am/ dwa yaṃ/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri ta yaṭ/ ta ar bsgyur/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ si am tra yaṃ/ don snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈de rnams spyi la 'jug tshul yin la/ bud med nyid dang*/ chu dang*/

khang pa dang*/ snod la sogs pa la āp ky-i rkyen 'jug ste/ dper na/ dwi ta ya sngar bzhin bsgrubs nas/ de la mo rtags su sgrub pa'i rkyen īp bzhag go /p rjes 'brel/ i a phyis/ drangs/ dwi ta yī ba dhu/ bu mo gnyis pa zhes pa lta bu ste/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri ta yī/ zhes pa dang*/ a yaṭ'i rjes/ dwa ya dang tra ya la īp byin pas/ dwa yī/ tra yī/ zhes pa 'byung ngo*/ ༈bar 'dir 'grel ba'i dpe 'ga' zhig las/ kha 'gangs lung drangs pa yod de/ dzaṃ gha'i sgra la sogs pa la i na a la la sogs pa dag go /de yang*/ dzaṃ gha dang*/ sogs khongs nas dza ba lta bu la rkyen i na byin/ a i la e/ dza ghe na/ dza be na/ ༈de bzhin du/ dzaṃ gha dang*/ a la bzhag/'dra ba'i yi ge ring po/ si rnam bcad/ dzaṃghā laḥ/ grub bo/ ༈yang dzaṃ ghā kā ra/ sogs khongs kyi rkyen/ ik i a'i dbyi/ si rnam bcad/ dzaṃ ghā kā ri kaḥ/ brla mdzes pa'o/ ༈yang dzaṃ gha la rkyen ik byin/ i a la phyis/ drangs si/ dzaṃ ghi kaḥ/ dza ba sogs la'ang de dag 'gre'o/ ༈yang pā ṇi pa'i lung drangs pa/ bud med dang skyes pa dag la naṇ snaṇ dag go /bud med kyi skad dod s+t+rī la rkyen naṇ dang*/ skyes pa'i skad dod/ puṃ la snaṇ zhes pa'i rkyen ster te/ s+t+rī naṇ/ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ ṣa ra ṛ las na ṇar song*/ si am/ s+t+rai ṇaṃ/ bud med mdzes ma'o/ ༈puṃ snaṇ ṇ rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ rab sbyor mtha' la m dbyi dgos pa/ nga ro nyid m yig pas phyis/ si am/ pau snaṃ/ zhes pa grub/ skyes pa dpa' bo'i don no/ /spyir rab sbyor mtha'i phyi ma mi snang bar byed pa yin kyang*/ 'dir snga ma phyis pa tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa yin/ rjes su nga ro rab sbyor gyi ya gyal du byed pa ni gzhan du'ang mang po yod pas ma brjed par bya'o/ /mdo gzhan gyi lung drangs pa 'di gnyis 'grel ba'i dpe gnyis la ma mthong ngo*/

༈she ṣā ni pā t+yā ka t+yā da yaḥ/ lhag ma tshig phrad rnams ni ka ti la sogs pa'o/ /'dir tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa zur tsam smos pa ste/ lhag ma gzhan rnams ni/ slob dpon gyi man ngag dang*/ klus bkod pa'i 'bum pa sogs las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin/ ༈kim la rkyen ḍa ti bzhag/ḍ rjes 'brel ṭi mi snang*/ drangs pas/ ka ti zhes pa byung ste/ gang tsam mam ji tsam zhes pa'o/ ༈de la rkyen pa ya sbyar/ rnam 'gyur med/ si rnam bcad/ ka t-i pa yaḥ/ ji tsam byung zhes pa ste/ grangs 'dri ba'o/ /de ltar de dag ni de phan gyi rkyen nyer 'kho che ba 'ga' zhig gi bya ba rags pa tsam brjod pa'o// ༈da ni dbyi ba bi kā ra ṇa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ de la byings a da sogs la/ luk bi kā ra ṇa 'jug ste/ ༈de la dang po/ pa rasme pa ti'i dbang du byas te/ a da za ba la'o/ /da yig gi a ni brjod don no/ /a dā derluk /a da la sogs pa rnams kyi 'jig go /byings sde tshan dgu las/ a da la sogs pa la ap bi kā ra ṇa 'byung mod kyi/ de ma thag tu 'jig pa'i phyir/ ap las rdzas gzhan du med kyang*/ 'jig pa bī ka ra ṇa zhes rnam grangs gzhan du brda sbyar ba yin no/ 'o na 'jig pa la slar bya ba med par bshad na/ 'dir de'i rjes su aṭ ī la sogs pa 'byung ba ci zhe na/ de ni ap kyi yul te shul la i la sogs pa'i rkyen gsar pa byin nas des rnam 'gyur byed pa yin gyi/ ap nyid yod pa'i dus dang*/ zhig pa'i dus gang la yang*/ ap kyi nus pas byings rtags kyi mtha' dang*/ pha rol rnam dbye sogs gang la'ang rnam 'gyur med pa'i phyir/ dbyi ba tsam ma yin te 'jig pa nyid do/ /a da sogs 'jig pa'i skabs/ ap ces byung ba rnams/ ap 'jig pa kho nar go bar bya'o/ /spyir 'jig pa la zhig zin nas rnam 'gyur med pa yin gyi/ 'jig 'gyur la nus med du ma nges so/ ༈de yang*/ a da ti zhes pa bzhagada'i a brjod don/

ap byin 'jigakha sa la dzha sa rnams tsa pa'o/ /zhes pas d tra ru song*/ pha rol ti yi steng du drangs/ at+ti/ za bar byed/ ༈ad tas/ ap 'jig/s rnam bcad/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra/ at+taḥ/ ༈ad an+ti ap/ d drangs/ a dan+ti/ ༈ad ྄si ap t drangs/ at+si/ khyod zas za bar byed/ ༈ad thas ྄ap d t drangs/ s rnam bcad/ at+thaḥ/ ༈ad tha ap gong dang 'dra/ at+tha/ ༈ad mip ap d ta ྄drangs/ at+mi*/ zas za bar byed do/ ༈ad bs ap da drangs/ s rnam bcad/ ad+baḥ/ ༈ad mas/ ap snga ma bzhin/ ad+maḥ/ ༈cho ga 'byung ba la/ ad yāt ap d yā la drangs/ ad+yā ta/ ༈de bzhin du gzhan brgyad la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ ad yā tāṃ/ ap ad+yā tāṃ/ ༈ad yus ap s rnam bcad/ ad+yuḥ/ ༈ad yās ap/ rnam bcad/ ad+yuḥ༈ ad yā tāṃ/ ap/ ad+yā tāṃ/ ad yā tā/ ap/ ad+yā tāṃ/ ༈ad yām/ ap m nga ro/ ad+yāṃ/ ༈ad yā ba/ ap ad+yā ba/ ༈ad yā ma ap ad+yā ma/ ༈shis byed la/ ad tup/ p rjes 'brel/ ap d t drangs/ at+tu/ yang na/ tup tātang du bsgyur/ taṃ gi ang phyis/ at+tā ta/ ༈ad tāṃ ap/ at+tāṃ/ ༈ad ྄an+tu/ ap d a la drangs/ a dan+tu/ ༈dzha sād+dhir+heḥ/ dzha sa las hi dhi'o/ /tshul rol byings kyi mtha' dzha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod la/ de'i pha rol tu rnam dbye hi byung na/ hi yig de dhi yig tu 'gyur ro/ ad hi ap/ hi dhi ru song*/ d dha'i steng du drangs/ ad+dhi/ yang na hi tā tang du bsgyur/ at+tāt/ ༈ad ྄tāṃ ap at+tāṃ/ ༈ad ta ap at+ta/ ༈ad.ā nip/ ap/ d a la drangs/ p rjes 'brel/ a dā ni/ ༈ad ā ba/ a p drangs/ a dā ba/ ༈ad āmap/ ap drangs/ a dā ma/ ༈lung drangs pa/ ad kyi di si dag la aṭ ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung bas/ dip sogs la sngon du aṭ'i rkyen sbyor dgos par ma zad/ dip dang sip gnyis la byings kyi mthar yang*/ aṭ ā ga ma ster dgos so/

༈ad dip zhes pa bzhag/p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ d dbyangs med lus/ ap/ byings kyi mthar aṭ/ sngon du yang aṭ/ ṭ gnyis phyis/ a ad ad/ ces pa byung*/ a dang po gnyis 'dra ba ring*/ d snga ma a la drangs/ phyi ma t ru song*/ ā dat/ ༈ad tāṃ ap/ sngon du aṭ/ 'dra ring*/ drangs/ āt+tāṃ/ ༈ad ྄an ap sngon du aṭ/ 'dra drangs/ ā dan/ ༈ad ྄sip/ p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ ap byings la aṭ/ sngon du aṭ/ a ad as zhes byung*/ 'dra ring*/ d a la/ s rnam bcad/ ā daḥ/ ༈ad ྄tāṃ ap/ aṭ āt+tāṃ/ ༈ad ta ap/ aṭ āt+ta/ ༈ad a mip/ p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ ap sngon du aṭ/ a ad am byung*/ 'dra ring*/ d a la/ m nga ro/ ā daṃ/ ༈ad ba ap aṭ d ba'i steng du drangs/ ād+ba/ ༈ad ma ap/ aṭ/ āt+ma/ ༈da ni at+ma ne'i tshig can rnams bshad te/ shīng nyal ba la'o/ /ng yig ni bdag don gyi tshig can mtshon pa'i don yin pas phyis/ 'di rnams la yang sngon ma bzhin du ap ni 'jig pa nyid do/shīngḥ/ shīng la'o/ /shīng zhes pa'i byings la/ at+ma ne'i rkyen de rnams gang byung yang*/ byings kyi dbyangs yon tan du 'gyur te/ sha'i srog gi ī ni yon tan e ru 'gyur bas/ she zhes pa sha stag 'byung ngo*/ ༈shīng te zhes pa bzhag/ng khyad don/ ap 'jig/yon tan i e ru song*/ she te/ ༈de bzhin du/ shīng ā te ap/ yon tan e ay/ drangs/ sha yā te/ shī'i skabs 'dir yon tan zhes pa byung na/ i e kho na yin la/ yon tan sogs zhes pa rnams/ i e e ay so sor 'dren pa go dgos so/ /༈shī ngo nya to ru ṭ/ shīng gi an+ta la ruṭ'o/ /byings shīng gi pha rol tu ad+ma ne'i rkyen/ an+ta'i rigs byung na/ byings kyi mthar ru ṭ ā ga ma ster ro/ /ā toṃ ྅ to da na taḥ/ āt kyi an+ta la āt te a min pa'o/ /'dir āt ces pa āt+ma ne'i tshig can gyi byings la zer/

de lta bu'i pha rol na yod pa'i rkyen an+ta'i rigs ni a ta ru sgyur dgos te/ ta'i srog gi dbyangs ni rang gnas su gnas pas lus 'gyur gyi dbang du byas na/ an ta'i n yig gam klad skor kho na spangs pa'o/ /'on kyang byings kyi mtha' na a yig yod na/ an+ta a ta ru mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni ā ga ma'i ra ྄yig byings mthar yod cing*/ shī dang she gang gi skabs yin kyang rung ste/ byings mtha' a yig ma yin pas/ a ta ru bsgyur ba kho na'o/ ༈de yang shīng an+te bzhag /ap phyis/ yon tan/ ruṭ.ā ga ma byin/ ṭ+ra rjes 'brel u brjod don/ /an+te a te ru bsgyur/ drangs/ she ra te/ ༈shīng se ap/ yon tan/ ku i la sogs sa ṣa/ she ṣe/ ༈shīng ā the/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yā the/ shīng dh+we/ ap yon tan/ she dh+we/ shīng e/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha ye/ ༈shīng ba he/ ap yon tan/ she ba he/ ༈shīng ma he/ /ap yon tan/ she ma he/ ༈shīng ī ta/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī ta/ ༈shīng ī yā tāṃ/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī yā tāṃ/ ༈shīng ī ran/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yi ran/ ༈shīng ī thas/ ap yon tan sogs/ s rnam bcad/ sha yī thāḥ/ ༈shīng ī yā thāṃ/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī yā thāḥ/ ༈shīng īdh+waṃ/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī dh+waṃ/ ༈shīng ī ya ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī ya/ ༈shīng ī ba hi/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī ba hi/ ༈shīng ī ma hi/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yī ma hi/ shīng tāṃ ap yon tan sogs/ she tāṃ/ ༈shīng ā tāṃ/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yā tāṃ/ ༈shīng an+taṃ/ ap yon tan/ ruṭ ster/ an+ta a tar bsgyur/ she ra ta/ ༈shīng swa ap yon tan/ ku i la sogs/ she ṣ+wa/ ༈shīng ā tham/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yā thaṃ/ ༈shīng dh+waṃ/ ap yon tan/ she dh+waṃ/ ༈shīng ai ap yon tan sogs/ sha yai/ shīng ā ba haip/ ༈p rjes 'brel/ ap/ yon tan sogs/

sha yā ba hai/ ༈shīng ā ma he p/ p rjes 'brel/ ap yon tan sogs/ sha yā ma hai/ ༈deng ma yin pa'i don la tan la sogs pa dgu ste/ sngar bshad pa bzhin 'di thams cad la thog mar aṭ bzhag par bya'o/ /shing tan/ n rjes 'brel/ ap yon tan/ aṭ a she ta/ ༈shīng ātāṃ/ ap yon tan sogs/ aṭ a sha yā tāṃ/ ༈shīng an+ta/ ruṭ ap yon tan/ an+ta a tar bsgyur/ aṭ/ a she ra ta/ shīng thās/ ap yon tan/ aṭ a she thāḥ/ ༈shing a thām/ ap/ yon tan sogs/ aṭ a sha yā thāṃ/ ༈shīngdh+wam/ ap yon tan/ aṭ a she dh+waṃ/ ༈shīng ྄i ap yon tan sogs/ aṭ a sha yi/ ༈shīng ba hi/ ap yon tan/ aṭ a she ba hi/ ༈shīng ma hi ap yon tan/ aṭ a she ma hi/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi dper brjod ni/ bru ny gsal bar brjod pa la'o/ /ny ni gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi rtags don yin pas dbyi/ a bā dā bī bi tit+sim/ ap la sogs pa dag gi ī te pit kyi ta sa ma'o/ /tshul rol na byings brū ny yod cing*/ pha rol rnam dbye'i rkyen gyi thog ma'i yi ge la/ ta sa ma rnams gang rung yod pa dang*/ pit te p rjes 'brel yin pa gzhi mthun na nges par yin zhing*/ gzhan nges pa med de de lta bu'i byings kyi mthar/ ap zhig pa'i yul la ī ring po rkyen du 'gyur zhing*/ bru yi srog u ni yon tan o ru 'gyur zhing*/ o a br 'gyur ba ī dang mtshams sbyor ba sogs bya'o/ /'dir ap la sogs pa zhes 'byung ba ni/ sogs khongs nas 'don rgyu med/ dang po'i don yin pas sngon ap byung ba da ltar mi snang bar byas pa'o/ ༈brūnyti ces pa bzhaganya rjes 'brel/ /ap 'jig/rkyen ī byin/ brū yi yon tan bro/ o ab/ b ī la drangs/ bra bī ti/ ༈ta s ni 'dir ta rkyen yin yang*/ pit min pas/ ī rkyen dang yon tan sogs mi byed de/ bru ta s/ s rnam bcad/

brū taḥ/ ༈ī ū byings kyi iy ub dag dbyangs pha rol la'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ spyir bi kā ra ṇa'i byings kyi mtha' la ī yig dang ū yig yong la/ pha rol du ti sogs kyi bye brag dbyangs rkyen byung na/ i y dang ub ru 'gyur zhes pa spyir btangs su bzhag/yang i u dag gi yang na'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas dbyangs du ma can te/ yig 'bru gnyis gsum sogs yod pa/ gsal byed rab sbyor te gsal byed du ma brtsegs pa ma yin pa de 'dra'i mtha'i i yig y dang*/ u yig b ru 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nu byings la'o/ zhes 'og nas 'byung ngo*/ /'on kyang dmigs gsal 'dir/ nā na phyorbaḥ/ ap med pa la up ma yin no/ /ap phyis pa'i shul du byings kyi mtha'i u yig ni ba yig tu mi bsgyur bar/ up zhes pa yi ge gnyis su bsgyur bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang*/ bru zhes pa 'di ni/ b dang r brtsegs pas gsal byed rab sbyor yin/ dbyangs du ma ma yin te/ u yig gcig pu nyid yin pas kyang*/ spyir btangs mi 'jug pa'o/ des na/ brū an+ti zhes pa bzhag/ap brū'i srog gi ū ring po ni/ phral te u br bsgyur/ br u thung ngu la drangs/ b a n la drangs pas/ bru ban+ti/ ༈yang brusip/ ap ī byin/ yon tan/ o ap/ drangs/ ku i la sogs/ bra bī ṣi/ brūnythas/ s rnam bcad/ brū thaḥ/ ༈dhī/'ubrū tha yang de dang 'dra/ ༈brū mip/ ap ī yon tan sogs/ bra bī mi/ ༈brū bs s rnam bcad/ brū baḥ/ brū mas/ s rnam bcad/ brū maḥ/ ༈yang 'dir dmigs gsal gyi khyad par ni/ bru ba ā hash+tsa pañtsa naṃ/ brū ā h yang ste lnga po rnams so/ /brū'i byings la ti p sogs thog ma'i rkyen lnga po ni/ ṇap la sogs par bsgyur ba yang rnam 'gyur lugs gcig yin no/ /de yang lnga car la brū ni āh zhes par bsgyur/ pha rol kyi rkyen tip ni ṇap du bsgyur/

tas ni a tus dang*/ an+ti ni us dang*/ sip ni thap dang*/ thas ni a thus su 'gyur ba yin no/ /༈brū tip bzhaga.ap 'jigabrū zhes pa ā har bsgyur/ tip zhes pa ṇap du bsgyur/ p rjes 'brel/ ṇ bya ba'-i don/ h dbyangs med a la drangs/ ā ha grub/ ༈ba tas ap brū ā har bsgyur/ tas ni a tus su bsgyur/ h drangs/ s rnam bcad/ ā ha tuḥ/ ༈brū an+ti ap/ brū āha/ an+ti us/ h drangs/ s rnam bcad/ a huḥ/ ༈nudhā toḥ/ byings la nu'o/ /mdo tshig 'di skabs 'di na yod kyang 'og tu 'chad do/ ༈ta the/ tha la ta'o/ /pha rol tu rnam dbye'i rkyen tha yig byung la/ snga rol tu brū yi rnam 'gyur āh yod na/ h dbyangs med des/ pha rol rnam dbye tha yig mthong bas/ rang nyid t yig tu 'gyur ba yin no/ ༈brūsip/ ap āha/ sip thap/ hat ru song*/ drangs/ āt+tha/ ༈brūthas ap/ āh thas a thus su bsgyur/ h drangs/ s rnam bcad/ ā ha thuḥ/ ༈at+ma ne'i tshig can la ni brū te bzhaga.ub byed/ bru bā te/ ༈ub an+te a te/ bru ba te/ ༈ku i la sogs/ brū ṣe/ ༈ub/ bru bā the/ ༈brū dh+we/ ༈ab/ bru be/ ༈brū ba he/ ༈brū ma he/ zhes pa rnams so/ /༈chog 'byung la/ brū yāt/ brū yā tāṃ/ ༈bru yuḥ/ bru yā ༈bru yā tāṃ/ ༈bh+rū yā ta/ ༈brū yāṃ/ ༈bru yā ba/ ༈bru yā ma/ de rnams ni rkyen dang sbyar ba tsam yin gyi rnam 'gyur med do/ ༈at+ma ne'i tshig can la/ dgu po rnams ub 'ba' zhig gi rnam 'gyur yin te/ bru bī ta/ bru bī yā tāṃ/ bru bī ran/ ༈bru bī thaḥ/ bru bī yā thāṃ/ bru bī dh+waṃ/ ༈bru bī ya/ bru bī ba hi/ bru bī ma hi/ ༈shis byed la/ brū tup zhes pa bzhagap rjes 'brel/ ap/ 'di bit yin pas ī/ brū la yon tan/ o ab/ so sor drangs pas/ bra bī tu/ yang na/ tup tā ta ng ru bsgyur bas/ /bru tā t/

༈brū tāṃ/ ub/ bru ban+tu/ 'di la'ang spyir btangs ltar na a tur bsgyur ba thob kyang lag len du mi byed par snang ngo*/ ༈brū hi/ yang na/ brū tāt/ ༈brū taṃ/ ༈brū ta/ ༈brū ā nip bzhag pit yin pas yon tan/ o ab/ b ā la drangs/ bra bā ni/ de dang 'dra bar yon tan/ o ab/ brū ābap/ bra bā ba/ ༈brū ā mab/ bra bā ma/ ༈at+ma ne la/ brū tāṃ/ ༈ub/ bru bā tāṃ/ ༈bru ba tāṃ/ 'di a ta ra song ba yin/ ༈ku i la/ bru ṣ+wa/ ༈ub/ brū ba thaṃ/ ༈bru dh+waṃ/ ༈brū aip/ pit kyi yon tan/ o ab/ drangs/ bra bai/ ༈de dang sgrub tshul 'dra ste/ brū ā ba hep/ bra bā ba hai/ ༈brū ā ma haip/ bra bā ma hai/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈deng min pa la thams cad kyi sngon du aṭ 'jog dgos/ dang por pa ra smi la/ brū di p bzhaga.ap/ ī yon tan/ o ap/ aṭ/ p rjes 'brel/ i khyad don/ d tr song*/ a bra bit/ ༈a brū tāṃ/ ༈ub/ a bru ba n/ ༈brū sip/ p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ pit kyi yon tan/ o ab/ drangs/ s rnam bcad/ a br baḥ/ a brū tāṃ/ a brū ta/ brū a mip/ p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ yon tan/ o ap drangs/ ma nga ro/ a bra baṃ/ ༈a brū ga.a brū ma/ ༈at+ma ne la/ brū tan/ n rjes 'brel/ a brū ta/ ༈u b/ a bru bā tāṃ/ ༈u b/ a bru bt/ ༈s rnam bcad/ a brū thāḥ/ ༈u b/ a bru bā thaṃ/ ༈a brū dh+waṃ/ ༈ub a bru bi/ ༈a brū ba hi/ ༈a brū ma hi/ zhes pa rnams te/ 'di ni gnyis don can yin pas byings thams cad pa'i rkyen bdun cu rtsa gnyis kar 'jug pa'o/ /'di rnams 'jig pa bi ka ra ṇa'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ byings la rnam dbye bkod ma thag tu ap 'jig pa yin mod/ 'dir yi ge mang bas 'jigs pa te re re bzhin ma bris mod kyi/ a da'i byings kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin du rigs bsgres te go bar bya la/ sa ris byed pa rnams kyis kyang sla chos mi byed par 'bri bsub byed pa gal che'o/

/de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rig par bya'o/ ༈'jig pa bi ka ra ṇa'i yul yin kyang*/ hu la sogs pa rnams la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod te/ 'dir byings gnyis su 'phel ba'i rigs la ni gnyis brjod ces bya'o/ /hu sbyin pa dang mchod pa dag la'o/ /zhes byings hu la dper brjod bya'o/ /hwā der+d+wish+tsa/ hu la sogs pa las gnyis kyang ngo*/ /'dir thams cad la yang gong bzhin ap 'jig go /de yang byings hu la 'dir bstan gyi rnam dbye byings thams cad la gang byin yang*/ byings nyis 'gyur du 'phel bar 'gyur te/ 'dir hu hu zhes gnyis 'byung ba yin no/ /sa swa rā di r+d+wir dwiḥ/ dbyangs bcas dang po gnyis te gnyis ma yin pa'o/ /dbyangs dang po can gyi byings la ni/ dbyangs nyid gnyis su 'phel bar 'gyur gyi /cha shas sam rjes 'brang gsal byed ni gnyis su 'phel ba ma yin no/ /mdo 'di gnyis kyang ngo zhes pa las 'phros pa ste/ dper brjod 'og tu 'chad skabs 'dir bya ba med do/ /ku hosh+tsuḥ/ ku dang ha yi tsu'o/ /thog mar yod pa'i byings de'i mtha' la/ ku ste ka sde dang gzhan ha yig yod na'ang*/ de dag tsu ste tsa sder 'gyur ro/ /de la ka kha ga gha nga*/ rim pas/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya rnams su 'gyur te/ dper brjod 'og tu ston/ ha yig ni tsa sde'i bzhi pa dzha yig tu 'gyur ro/ /dzha pā nāṃ dza ba tsa bāḥ dzha pa rnams dza ba dang tsa pa rnams so/ /dzha pa so sor bsdu ba ni/ sde pa lnga po rnams kyi da sogs spangs pa'o/ /dza ba ni sde pa'i gsum pa rnams so/ /tsa pa ni dang po lnga'o/ /rnams kyi zhes pa'i tshig zur ni kha pa so sor bsdu ba ste/ sde pa rnams kyi dang po rnams dang gnyis pa rnams so/ /des na byings gnyis su 'phel ba'i thog ma de ni/ dzha pa'i yi ge gang yin kyang*/ sde pa'i nang sel gyi grangs dang mthun pa'i dza bar 'gyur la/ rnams kyi sgras kha pa yin na/ ka par yang 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i don yin mod kyi/

de yang dzha pa thams cad dza bar 'gyur ba ni spyir btangs dang*/ dza ba'i nang sel kha pa ni dza bar mi 'gyur bar/ tsa par bsgyur ba dmigs gsal yin no/ /'dir ni bzhi pa dzha sogs/ gsum pa dza sogs su 'gyur ba 'di dgos so/ ༈de yang hu ti zhes pa bzhag/ap phyis/ hu la sogs pa'i gnyis kyang ngo*/ /zhes pas hu las hu gcig gral 'gor 'phel/ ku ha dag gi tsu'o/ zhes pas hu gral 'go ma dzhu zhes par song*/ dzha pa rnams kyi dza ba dang tsa pa'o/ /zhes pas/ dzhu de yang dzu ru song*/ dzu hu sgrub tshul 'di 'og ma thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ pit la yon tan te/ hu ho ru song/ dzuho ti/ ༈dza hu tas/ s rnam bcad/ dzu hu taḥ/ dweḥ/ gnyis las so/ gnyis su brjod pa'i tha ma'i an+ti a tar bsgyur dgos te/ dzu hu an+ti ap/ dzu hu a ti/ hu'i u br song*/ drangs/ dzu hwa ti/ ༈ap la yon tan/ dzu ho ṣi/ ༈s rnams bcad/ dzu hu thaḥ/ ༈yang dzu hu tha/ ༈mip ni pit te yon tan no/ /dzuho mi/ ༈orba morbā lo paḥ/ ba ma la u dbyi ba yang na'o/ /pha rol rnam dbye wa ma gang rung byung na/ tshu rol byings kyi mtha' yi u yig ni yang na dbyi bar bya ste/ 'dir 'grel pa las rkyen la gnas pa'i u dbyi bar dngos su bstan zhing*/ shugs la gzhan yang yod par bshad pa las/ rkyen gyi u yig dbyi ba skabs gzhan du 'byung*/ 'dir gzhan dbyi bar bshad pa de yin te/ byings sa la yod pa'i u yig yin pas so/ ༈des na mi 'phyid pa'i phyogs la dzu hu baḥ/ ༈dzu hu maḥ/ 'di la s rnam bcad ma gtogs pa'i rnam 'gyur med/ ༈dbyi ba'i phyogs la ha'i srog gi u phyis/ h ba'am ma la drangs/ rnam bcad byas pas/ dzu hwaḥ/ ༈dzu h+maḥ/ ༈de bzhin du ling la/ dzu hu yā tā/ dzu hu yā tāṃ/ dzu hu yuḥ/ dzu hu yā*/ dzu hu yā taṃ/ ༈dzu hu yā ta/ dzu hu yāṃ/ dzu hu yā ba/ dzu hu yā ma/ ༈de bzhin du loṭ la yon tan/ dzu ho tu/ /yang na dzu hu tāt/

dzu hu tāṃ/ an+tu la a tar bsgyur/ hu yi up/ dzu hwa tu/ her+dhiḥ/ hi dhi'o/ skabs 'dir/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi ni dhi ru bsgyur ba ste/ dzu hu dhi/ yang na/ dzu hu tā t zhes pa'o/ /dzu hu taṃ/ dzu hu ta/ ā ni p la pit yon tan no/ /dzu ha bā ni/ de bzhin du yon tan te/ dzu ha bā ba/ dzu ha bā ma/ zhes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du lang zhes pa la thams cad kyi 'gor aṭ sbyar/ dzu hu dip/ p dang i phyis/ hu yon tan/ dt/ a dza ho ta/ a dzu hu tāṃ/ a n us/ an ni us so/ gnyis su brjod pa'i skabs 'dir/ deng min skyes bu dang bo'i ming tshiga.an ni us su bsgyur ba yin no/ /dzu hu an bzhag/an us su bsgyur/ dzu ho o ab/ drangs/ s rnam bcad/ a dzu ha buḥ/ ༈sip ni bit yin pas/ hu la yon tan/ p dang i phyis/ s rnam bcad/ a dzu hoḥ/ a dzu hu taṃ/ a dzu hu ta/ ༈a mip la p dang i phyis/ yon tan o ab/ drangs/ mng ro/ /a dzu ha baṃ/ ba ma la bs mas bzhin sgrub ste/ hu'i u phyis na/ a dzu hwa/ a dzu h+ma/ ༈ma phyis na/ a dzu hu ba/ a dzu hu ma/ de ltar na byings hu la pa ra smai pa ti sbyar ba'o/ ༈ /da ni gnyis brjod pa'i āh+ma ne'i dper brjod ni/ de yang ḍubhṛt gnas pa dang rgyas pa la'o/ /o hāng 'gro ba la'o/ /māng mchod pa la'o/ /zhes pa rkyen 'di gsum ni/ bhṛ la sogs pa zhes tha snyad byed do/ ༈de las skabs 'dir o hāng dper brjod du bzung ngo*/ /hra swaḥ/ thung ngu'o/ /de yang byings gnyis 'phel ba'i thog ma ste/ gral 'go na yod pa de sngar ring po las phyis thung ngur bsgyur bar bya'o/ bhṛ yāṃ lu ki /bhṛny rnams kyi 'jig go 'dir o hāng yang bhṛ la sogs pa ste/ 'di rnams la byings dang po'i srog gi a yig ni/ i yig tu bsgyur ba dang*/'jig pa gnyis yod do/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ gnyis nyid dag la mi snang ba rjes su 'jug ste/

ī yig yang ngo*/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas/ byings gnyis su brjod pa'i skabs 'dir/ pha rol dbyangs thog ma can gyi rkyen la/ pati? ma yin par ngit du yod na byings kyi mtha'i a yig dbyi ba yin zhing*/ ha sa te gsal byed thog ma can gyi rkyen di ta byung na/ byings kyi mtha'i ā yig ī yig tu 'gyur ba yin no// de yang ohāng ྄ng khyad don/ o ni bya ba'i don/ hā te zhes pa bzhag go /ap phyis/ byings nyis 'gyur gcig gong du bzhag/thung ngu'o zhes pas hā snga ma thung ngur song*/ ku dang ha'i tsu'o/ ha dzha/ dzha sa rnams kyi dza ba'o/ /zhes pas dzha dza ru song*/ bhṛ i rnams kyi 'jig go /zhes pas byings dang po'i srog gi a ni ir bsgyur te/ dzi hā zhes pa byung*/ te'i ta ni gsal byed thog ma can yin pas/ byings mtha' hā yi srog ā ni ī ring por 'gyur/ dzi hī te/ de bzhin du/ dzi hā sgrub tshul thams cad la 'dra/ dzi hā ā te zhes pa bzhag/ā te ni dbyangs thog ma can gyi rkyen yin pas/ dzi hā'i srog ā ring po phyis/ ha ni ā te'i ā dang sbyor/ dzi hā te/ de gnyis kar pit kyi rkyen ma yin no/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ an+te ྄a ter bsgyur/ dzi ha te/ ༈ku i la/ dzi he ṣe/ dzi hā the/ dzi hī dh+we/ ༈dzi he/ dzi hī ba he/ dzihī ma he/ ༈ling la dzi hī ta/ 'di'i hī ring po ni gsal byed kyi rkyen las byings mtha' īr gyur pa ma yin/ dbyangs rkyen yin pas/ byings mtha'i ā ring po phyis nas/ rkyen gyi ī la h drangs pa yin te phyi ma brgyad la'ang 'di bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /dzi hī yā tāṃ/ dzi hī ran/ ༈dzi hī thāḥ/ dzi hī yā thāṃ/ dzi hī dh+waṃ/ ༈dzi hī ya/ dzi hī ba hi/ dzi hī ma hi rnams so/ ༈loṭ kyi sde rnams la/ sngar bshad pa'i dbyangs gsal thog ma can rnams dran par byas te/ dzi hī tāṃ/ dzi hā taṃ/ a tar bsgyur/

dzi ha tāṃ/ ༈sa ṣa ru song*/ dzi hī ṣ+wa/ dzi hā thaṃ/ dzi hī dh+waṃ/ ༈dzi hai/ dzi hā ba hai/ dzi hā ma hai/ ༈lang gi rkyen la aṭ sngon du bzhagatan gyi n phyis/ a dzi hī ta/ a dzi hā tāṃ/ a tar bsgyur/ a dzi ha ta/ ༈a dzi hī thaḥ/ a dzi hā thāṃ/ a dzi hī dh+waṃ/ ༈a dzi hi/ a dzi hī ba hi/ a dzi hī ma hi/ zhes pa'o/ ༈o hāk gtong ba la'o/ k rjes 'brel/ o brjod don/ dang por la ṭ pa ra smai'i dbang du byas te/ hā hip zhes pa bzhaga.ap 'jigahā gnyis 'phel/ hā gong ma thung ngu ha ru bsgyur/ de dzha dang*/ de yang dza ru bsgyur te/ dza hā ti/ 'di pit yin pas mtha'i ā dbyi ba dang*/ ī ring bor bsgyur ba gnyis kar med do/ ༈hā tas/ 'di gsal byed thog ma can yin pas byings mtha' ī ring por bsgyur/ dza hī taḥ/ ༈dza hā in+ta a ti ra bsgyur/ hā'i srog ā phyis/ h a ti'i a la drangs/ dza ha ti/ ༈de ltar gsum po de mtshon byed du byas nas rigs 'gre ste/ pit yin min gyi khyad dang*/ ngit la yang gsal byed dang po can dang dbyangs dang po can gyi dbye ba so sor shes par bya ste/ dza hā si/ dza hī thaḥ/ dza hī tha/ ༈dza hā mi/ dza hī baḥ/ dza hī maḥ/ zhes so/ ༈'dir dza hā nyid yā t la sogs pa rnams kyi a dbyi'i zhes/ mdo gzhan las bshad pas/ byings dza hā la yāt la sogs pa/ ling pa ra smai rkyen dgu po gang byung kyang*/ hā'i ā ring po phyis te h yig yā yi steng du 'dren pa yin no/ /dza h+yat/ dza h+yā tāṃ/ dzah+yuḥ/ ༈dzah+yāḥ/ dzah+yā tāṃ/ dza h+yāṃ ta/ ༈dza h+yāṃ/ dza h+yā ba/ dza h+yā ma/ ༈loṭ yi pa ra smai/ dza hā tu/ yang na dza hī tāt/ 'di sngar pit yin pa de tāt ru bsgyur zin pa na/ 'gyur nas ngit gsal byed dang po can du song bas/ byings mtha'i ā yig ī yig ring por bsgyur ba yin te/ don 'di sngar phyi mang po gcig tu 'khyer dgos pa yod do/ ༈ /de bzhin du/

dza hī tāṃ/ ༈ an+tu/ a tur bsgyur/ ā phyis/ dza ha tu/ ༈ īrbā hau/ hi la i ī yang na'o/ /skabs 'dir rnam dbye hi la sngar bshad pa ltar gyi rnam 'gyur med pa dang*/ tātang du bsgyur ba gnyis thun mong dkyus 'gro yin la/ 'dir ohāk gi byings la byings mtha'i ā i thung ngu'am/ ī ring po gang rung du bsgyur ba 'di nyid kyi dgos chos yin/ spyi 'gros dang dgos chos gdam kha yin pas/ 'di la rnam 'gyur bzhi 'byung ngo*/ /dza hā hi/ dza hī tā t/ spyir 'gros gnyis so/ dza hī hi/ dza hi hi/ dgos chos gnyis so/ ༈de bzhin du/ dza hī tāṃ/ ༈dza hī ta/ ༈ā nip la p dang i phyis/ pat yin pas byings mtha' la rnam 'gyur gzhan med/ rkyen gyi ā mtshungs 'dra sbyar/ dza hā ni/ de dang 'dra bar mtshungs 'dra sbyar bas/ dza hā ba/ ༈dza hā ma/ ༈la da pa ra smai ni/ 'di rnams la aṭ sngon du bzhag/dza hā dip/ 'di 'dra'i rigs gsal byed snga ma can yin yang*/ pit yin pas/ hā la rnam 'gyur med/ dip kyi p dang i phyis/ d t ru song*/ a dza hā t/ de bzhin du/ a dza hī tāṃ/ ༈yang a dza hā/ an us su bsgyur/ u s+yā lo paḥ/ us kyi ā dbyi'o/ /rkyen an zhes pa us zhes par bsgyur zhing/ o hāk gi skabs 'dir rkyen us kyi nus pas/ byings mtha'i ā ring po phyis par 'gyur/ h u la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ a dza huḥ/ ༈sip kyi p dang i phyis/ s rnam bcad/ pit yin pas gzhan rnam 'gyur med/ a dza hāḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ a dza hī tāṃ/ a dza hī ta/ ༈a mip la p i phyis/ 'dra ba/ m nga ro/ a dza hāṃ/ a dza hī ba/ a dza hī ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ḍudāny sbyin pa la'o/ /ny yig gnyis ka'i don/ ḍu yig ḍit ky-i bya ba'i don/ gnyis ka khyad don yin pas phyis/ dā tip zhes pa bzhag/byings nyis 'gyur/ snga ma thung ngu*/ da dā ti/ ༈dā deḥ/ dā la sogs pa'o/ /ḍu dāny la sogs pa'i byings gnyis su brjod pa dag la/

dā phyi ma'i dbyangs ā yig ni pha rol du pit ma yin pa/ ngit kyi rnam dbye dbyangs gsal thog ma gang yin yang 'dra ste dbyi bar bya ba yin no/ de ltar na da dā grub par byas te pha rol du tas bzhag/'di gsal byed dang po can gyi di t yin pas/ dā phyi ma'i srog gi ā ring po phyis/ d dbyangs med t ru song*/ rkyen gyi steng du drangs/ s rnam bcad/ dat+taḥ/ ༈da dā/ an+ti zhes pa bzhag/a tir bsgyur/ ā phyis/ d dbyangs med rkyen gyi a la drangs/ da da ti/ ༈'dis mtshon nas gsal byed thog ma can rnams la/ d srog med rkyen gyi yi ge dang rtseg dgos/ yi ge'i grogs kyi dbang gis t ru bsgyur ba'am/ d nyid du gnas pa ci rigs yin/ dbyangs thog ma can gyi ngit rnams la d srog med rkyen gyi dbyangs rnams la 'dren no/ /de ltar na/ da d si/ dad+thaḥ/ dad+tha/ ༈da dā mi/ dad+baḥ dad+maḥ'ajug bzhin pa'i pa ra smai'o/ ༈da ni 'di dag la dā phyi ma'i ā phyis te/ rkyen gyi ya'i steng du 'dren pa kho na ste/ da d+yāt/ da d+yā tāṃ/ da d+yuḥ/ ༈da d+yāḥ/ da d+yāḥ tāṃ/ da d+yā ta/ ༈da d+yāṃ/ da d+ya ba/ da d+yā ma/ chog 'byung gi pa ra smai'o/ ༈ da dā tu/ yang na/ dat+tāt/ dat+tāṃ/ an+tu a tur bsgyur/ dā'i ā dbyi/ da da tu/ ༈dāṃ hau/ da rnams kyi hi la'o/ /rkyen hi pha rol du mthong na/ dā gnyis yod pa'i thog ma dbyi zhing*/ phyi ma'i dbyangs ā ring po e yig tu bsgyur dgos pa'i don no/ /de yang dā hi zhes pa bzhag/byings nyis 'gyur/ dā dā hi zhes pa byung*/ dā dang po phyis te/ phyi ma'i dbyangs e ru bsgyur pas/ de hi/ ༈yang na spyi 'gros kyi hi tā tad du bsgyur/ dā yi byings kyi dgos chos la phyi ma'i dbyangs phyis pas/ da t+tāt/ ༈de bzhin du/ dat+taṃ/ ༈dat+ta/ ༈a nip sogs gsum la mtshungs pa sbyar ba ste/ da dā ni/ da dā ba/ da dā ma/ shis byed kyi pa ra smai rnams so/

༈dip sogs kun la aṭ thog mar sbyar/ a da dā/ dip p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ d t/ a da dāt/ ༈de bzhin du/ a dat+tāṃ/ ༈an us/ a da duḥ/ ༈a da dāḥ/ a dat+taṃ/ a dat+ta/ a da dāṃ/ p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ a 'dra ba/ m nga ro yin par go dgos/ ༈a dad+ba/ a dad+ma/ deng min pa'i pa ra smai rnams so/ ༈da ni ād+ma ne tshig can la/ pit rnams bor ba'i ngit kyi rkyen dbyangs thog ma can dang ha sa thog ma can gang yin yang 'dra ste byings nyis 'gyur gyi phyis ma'i dbyangs/ ā ring po ni dbyi bar bya ba 'ba' zhig go /༈ da dā te zhes pa bzhag/byings kyi dā phyi ma'i dbyangs ā ring po phyis/ d t r song*/ rkyen gyi ta'i steng du drangs/ dat+te/ ༈da dā/ ā te zhes pa bzhag/ byings rting ma'i ā phyis/ d dbyangs med rkyen gyi a la drangs/ da dā te/ ༈an+te a ter bsgyur/ da da te/ ༈de bzhin d dbyangs med tar bsgyur/ dat+se/ da dā the/ dad+dh+we/ ༈da de/ dad+bahe/ dad+ma he/ 'byung bzhin pa'i at+ma ne'o/ ༈dadā ī ta/ zhes pa bzhag/dī'i ā phyis/ rkyen gyi ī dang sbyar/ da dī ta/ des rigs 'gre ste/ da dī yā tāṃ/ da dī ran/ ༈da dī thaḥ/ da dī yā thā/ ༈da dī taṃ/da dī ya/ da dī ba hi/ da dī ma hi/ cho ga 'byung gi āt+ma ne'o/ ༈dkyus bzhin du/ dat+tāṃ/ da dā tā/ a ta ru bsgyur/ da da taṃ/ ༈dat+s+wa/ da dā thāṃ/ dad+dh+waṃ/ ༈da dā aip zhes pa bzhag/e ai la ai'o/ da dai/ phyi ma 'di gnyis la 'dra ba sbyar/ da dā ba hai/ da dā ma hai/ shis byed kyi āt+ma ne rnams so/ ༈da ni 'di rnams la aṭ sbyor te/ da dā tan zhes pa bzhag/gong du aṭ/ n rjes 'brel/ dā'i dbyangs phyis/ t ru song*/ rkyen gyi ta la drangs/ a dat+ta/ ༈a da dā tāṃ/ ༈a ta ru bsgyur/ a da data/ ༈a da t+thaḥ/ a da dā thāṃ/ a dad+dh+waṃ/ ༈a da di/ a dadwa hi/ a dad+ma hi/ deng min pa'i āt+ma ne rnams so/ ༈ḍudhāny 'dzin pa dang rgyas pa la'o/

/zhes pa'i byings la/ ḍu dang ny phyis/ dhā bzhag go /de yang laṭ gyi gzhan don gyi rkyen las/ ༈dhā tip/ p rjes 'brel/ ap 'jig/byings nyis 'gyur/ dhā gong ma thung ngur bsgyur/ dzha pa rnams dza ba'o/ /zhes pas dha thung ngu de da ru song*/ da dhī ta/ ༈pūrba s+ya ngi ti dzha se dhaḥ/ ngit dzha sa la dang po'i dha'o/ /byings dza ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge can yin la/ pha rol tu rnam dbye dit yin pa/ dza (dzha )sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin pa byung na/ byings snga ma da yig ni/ dha yig tu bsgyur ba yin te/ skabs gzhan du ni/ gdod ma'i da yig dha yig tu bsgyur ba la dgongs pa yin mod kyang*/ 'dir ni dha yig da yig tu bsgyur ba de nyid/ slar yang dha yig tu bsgyur dgos so/ /nges pa 'di yang*/ ḍudhā ny la sogs pa 'ga' zhig la yin gyi/ kun la 'jug par ma nges so/ /'dir dzha sa zhes pa ka lā par mthar gnas dang rjes su sna ldan ma yin pa'i gsal byed dhu ṭ'o/ /zhes pa dang phal cher gcig ste/ 'on kyang 'dir ha yig bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /de'i phyir rnam dbye 'di rnams kyi nang na/ gsal byed dang por yod pa'i rkyen la/ mip/ mas/ ma hai/ ma/ ma hi/ yāt sogs dgu rnams/ dzha sa so sor bsdu ba ma yin pa/ bs/ ba he/ ba/ ba hi ste bzhi po 'di rnams mthar gnas yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dzha sa'i lugs mi byed pa dang*/ pa sde gsum pa yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dzha sa'i lugs kyi bya ba byed par 'dod pa gnyis yod cing*/ gzhung 'di na'ang ci rigs pa las/ pa sde'i lugs gtso che bar 'dod do/ ༈dhā tas ap/ gnyis brjod/ dhā gong ma da thung ngu/ slar yang dha ru log ste thung ngu nyid/ dhā phyi ma'i a phyis/ dha d ru song*/ de t ru song*/ drangs/ dhat+taḥ/ ༈bit rnams dang dbyangs dang po can la/ da yig dha yig tu bsgyur ba med/ an+ti a tir bsgyur/ a phyis/ drangs/ da dha ti/

༈da dhā si/ ༈dhat+thaḥ/ ༈bhat+tha/ da dhā mi/ ༈pa sde'i dbang du byas na/ dad+baḥ/ ༈mthar gnas kyi dbang du byas na/ dadh+waḥ/ ༈dadh+maḥ/ ༈dad+maḥ/ ling ki gzhan don la/ gong dā'i byings kyi rigs 'gre ste/ da dh+yā t/ ༈da dh+yā tāṃ/ ༈da dh+yuḥ/ ༈da dh+yāḥ/ ༈da dh+yā taṃ/ ༈da dh+yā ta/ ༈da dh+yāṃ/ ༈da dha ba/ ༈da bha ma/ ༈lo ṭa'i gzhan don la/ da dhā tu/ yang*/ dhāt+tāt/ ༈dhāt+tāṃ/ ༈an+tu a tur bsgyur/ da dhā tu/ ༈hi'i skabs 'dir/ da rnams kyi hi la'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ byings gong ma da phyis/ phyi ma'i dbyangs e ru bsgyur bas/ dhe hi/ yang na/ dhāt+tāt/ ༈dhat+taṃ/ ༈dha ta/ ༈da dhā ni/ ༈da dhā ba/ ༈da dā ma/ ༈lang gi gzhan don ni/ da dhā dip/ aṭ/ a da dhāt/ ༈a dhāt+tāṃ/ an us su bsgyur/ dhā'i ā phyis te drangs/ a da dhuḥ/ ༈a da dhāḥ/ ༈a dha t+tāṃ/ ༈a dhat+ta/ ༈a da dhāṃ/ ༈a da dh+wa/ ༈a dadh+ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈da ni bdag don gyi rnam dbye las/ laṭ yi bdag don ni/ dhat+te/ ༈da dha te/ ༈an+te a ter bsgyur/ da dha te/ ༈dhat+se/ ༈da dhā the/ ༈dhad+dh+we/ ༈dadhe/ ༈dhad+ba he/ ༈dhad+ma he/ ༈ling gi bdag don ni/ da dhī ta/ da dhī yā tāṃ/ ༈da dhī ran/ ༈da dhī thāḥ/ ༈da dhī yā thaṃ/ ༈da dhī dhā༈da dhī ya/ ༈da dhī ba hi/ ༈da dhī ma hi/ ༈loṭ'i bdag don ni/ dhat+tāṃ/ ༈da dhā tāṃ/ ༈a tar bsgyur/ da da tāṃ/ ༈dhat+s+wa/ ༈da dhā thaṃ/ ༈dhad+dh+waṃ/ ༈e ai la ai/ da dhai mtshungs pa sbyar/ da dhā ba hai/ ༈da dhā ma hai/ ༈lang gi bdag don ni/ thams cad la a thog mar sbyar/ tan gyi n rjes 'brel/ ā dhat+ta/ ༈a da dhā tāṃ/ ༈a da dha ta/ ༈a dat+thaḥ/ ༈a da dhā thaṃ/ ༈a dhad+dh+waṃ/ ༈a da dhi/ ༈a da dh+wa hi/ ༈a dadh+ma hi/ zhes pa rnams so/ /de rnams ni 'jig pa bi ka ra ṇa'i sde tshan te/ thams cad du ap 'jig pa go bar bya'o/ ༈ /dip rtsed mo dang rgyal bar 'dod pa dang*/ 'du 'god dang gsal ba dang bstod pa dang*/ rmi lam dang dga' ba dang myos pa dang 'gro ba rnams

la'o/ /zhes pas byings dip zhes pa bzhag go /byings mdo sngar bsgyur ba na/ rgyal 'dod kyi skad dod/ bi dzi gī rdo bar 'dod pa dang*/ bya ba hā ra tha snyad du bsgyur ba spyir de yin mod kyang*/ 'dir 'du 'god kyi don yin/ d+yu ti/ sdu gu zhes bar bsgyur 'dug/rmi lam dga' myos gsum mi snang ngo*/ /di bā der+yaḥ/ dip la sogs pa la ya'o/ /dip la sogs pa'i byings kyi tshogs rnams la/ ti p la sogs pa'i rnam dbye sum cu rtsa drug byin pa'i tshe/ bar gyi rkyen du ya bi kā ra ṇa 'byung ngo*/ /ya'o zhes pas/ ap kyi rkyen mi 'jug pa shugs las 'phangs so/ /gong du i up dag ra ba ha sa la'o/ zhes 'byung bas/ rkyen la ra dang ba dang ha sa dag yod na/ byings kyi thog ma'i dbyangs de ring por 'gyur ro/ /des na 'dir/ dip tip zhes pa bzhag /bar du rkyen ya byin/ ya ni ha sa'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ di'i ī ring por 'gyur/ p dbyangs med ya'i steng du drangs/ dī bya ti/ ༈tas la sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra/ dī bya taḥ/ ༈an+ti la rkyen ya'i dbyangs a phyis/ y dbyangs med an dang sbyar/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ dī byan+ti/ ༈des mtshon te thams cad la rkyen ya byin/ dī ring por song*/ b ya la drangs pas/ dī bya zhes 'byung ba go bar byas te/ de la rnam dbye sbyar ba'i lus 'gyur so sor byed do/ /dī bya si/ ༈dī bya thaḥ/ ༈dī bya tha/ ༈dī byā mi/ ༈dī byā baḥ/ ༈dī byā maḥ/ de gsum la ba ma dag la ā'o/ zhes pa dran par bya'o/ ༈yāt sogs las yus yām spangs pa'i bdun po la yā rnams i yig tu bsgyur zhing*/ de ya bi kā ra ṇa la/ a i la e zhes mtshams sbyor rgyu yin/ ༈yus kyi skabs/ yu la rnam 'gyur med/ ya ba'i mthar/ iṭ ā ga ma 'jug ste/ ya bi dang mtshams sbyor byed pa yin/ ༈yām gyi skabs su yām i yam du bsgyur nas mtshams sbyor ro/

/de ltar byas pas gzugs 'di bzhin du 'byung ste/ dī bye t/ ༈dī bye tāṃ/ dī bye yuḥ/ ༈dī byeḥ/ ༈dī bye tāṃ/ ༈dī byeta/ ༈dī bye yaṃ/ ༈dī bya ba/ ༈dī bya ma/ zhes so/ ༈tup sogs la/ dī bya tu/ yang na/ dī byā tāta/ ༈dī byā tāṃ/ ya bi'i a phyis/ bya dbyangs med an dang sbyar/ dībyan+tu/ rkyen hi ni a mtha' la dbyi ba'am/ yang na ta tang du bsgyur ro/ /dī bya/ dī bya tāt/ ༈dī bya tāṃ/ ༈di bya ta/ ༈dī byā ni/ dī byā ba/ dī byā ma/ de gsum la 'dra ba ring po'o/ ༈rnam dbye dip sogs ni thams cad la aṭ mgor sbyar/ ip phyis pas/ dip d ru song*/ de t ru song*/ a dī byat/ ༈a dī bya tāṃ/ ༈an gyi skabs ya bi'i a phyis/ ya phar drangs/ a dī byan/ ༈sip rnam bcad/ a dī byaḥ/ ༈a dī bya tāṃ/ ༈a dī bya ta/ ༈a mip kyi skabs 'dir/ ya'i a phyis/ pha rol a la drangs/ m nga ro/ a dī byaṃ/ ༈ba ma la ā dran/ a dī byā ba/ ༈a dī byā ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ /dip pa ra smai pa ti yin pas/ bdag don gyi rkyen rnams mi 'jug go /༈ṣuny gcod cing rdung ba la'o/ /ā d+yaḥṣ+ṇaḥsnaḥ/ dang po'i ṣa ṇa ni sa na'o/ /byings kyi thog ma'i yi ge ṣa yig yod na/ sa yig du 'gyur ba dang*/ ṭa sde'i ṇa yig yod na/ ta sde'i na yig tu 'gyur/ zhes pa ste rkyen rnams dang phrad pa'i nus pa'o/ /swā dernuḥ/ su la sogs pa la nu'o/ /'dir byings ṣuny ni su zhes par 'gro ba yin pas/ su ste ṣuny la sogs pa'i byings kyi tshogs pa la pha rol tu byings thams cad pa'i rkyen sde tshan bzhi po gang byung yang*/ bar du rkyen nu bi ka ra ṇa 'jug par bya'o/ gal te byings la dang por ṣa yig yod na sa yig dang*/ ṇa yig yod na na yig tu 'gyur ba yang skabs 'dir yin no/ prā d+ya sh+tsa ta thā tau su na māṃ/ su dang na ma dag pa la sogs pa rnams kyi de ltar gnyis po'o/ ṣu la sogs pa dang ṇam la sogs pa'i byings kyi/

ṣa yig dang ṇa yig de dag tip sogs rnam dbye nu bi dang bcas pa phrad pa las sa dang nar song ba de la nyer sgyur mi sbyor na de ka gnas mod de dag la sngon du pra la sogs pa'i nyer sgyur nyi shu po gang bzhag kyang 'dra ste/ sa dang na gnyis po rang gi sngon gyi gnas ṣa yig dang*/ ṇa yig nyid du slar ldog ste 'gro ba yin no/ /nū pa/ nu dang u ba'o/ /pha rol pit kyi rnam dbye yod na nu bi kā ra dang*/ u bi kā ra ṇa'i rkyen yod pa de'i mtha'i dbyangs la yon tan du 'gyur te/ nyer sgyur yod med gnyis kar la 'dra'o/ /don de ltar yid la bzhag nas/ ༈ṣuny tipa/྄ ny dang p phyis/ bar du nu bi bzhag ṣa sa ru song*/ rkyen nu la yon tan te no/ su no ti/ zhes pa grub/ ༈yang ṣa sa ru bsgyur ba'i mtshams nas/ thog mar a bhi bzhags ṣa ru ldogaṣa ra ṛ sogs nu ṇur song*/ yon tan ṇo/ a bh-i ṣu ṇo ti/ mngon par gcod cing rdung bar byed/ ces pa ste/ de'i don yang*/ so maṃ so ma yā dzi/ mchod pa'i don du so ma rdung bar byed ces so/ /de la so ma ni so ma bal+li te/ rtswi zhib bcad cing brdungs chu la gnyis te khu ba 'thungs nas lha mchod par byed do/ ༈de bzhin du sbyar te/ ṣuny tas/ nu ṣu sa ru bsgyur/ 'di ngit yin pas nu la yon tan med/ su nu taḥ/ ༈ṣu an+ti nu na bi u ba/ an dang sbyar/ su n+wan+ti/ ༈su no ṣi/ 'di la yon tan dang ku i la byung*/ ༈su nu thaḥ/ ༈su nu tha/ ༈su no mi/ 'di la tip kyi yon tan yin/ ༈ba ma dag la yang na u dbyi bar dran par byas te/ de yang skabs 'dir nu bi'i u dbyi ba yin no/ / dbyi ba'i phyogs la/ sunab/ sun+ma/ ༈u bi mi dbyi na/ su nu baḥ/ su nu maḥ/ ༈yāt sogs la rnam 'gyur gsar ba med te/ su nu yā t/ ༈su nu yā tāṃ/ ༈su nu yuḥ/ ༈su nu yāḥ/ ༈su nu yā tāṃ/ ༈su nu yā ta/ ༈su nu yāṃḥ/ ༈su nu yā ba/ ༈su nu yā ma/

༈tup sogs la/ su no tu/ 'di pit yin pas yon tan no/ /yang na su nu tāt/ ༈su nu tāṃ/ ༈su n+wan+tu/ 'di ubr song ba yin no/ ༈orbā heḥ/ u ni hi la yang na'o/ /rkyen gyi mtha'i u yig ste/ skabs 'dir ni nu bi'i u'o/ /u yig de dag gi pha rol tu rnam dbye hi byung na spyir btang la hi 'jig pa yin pas/ su nu/ ༈yang spyir dgos kyi gdam ka tā tang du yang bsgyur bas/ su nu tāt 'byung*/ 'dir ni yang na'o zhes bzung bas/ byings kyi mtha' u yig yin kyang*/ yi ge rab sbyor dang 'brel na mi 'gyur te/ tak+ṣu dang*/ twak+ṣu phra mo'i don la'o/ /zhes pa lta bu'i byings la hi 'jig pa yang min/ rnam 'gyur yang med par rang gnas te/ k+ṣu'i u phyis/ na ṇa/ tak+ṣ+ṇu hi/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈yang su nu tāṃ/ ༈su nu ta/ ༈su na bā ni/ ༈su na bā ba/ ༈su na bā ma/ de gsum la pit yon tan/ o ab byung ba'o/ ༈dip sogs la/ aṭ gong*/ yon tan/ rjes 'brel dang brjod don phyis/ dt/ a su no t/ ༈u su nu tāṃ/ ༈an gyi skabs su/ nu'i ubar song*/ sbyar bas/ a su n+wan/ ༈sip pita yin yon tan/ a su noḥ/ ༈a su tāṃ/ ༈u su ta/ ༈a mip la u yon tan/ o a b sbyar bas/ a su na baṃ/ ༈u su nu pa/ ༈a su nu ma/ zhes so/ ༈ru dhir sgribs pa la'o/ ru dhir zhes pa byings so/ /at las ir yang na'o/ /zhes pa'-i khyad par dang rjes 'brel yin pas i dang r phyis/ ru dh zhes pa lus so/ /ru dhā dernam/ ru dha la sogs pa la nam'o/ /byings ru dha la sogs pa'i tshogs pa rnams la nam bi kā ra ṇa rkyen du 'jug ste/ de yang byings kyi yi ge ru dang dha gnyis so sor phye ba'i dbus sam bar du 'jug rgyu yin/ m ni gnas la rab tu brten pa'i don te/ dbyi bar 'grel ba las bshad/ de'i gnas sa rab tu brten pa'i skad dod/ s+thā na bi dhā na zhes pa yod pa'i/ s+thā na gnas te dbus kyi don yin/

de yang byings 'di'i thog mtha' gnyis ma yin dkyil du dgos pa'o/ /ta thor+dhaḥ/ ta dang tha yi dha'o/ /byings kyi mtha' la dzha bha so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod la pha rol rnam dbye'i thog mar tha yig dang ta yig yod na/ ta dang tha de dag dha yig tu bsgyur bar bya ba las/ 'di dzha bha'i nang gi dha yig go /dzha ba bhal dza ba'o/ /zhes pas byings kyi dh dbyangs med de d ru bsgyur nas pha rol tu 'dren pa shas che'o/ /rnam dbye la dzha ba bha so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod na de bzhin yin la/ rnam dbye'i thog ma dbyangs yin na/ dha dbyangs med dbyangs dang sbyor/ rkyen pit rnams la nam gyi na'i srog ma phyis par 'jog pas/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs kyis na ṇa ru bsgyur/ rnam dbye pit byung na 'di lta ste/ na ma so3s+ya/ nam dang u su dag gi'o/ /nam bi kā ra ṇa'i rkyen gyi na'i srog a dang*/ byings a su zhes pa'i a ni/ rnam dbye ngit pha rol la dbyi ba yin te/ de las 'dir skabs don nam'o/ /ru dha'i skabs 'dir pit la nam gyi na'i dbyangs mi dbyi bas na srog can de ru'i ra mthong bas ṇa ru song ba yin pas ṇa yod nga ro med/ ngit la nam gyi na'i a dbyi bas n dbyangs med ṇ ru mi 'gro nga ror song bas ruṃ zhes nga ro byung tshad nam rnam 'gyur du shes so/ ༈de yang rudha tip zhes pa bzhag/ru dha sogs la nam'o zhes pas/ ru dang dha'i bar du nam/ m rjes 'brel/ rnam dbye 'di pit yin pas na'i srog mi 'phyid/ na dbyangs ldan yin pas/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs ṇa ru song*/ ta dang tha'i dha'o zhes rnam dbye'i ta yig dha ru bsgyur/ srog rang gnas yin pas/ ti dha ru song*/ byings kyi dh+wa dr bsgyur/ drangs/ ru ṇad+dhi/ zhes pa grub bo/ ༈de bzhin du/ rudha tas zhes pa bzhag/nam m rjes 'brel/ nam a su dag gi'o zhes te/ rnam dbye 'di ngit yin pas na'i srog gi a phyis/

n dbyangs med nga ror song*/ ru'i steng du bris/ rnam dbye'i ta dha ru song*/ byings kyi dha d ru song ba de'i steng du drangs/ s rnam bcad/ ruṃd+dhaḥ/ ༈yang rudha/ an+ti zhes pa bzhaganam m rjes 'brel/ ngit la na'i a phyis/ ru'i steng du nga ro ru song*/ /byings kyi dha rkyen gyi an la drangs/ 'di dbyangs yin dzha bha ma yin pas dh d ru bsgyur mi dgos so/ /ruṃ dhan+ti/ de gsum pos phal cher la rigs 'gre ba go bar bya/ ༈rudha sip p rjes 'brel/ nam na ṇa kha sa la sogs dh t ru song*/ drangs/ ru ṇat+si/ ༈ruṃd+dhaḥ/ ༈ruṃd+dha/ 'di gnyis ngit yin/ tha dha ru bsgyur ba yin/ rnam dbye'i thog ma dbyangs yin pa rnams dang*/ ma dang ya rnams dzha ba bha'i yi ge ma yin pas/ byings mtha'i dh d ru mi 'gyur dh nyid du gnas/ bs ba he sogs ba yig pa sder byed na dzha ba bhayin mod kyang*/ 'dir mthar gnas su byed pa gtso che bas ma dang 'dra/ dbyangs rnams dang phrad na dh'i srog tu 'jug/ba ma ya rnams la de dag gi steng du 'dren/ an+ti dang a thai lta bu ta yig dang tha yig rjes la yod kyang nus pa med/ tas dang thas lta bu'i ta tha thog mar yod pa rnams kyi gsal byed ta dang tha gnyis dhar bsgyur/ dbyangs dang nga ro rang gnas yin pas/ de dag ma brjed par dran par bya/ tup hi dip sip phyi ma rnams la dmigs gsal re yod do/ ༈de ltar na/ ru ṇadh+mi/ ༈ruṃ dh+waḥ/ ༈ruṃ dh+maḥ/ ༈yāt sogs la/ ruṃdh+yāt/ ruṃ dh+yā taṃ/ ruṃ dh+yuḥ/ ༈ruṃ dh+yāḥ/ ruṃ dh+yā taṃ/ ruṃ dh+yā ta/ ༈ruṃ dh+yāṃ/ ruṃ dh+yā ba/ ruṃ dh+yā ma/ ༈tup sogs la/ ru ṇad+dha yang na tā tang du bsgyur bas ngit tu song*/ na'i a dbyi dgos/ ruṃd+dhāta/ ruṃ d+dhāṃ/ ruṃ dhaṃ tu/ ༈dzha sād+dhir+heḥ/ dzha sa las hi dhi'o/ byings kyi tha ma dzha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod pa la/ rnam dbye hi byin na/ gzhan gsal byed kyi ngit spyi dang 'dra ba las/

hi nyid dhi ru 'gyur ro/ /'dir byings kyi dh nyid dzha sa'i yi ge'o/ /ruṃ d+dhi yang na tā tang bsgyur bas/ ruṃ d+dhāt/ rud+dhāṃ/ ruṃd+dhā/ ༈ru ṇa dhā ni/ ru ṇa dhā ba/ ru ṇa dhā ma/ de gsum pit yin pas na'i a mi dbyi/ rkyen dbyangs yin pas dha'i srog tu bzhag pa'o/ ༈dis+yor+ha sāt/ di si dag gi ha sa las so/ /de yang byings sam rkyen ha sa ste gsal byed mtha' can gyi pha rol tu byung ba'i dip dang sip ni dbyi bar bya'o/ /'dir sip ni dip sogs nyid kyi sip te/ tip tas sogs kyi sip gong du bstan zin to/ /sip snga ma ni p kho na rjes 'brel yin/ 'dir ni i dang p gnyis kar rjes 'brel yin pas/ gong 'og thams cad du 'di gnyis cho ga mi 'dra'o/ ༈ridh dip nam 'di pit yin/ na ṇa aṭ gong du bzhag/dip phyis/ byings kyi mtha'i dha yig ni dza ba d'am/ tsa pa ta ru bsgyur/ a ru ṇat a ru ṇad/ a ruṃ d+dhāṃ/ a ruṃd+dhān/ ༈daḥsaḥ/ da'i sa'o/ /dip sogs sip kyi skabs 'dir skye bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig sip nyid mi snang bar bya/ 'on kyang sip kyi yul te shul du gyur pa de'i nus pas/ byings kyi mtha'i dh yig de ni phal cher d ru gyur zhing*/ yang na t ru 'gyur/ t la slar bya ba med/ d ru bsgyur na mdo 'dis d yig sa yig tu bsgyur zhing*/ de yang rnam bcad do/ /a ru ṇaḥ/ a ru ṇat/ de bzhin du/ a ruṃd+dhaṃ/ a ruṃ d+dha/ ༈a ru ṇa dhāṃ/ a ruṃ dh+wa/ a ruṃ dh+ma/ ༈āt+ma ne yi tip tas sogs la/ te ād+ya sogs te/ ruṃ d+dhe/ ruṃ dhā te/ ruṃ dha te/ ༈ruṃt+se/ ruṃ dhā the/ ruṃ dh+we/ ruṃ dhe/ ruṃ dh+wa he/ rum dh+ma he/ ༈yāt sogs la/ ruṃ dhī ta/ ruṃ dhī yā taṃ/ ruṃ dhī ran/ ༈ruṃ dhī thaḥ/ ruṃ dhī yā thāṃ/ ruṃ dhī dh+waṃ/ ruṃ dhī ya/ ruṃ dhāṃ ba hi/ ruṃ dhī ma hi/ ༈tup sogs la ruṃd+dh+yāṃ/
