dzi hri yi ma zhes pa rnams so/ /de ltar na par ti ka'i lung drangs pa'i don bhī sogs byings bzhi po de rnams bsgrubs zin to/ ༈dzi rgyal ba la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag/ sa pa ro3k+ṣa yo rdze rgiḥ/ sa dang lkog gyur dag la dzi gi'o/ /dzi ṇap zhes pa bzhagaliṭ'i rnam dbye mthong bas dzi gi tu bsgyur gi gnyis brjod gi dang po slar yang dzir ldog/phyi ma rkyen gyi a mthong bas 'phel ba ai ke sha can du song*/ āy so sor drangs/ dzi gā ya/ 'di dag kyang gong bh+ri sogs kyis rigs 'gre ste/ dzi gya tu/ dzi gyuḥ/ ༈dzi ga yi tha/ yang na dzi ge tha/ dzi gya thuḥ/ dzigya/ ༈dzi gā ya/ yang na dzi ga ya/ dzi gyi ba/ dzi gyi ma/ zhes pa'o/ ༈lung drangs pa/ sems med dran nyams dang rdzun pa dang dus thung ngu dag la yang ṇap la sogs pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ste brgyal ba dang*/ myos pa dang*/ gnyid kyi bla brdol la sogs pa sems med kyi smra ba dang*/ bden pa ma yin pa'i don can gyi tshig dang*/ dus yun thung ngu rnams bzlas dus dang lkog gyur ma yin kyang*/ liṭ'i rnam dbye rnams 'jug pa'o/ ༈lap nga ro 'don pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings lap bzhag༈pha rol du ṇab ste a/ gnyis brjod p gong ma phyis/ a'i u pa dhā'i'o zhes pas/ la yig phyi ma'i dbyangs a thung ā ring du song*/ p phyi ma rkyen gyi a la drangs/ sngon du bi bzhagabi la lā pa grub/ bi med kyang chog ste la lā pa zhes so/ /su stonyahaṃ ki la bi la lā pa/ bdag nyid nyal ba bas ca co'i sgra 'byin no/ /ṇap gnyis pa la yang 'di dang 'dra ba las/ u pa dhā ring por byed mi byed gdam kha yin/ gzhan rnams la gnyis brjod kyi rjes la lap lap zhes pa gnyis kyi thog mar p dang po phyis/ de nas la dang po yang phyis shing la phyi ma'i dbyangs a yig de e yig tu bsgyur ba yin/ thap ba ma rnams la iṭ yang 'jug go /bi le pa tuḥ/ bi le puḥ/ ༈bi le pi tha/

bi le pa thuḥ/ bi le ba/ ༈bi la lā ba/ yang na bi la la pa/ bi le pi ba/ bi le pi ma/ zhes pa'o/ ༈gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /zhes pas byings gaml̥ bzhag /pha rol du ṇap ste a'o/ /l̥ bya ba'i don gam bzhag gnyis brjod dang po'i ha sa thog ma yal/ ga gam ku ha sogs kyis ga dang po dza ru bsgyur/ ga phyi ma a'i upadhā ring po/ dza gā m drangs pas/ dza gā ma/ nā haṃ ka liṃ gaṃ dza gā ma/ bdag ni ka ling kar ma byin no/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang dza gam zhes pa grub par byas nas/ rnam 'gyur rnams byed do/ /ga māṃ swa re/ gam rnams kyi dbyangs la'o/ /gam la sogs pa ni gam han/ dzan khan/ ghas te 'dir lnga bshad te gzhan yang ci rigs pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi pha rol du*/ p dang*/ ṇap ma gtogs pa'i atus sogs drug po rnams la/ u padhā mi snang bar byed dgos te/ skabs 'dir ga'i srog gi a sbed pa yin/ g dang m srog med lhan cig pha rol gyi dbyangs la 'dren dgos pas/ /p la phyogs gsum yod pa'i phyogs gcig dang*/ ba dang ma rnams la iṭ 'dren/ yang na thap la a dbyi ba mi dgos te pit kyi cho ga byed pa'i phyir ro/ /ṇap la'ang de dang 'dra/ des na ga'i a mi dbyi ba rigs la'ang gnyis te/ iṭ yod pa'i phyogs la/ gam gyi m i la 'dren/ med pa'i phyogs la m nga ror byed/ ṇap gnyis pa la u pa dhā ring por mi byed pa'ang gdam kha yin no/ /dza g+ma tuḥ/ dza g+muḥ/ ༈dzag+mi tha/ dza ga mi tha/ dza gaṃ tha/ dzag+ma thuḥ/ dzag+ma/ ༈dza gā ma/ dza ga ma/ dzag+mi ba/ dzig+mi ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ dza gā mā ga s+t+yod k+ṣī ṇāṃ di shaṃ/ yul lho phyogs rnams la ri byi 'gro bar byed do/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ha na 'tshe ba dang 'gro ba dag la'o/ /zhes pas byings ha na bzhag /na yig gi a yig brjod don/ ha n'i gha na'o zhes pas byings ha'i yig ni/ n mtha' dang rnam dbye'i ngit pha rol du yod na/

gha yig tu 'gyur ro/ 'di yang gnyis brjod yin pas/ dza ghā nar 'gyur te/ de'i dper brjod pa'i tshigs bcad ni 'grel par lung drangs ba/ mu rāṃ ga nā kadz+dza la lo pa lo lo/ / lak+ṣ+mi mu khāṃ bho dza bi lāpabhīd+gaḥ/ dza ga tra pa trā ṇa ta nu trabhu to/ /dza ghā na kaṃng+saṃ ki la bā su de baḥ/ gcod byed lha min yan lag ma yi mig sman byi/ /dpal mo'i gdong gi pad tshal rnam rol bung ba ni/ /'gro ba'i skyabs dang skyob pa phra bar 'jug pa can/ /mkhar ba nges par bcom pa nor lha'i bu 'di'o/ /zhes pa'i dza ghā na zhes pa 'di dper brjod du 'gyur bar dgongs pa ste/ 'dir 'joms pa'am gsod pa'i don yin la/ gzhan du 'gro bar byed pa'i yang don te/ 'das pa'i dus can la gtso bor 'jug go ༈de yang han ṇap zhes pa ste a bzhag/gnyis brjod n snga ma phyis/ ku ha sogs kyi ha dzhar song*/ de yang dza ba dza ru song*/ ha phyi ma han rnams kyi gh+na'o/ zhes gha ru bsgyur/ n'i upa dhā ring po/ n rkyen gyi a la drangs/ dza ghā na grub/ ༈a tus sogs la phal cher snga ma rnams dang khyad par du gam gyis rigs 'gre ste/ dbyangs rnams la u pa dhā phyis/ n dang h dbyangs med brtsegs te rnam dbye'i dbyangs la 'dren/ thap la iṭ yod med dbye ba gsum gong du 'dra/ ṇap phyi ma la a i phyed 'phel ba byed dam mi byed gdam kha/ ba ma rnams la iṭ ster ba kho na yin/ de yang gong du gam la sogs pa zhes gsungs te/ gam gyi bya ba de la 'dir han la'ang sbyor zhing*/ ghas'i bar la'ang 'dra bar dgongs so/ /ha ghar bsgyur ba ni 'di kho na'i dgos chos yin no/ /dza gh+nā tuḥ/ ༈dzagh+nuḥ/ ༈dza gh+ni tha/ yang na dza gha ni tha/ yang na dza ghaṃ tha/ dza gh+na thuḥ/ dza gh+na/ ༈dza ghā na/ dzagha na/ dza gh+nib/ dza gh+ni ma/ zhes pa'o/ ༈dzi nī skyed pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings/ dza nī/ ī ring po bya ba'i don/ 'di bdag don gyi tshig can yin pas rnam dbye e la sogs pa at+ma ne dgu po kho na 'jug go

/dzan e zhes pa bzhag/gnyis brjod n snga ma phyis/ dza phyi ma'i u pa dhā mi snang bar song*/ dza dzn zhes pa byung*/ dz phyi ma dang n dbyangs bral yin/ sa tu ni sha tsu rnams las sha tsu'o/ /zhes pas pha rol sa tu'i n nu tshur rol sha tsu'i dza mthong bas sha tsu'i ny yig tu song*/ dz ny 'dus pa dzha de rkyen gyi e la drangs/ dza dz+nye zhes pa grub/ dza dz+nye dza gadz+dza nārda nāt/ 'gro bas mchod las 'gro ba rnams skyes so/ /zhes pa ste ngag tu bkod pa'i dper brjod do/ ༈de kho na ltar dzan dza dz+nyar bsgyur ba yan chad kun la 'dra/ dzan ā te/ dza dz+nyā te/ ༈dzan i te/ dza dz+nyi te/ ༈dzan se iṭ/ ku i la dza dz+nyi ṣi/ ༈dzan ā the/ dza dz+nyā the/ ༈dzan dh+we/ iṭ/ dza dz+nyi dh+we/ dzan/ e/ dza dz+nye/ dzan ba he/ iṭ/ dza dz+nye ba he/ dzan ma hi/ iṭ dza dz+nyi ma he/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈kha na sa brko ba la'o zhes pas byings kha na bzhag/na'i a brjod don/ kha n ṇap gnyis brjod n dang po phyis/ kha tsha ru bsgyur/ de tsa ru bsgyur/ n'i u pa dhā ring na/ drangs/ tsa khā na/ sa brko ba'o/ /ngag tu bkod pa'i dper brjod ni/ kū paṃ tsa khā na pūrta kṛt/ khron pa 'dru'o khron pa mkhan gyis so/ ༈phyi ma dbyangs rnams la u pa dhā phyis/ n dang kh dbyangs la 'dren/ tsa kh+na tuḥ/ tsa kh+nuḥ/ tsa kh+ni thaḥtsa khaṃ tha/ tsa kh+na thuḥ/ ༈tsa kh+na/ tsa khā na/ tsa kha na/ tsa kh+ni ba/ tsa kh+ni ma/ ༈ghasli za ba la'o/ zhes pas ghasli li bya ba'i don/ gnyis brjod ghas ghas zhes pa byung*/ s dang po phyis gha dang po dzhar song*/ de dza ru song*/ u pa dhā ring po/ s a la drangs dza ghās/ zos zin no zhes pa'o/ /ngag tu bkod pa'i dper brjod ni ghā sa grā saṃ dzaghā sa go /rtswa mid cing za bar byed do ba lang ngo*/ /zhes so/ ༈a tus sogs la spyi rnams gong dang 'dra ba las 'dir u pa dhā phyis pa'i mtshams su/ kha sa tsa pa rnams las dzha sa rnams so/ /zhes pas gh yig k yig tu bsgyur bar bya'o/

/gha sā deḥṣaḥ/ ghas sogs kyis ṣa'o/ /byings gha s la sogs pa mang po zhig la/ ghas zhes pa'i s yig lta bu byings mtha'i s dbyangs bral ni/ ṣ yig tu bsgyur ba yin la/ sngar gh dbyangs med k dbyangs med du gyur pa de dang*/ mtha' rten s dbyangs med ṣ yig tu gyur ba brtsegs pas k+ṣa ste de dag pha rol rnam dbye dbyangs la 'dren no/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can kṣ 'dus pa k+ṣa ste yi ge gzhan du gyur pa dang*/ dzny 'dus pa dz+ny ste yi ge gzhan du gyur pa yin la/ gzhan yi ge gzhan du ma gyur kyang*/ u pa dhā phyis pa la sogs pas/ dbyangs rkyen la yi ge gnyis 'dren pa 'di rnams gsal byed phyi ma de nyid thog mar dbyangs la drangs pas dbyangs bcas su song*/ de la gsal byed gong ma de 'dren pa yin/ gsal byed dbyangs med du ma cig car 'dren pa ma yin pa'i go ba blo la 'jog dgos/ sa ris 'bri ba rang la grub gzugs ma nor na/ yi ge 'bri ba'i rim pa la mtha' gcig tu nges pa mi snang ngo*/ /dzak+ṣa tuḥ/ dzak+ṣuḥ/ ༈dzak+ṣi tha/ dza gha si tha/ dza gha s+tha/ dzak+ṣa thuḥ/ dza k+ṣa/ ༈dza ghā sa/ dza gha sa/ dza k+ṣi ba/ dza k+ṣi ma rnams so/ ༈ḍudāny sbyin pa la'o/ /zhes pas dā bzhag/ā tau ṇapaḍau/ āt kyi ṇap ḍau'o/ /byings āt te ā ring gi mtha' can la/ rnam dbye ṇap ni ḍau bsgyur/ ḍ bya ba'i don/ au bzhag de ḍi t yin pas ṭi mi snang bar byed do/ /de la byings dang po dā sbyin pa'i don yin/ gnyis pa ni pā btung ba la'o zhes pa dang*/ gsum pa ni ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba 'gog pa la'o/ /bzhi pa ni yā thob par byed pa la'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bzhi po 'di la ṇap ḍau ru bsgyur pa yin/ sngar gzhan rnams la ni ṇap rjes 'brel dbyi ba tsam yin/ de nyid pit yin pas u pa dhā 'phel ba'am rang gnas su byed kyang*/ 'di rnams la ṇap ā de sha byas pas byings kyi mtha'i dbyangs dbyi ba yin no/ ༈dā ṇap bzhagaganyis brjod/

dang po thung ngu rnam dbye ḍau ḍ phyis ṭi ya la drangs da dau/ ༈pā ṇap gnyis brjod thung ngu ḍau ḍ phyis ṭi mi snang drangs papau/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā ṇap ṣs ru bsgyur lugs bsgyur pas lugs can yang 'gyur/ ṭhā yang thā ru song bas s+thā ru bsgyur/ /gnyis brjod gzhan rnams la gnyis brjod dang po yi ge gnyis yod na/ mtha' brten nam brtsegs pa'i 'og ma de ka phyi ma yin pas dbyi ba yin kyang*/ 'dir brtsegs pa'i dang po s dbyi'o/ /thung ngur bsgyur/ tha s+thā zhes pa byung*/ thog ma'i tha ta ru bsgyur/ ḍau ṭi phyis drangs tas+thau/ ༈yā ṇap gnyis brjod dang po thung ngu ḍau ṭi dbyi/ ya yau/ zhes pa rnams grub bo/ /da dau dā naṃ ta dā dā ta/ pa pau be yaṃ mudā pu naḥ/ tas+thau prī tasta dās+thā ne/ dha naṃ hi twa ba naṃ ya yau/ sbyin pa po des sbyin pa ster byed/ /dga' bas slar yang btung ba 'thungs so/ /gnas der mchod pa'i phyir du nges sdod/ /nor rnams spangs nas nags su thob gyur/ zhes pa ste/ tshig rkang gsum po'i 'go na/ da dau pa pau tas+thau dang bzhi pa'i tha mar ya yau rnams yod te/ tshig tu sbyar ba'i dper brjod do/ /de yang da dau la sogs pa 'di rnams bya ba'i tshig yin/ sbyin pa dang btung ba dang gnas dang mchod pa la sogs pa las tshig yin/ sbyin bdag dang dga' bas zhes sogs byed pa po'o/ /nags su zhes pa las yin la/ nor rnams spangs pa zhes pa ni byed pa'i tshig go ༈ā to3n pi/ āt kyi ap med pa la'o/ /byings ā ring mtha' can ap kyi rkyen med pa 'di dag la/ kit dang ngit kyi rkyen dbyangs yin pa rnams pha rol tu byung na/ byings kyi mtha'i ā yig ring po ni dbyi bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang ṇap kyi bya ba gong du bshad zin de ni dang por pit yin pa'i phyir/ kit dang ngit la yang mi the bas logs su bcad la/ phyi ma 'di dag la sngar bshad gzhan rnams la'ang u padhā dbyi ba yod pa'i phyir/

dmigs gsal gyi mdo 'di mi dgos so snyam na/ byings ā ring mtha' can la sngar ma bshad pas/ dmigs gsal mdzad pa yin zhing*/ cho ga tha dad pa'i phyir/ dbyi ba tsam du 'dra yang ṇap dang chabs cig tu ma bstan pa'o/༈/de ltar na da da tuḥ/ da duḥ/ ༈da di tha/ da de tha/ da dā tha/ da da thuḥ/ da da/ ༈da dau/ da di ba/ da di ma rnams so/ ༈pa pa tuḥ/ pa puḥ/ ༈pa pi tha/ pa pe tha/ pa pā tha/ pa pa thuḥ/ pa pa/ ༈pa pau/ pa pi ba/ pa pi ma zhes pa rnams so/ ༈na sha sāt+kha pāḥ/ sha sa las te ma yin kyang kha pa'o/ /gong du bshad pa ltar ṣ+ṭhā dang rnam dbye bkod nas ṣ+ṭhā s+thā ru bsgyur/ gnyis su 'phel/ sngon du sha sa'i yi ge yod la/ phyi mar kha pa yod na/ kha pa'i yi ge de nyid lhag mar gnas kyi/ sha sa'i yi ge ni 'jig par 'gyur zhes pa ste/ 'dir yang sha sa so sor bsdu ba'i s steng ma dang*/ kha pa so sor bsdu ba'i tha de'i 'og na yod pas 'og ma de phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ s 'jig cing thā gnas so/ /gnyis brjod spyi 'gros kyi dang po thung ngur yang bsgyur te/ tha yig kha pa yin pa de rang gi sde pa'i dang po ka pa ta yig tu bsgyur/ tas+thā zhes sgrub pa de mdo tshig 'di'i don yin yang*/ gong du 'brel chags pas bsgrubs so/ /tas+tha tuḥ/ tas+thuḥ/ ༈tas+thi ta/ tas+the tha/ tas+thā tha/ tas+tha thu/ tas+tha/ ༈tas+thau/ tas+thi ba/ tas+thi ma zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ya ya tuḥ/ ya yuḥ/ ༈ya yi tha/ ya ye tha/ ya yā tha/ ya ya yu yuḥ/ ya ya/ ༈ya yau/ ya yi ba/ ya yi ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ṣ+ṇā dag par byed pa la'o/ /zhes bas ṣ+ṇā bzhag/pha rol tu ṇap ṣ+ṇā snā ru bsgyur/ gnyis brjod dang po'i ha sa sogs te gong ma'i na phyis/ thung ngu'o/ /sa snā ṇap ḍau song ḍ yal ṭi phyis drangs/ sa snau/ de bzhin du/ ā dbyi bsas sna tuḥ/ sa snuḥ/ ༈sa sni tha/ sa sne tha/ sa snā tha/ sa sna thuḥ/ sa sna/ ༈sa snau/ sa sni ba/ sa sni ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ṣ+tuny bstod pa dag la'o/ /zhes pas byings ṣ+tuny bzhag/ny rjes 'brel pha rol du yang ṇap bzhag/rkyen dang phrad tsam la ṣ+tu star bsgyur ba stur song gnyis brjod sha sa las te ma yin kha pa'o/

/zhes pas stu gong ma'i s phyis/ ku i la sogs kyi stu 'og ma'i sa ṣa ru log/de'i nus pas ta yang ṭa ru log/mtshams de nas pitra rkyen dang phrad pa'i 'phel ba byung*/ ṣ+tau āp so sor drangs tuṣ+tā ba/ ༈ṇap ma gtogs dbyangs rkyen pha rol na yod pa rnams la/ ṣ+tu'i u la yon tan dang 'phel ba mi byed/ ub ces par bsgyur ba yin/ tuṣ+tu ba tuḥ/ tuṣ+tu buḥ/ ༈tuṣ+tu bi tha/ yon tan byed/ tuṣ+ta ba thuḥ/ tuṣ+tu ba/ tuṣ+tā ba/ tuṣ+tu ba/ tuṣ+tu bi ba/ tuṣ+tu bi ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈yang byings 'di u bha ya pa ti yin par 'dod pa ltar na/ tuṣ+tu be la sogs pa yang sbyor te/ dh+we la tuṣ+tu bidh+we'o/ ༈ /ya dza lha mchod pa dang*/ 'tshog 'du dang byed pa dang sby-in pa rnams la'o/ /zhes pas byings ya dza dza'i a khyad don/ yadz ṇap te a gnyis brjod dang po'i ha sa ya yadz a zhes pa byung*/ ṇa bā dau pūrba s+ya/ ṇap sogs la dang po'i 'o/ /ya dza la sogs pa dang*/ gra ha la sogs pa'i byings rnams pha rol du ṇap la sogs pa liṭ rkyen byung ba'i skabs 'dir byings gnyis brjod kyi thog ma de/ ya ba ra la yin na sam+p+ra sā ra ṇa ste/ slar yang dag par bsgyur ba zhes par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'dir ya yig i yig tu bsgyur ro/ /i yadz zhes pa byung*/ u padhā ring po/ dz rkyen gyi a la drangs/ i yā dza ste grub/ mchod pa byas so/ /sa i yā dza dza nār+d+da naṃ/ de mchod pa byed do 'gro bas mchod pa la'o/ /de zhes pa byed po'i tshig/mchod byed ni bya ba'i tshig/'gro bas mchod pa ni las kyi tshig go /yadzāṃ ya ba ra ṇāṃ y-ibra taḥsam+p+ra sa ra ṇaṃ ki ti/ ya dza rnams kyi ya ba ra rnams la i u ṛt rnams/ slar yang dag par bsgyur te kit la'o/ /de yang yadz bts swab bah be ny byeny hweny bap bd bs/ zhes pa byings 'di rnams ni/ yadz la sogs pa rnams te/ 'di rnams rnam dbye pa ro k+ṣa rnams dang phrad pa'i tshe/

byings gnyis su 'phel ba'i skabs/ ya ba ri yod na snga mar ma zad gnyis kar la/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed do/ /sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa ste slar yang dag par bsgyur ba zhes pa'i don ni/ dang po i y dang*/ u b dang*/ ṛ r dang*/ l̥ l rnams su bsgyur ba las yang phyis slar log ste/ y i dang b u dang r ṛ dang l l̥ rnams su 'gyur bas na slar yang dag par bsgyur ba'o/ /l̥'i rnam 'gyur mkho chung bas 'dir dngos su ma smos/ ya ba ra gsum rim pas i u ṛ gsum du bsgyur te/ pha rol du kit dang dit kyi rnam dbye yod na'o/ /de yang ki ngit rgya yan la go bar mi bya ste/ ṇap sogs kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /kit ngit zhes nges bzung byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ pit la skabs 'dir gnyis brjod kyi dang po kho na la/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed kyi gnyis ka la ma yin zhing*/ kit rnams la gnyis ka byed pas so/ /slar yang dag par bsgyur ba 'di la dngos su ya ir bsgyur zer ba sogs las med kyang*/ ya sogs dbyangs dang bcas pa i sogs su bsgyur ba yin/ de yang yā sogs ring po ī sogs ring po dang*/ ya sogs thung ngu.i sogs thung ngur bsgyur/ ༈des na thap kyi phyogs gcig dang ṇap gnyis pa ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams la 'dra ste/ ya dz'i pha rol du a tus sogs rnam dbye bzhag/yadz yadz dz gong ma dbyi/ ya gnyis ka i ru bsgyur/ i gnyis 'dra ba ring por mtshams sbyar/ īdz zhes 'byung ba grub par byas nas so sor bsgrub ste/ ī dza tuḥ/ ī dzuḥ/ ༈ī dzi tha/ pit it yod pa'i phyogs la/ i ya dzi tha/ iṭ med pa la byings kyi dz ṣ ru song*/ rkyen gyi tha ṭha ru song*/ i yaṣ+ṭha/ ī dza thuḥ/ī dza/ ༈i yā dza/ yang na i ya dza/ ī dzi ba/ ī dzi ma/ pa rasmai rnams so/ ༈ī dze/ ī dzā te ī dzi re/ ༈ī dzi ṣe/ ī dzā the/ ī dzi dh+we/ ༈ī dzi ba he/ ī dzi ma he/ zhes pa āt+ma ne rnams so/

༈bts yongs su brjod pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings ba ts pha rol du ṇap a gnyis brjod ts snga ma yal ba dang po saṃ p ra sa ṇa ste ur song*/ u pa dhā ring po ts drangs u bā tsa/ ༈bts a tus gnyis brjod ts gong yal ba gnyis u/ 'dra ba ring ū ts drangs pas ū tsa tuḥ/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ ṇap mi the ba'i dbyangs dang ba ma thap kyi phyogs gcig rnams la ū tsuḥ/ ū tsi tha/ ༈ūtsa thuḥ/ ༈ū tsa/ ༈ū tsi ba/ ༈ū tsi ma/ ༈thap kyi sgrub tshul gzhan la u ba tsi tha zhes pa'am/ tsa yi ku'o zhes pas tsa ka ru bsgyur ba tha la drangs u bak+tha/ ༈ṇap phyi ma la u bā tsa'am/ u ba tsa'o/ ༈brūny gsal bar brjod pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings brūny bzhag/brū nyo ba tsi/ brū nya'i ba tsa'o/ /byings brūny la rkyen lkog gyur gyi rnam dbye byin na/ brūny ba tsr bsgyur dgos te/ ap byin pa'i shul ma yin pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ ༈brū ṇap bzhag/ba tsr bsgyur/ gnyis brjod/ tsa dang po phyis/ ba dang po u/ u pa dhā drangs u pā tsa/ ༈gzhan de dang 'dra ba las ba gnyis ka u ru bsgyur/ 'dra ring ū tsa tuḥ/ ū tsuḥ/ ༈ū tsa bi tha/ u bak+tha/ ū tsa thuḥ/ ū tsa/ ༈u bā tsa/ ū ba tsa/ ū tsi ba/ ū tsi ma/ ༈ū tse/ ū tsā te/ ū tsi re/ ༈ū tsi ṣe ū tsā the/ ū tsi dh+we/ ༈ ū tse/ ū tsi ba he/ ū tsi ma he/ zhes pa rnams so/ / 'di dang gong ma gnyis byings mi gcig kyang*/ phyi ma ba tsr bsgyur bas/ dang po dgu la gzugs 'dra'o/ ༈nyiṣ+wap nyal ba la'o zhes pas byings nyiṣ+wap bzhag / nyi rjes 'brel/ ṣ+wa p ṇap bzhag/ṣ+wa swa ru bsgyur/ gnyis brjod/ swap swap/ p gong ma phyis/ swa gong ma'i ba yig u ru bsgyur bas su zhes pa byung*/ su i la'i mtha' yin pas/ ku i la swa zhes pa de ṣ+wa ru slar loga.u pa dhā ring po'o/ /drangs su ṣ+wā pa/ ༈lhag ma rnams la'ang gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ swa swa zhes pa'i ba zur gnyis kar u ru bsgyur/

su su de rjes su ṣu zhes pa 'byung*/ u pa dhā ring pa mi byed pa khyad par ro/ /su ṣu pa tuḥ/ su ṣu puḥ/ ༈su ṣu pi tha/ su ṣ+wa pi tha/ su ṣ+wa p+tha/ su ṣu pa thuḥ/ su ṣu ba/ ༈su ṣ+wā pa/ su ṣ+wa pa/ su ṣu pi ba/ su ṣu pi ma/ su ṣ+wā pa/ su khaṃ sa khā/ nyol zhig bde bar grogs po'o/ /zhes so/ /nyol zhig ni bya ba/ bde bar ni las yin zer yang byed pa yin/ grogs po ni byed pa po'o/ ༈nu ga shāṃ/ nuk a sha rnams la'o/ /a sha zhes pa ni/ byings a shud ste/ de la sogs pa byings mang po zhig la ṇap sogs pha rol du byung ba na/ byings gnyis su brjod pa'i dang po'i mthar nuk ā ga ma ster ro/ /k dgos don/ u brjod don/ rkyen n nyid do/ /a shūd khyab par byed pa la'o/ /d ni āt+ma ne pa ti'i khyad don no/ /'di la ṇap sogs kyi at+ma ne'i rkyen kho na 'jug ste/ pha rol du e sogs dgu po dag las gcig bzhag/bhu a dag gi ṇap sogs la ā'o/ /zhes gnyis brjod kyi dang po ring por bsgyur ba dang*/ sngon du nyer bsgyur bi? dang āng gnyis 'jog pa khyad par te/ de yang a sh e zhes pa bzhag/byings gnyis brjod/ dang po'i ha sa sogs thog ma'i sh phyis/ bhū a sogs a dang po thung ngu de ā ring por song*/ bar der nuk ā ga ma byin/ thog mar bi dang āng bzhag/ng song ā gnyis 'dra ba mtshams sbyar bi zhes pa'i i ni y ru song*/ by dbyangs med ā la drangs/ n dbyangs med 'og gi a thung la drangs/ sh dbyangs med e la drangs/ byā na she/ zhes pa grub bo/ /dper brjod ngag tu bkod pa ni/ byā na she bi shwaṃ bha ga wān/ sna tshogs rnams la khyab byed bcom ldan no/ ༈de bzhin du phyi ma rnams la byā na shā te/ byā na shi re/ ༈byā na shi ṣe/ ba byā na shā the/ byā na shi dh+we/ ༈byā na she/ byā na shi ba he/ byā na shi ma he zhes pa rnams so/ ༈añdzu gsal ba dang*/ mi sman dang*/

mdzes pa dang 'gro ba rnams la'o/ /zhes pas byings añdzu bzhag /ū bya don re zhig ny dz dang phral bas n ru song n klad skor du bsgyur na'ang chog byed bla (sla )bas legs/ pha rol tu ṇap ste a bzhag /gnyis brjod/ dang po'i ha sa dbyi ba la dz snga ma dang*/ a'i mtha' brten du n ny nga ro gang yod kyang phyis/ a gong ma ring po/ a gnyis kyi bar du nuk ā n aṃ dz a zhes pa rnams byung*/ n dang dz so sor a la drangs pas/ ā naṃ dza zhes pa grub/ de'i don ni gsal bar byas so/ /mig sman byugs so/ /mdzes par grags so/ /phyin no/ /zhes pa rnams la 'jug /ā naṃ dzā k+ṣi ṇī kadz+dza le na kā tsi t/ mig sman gyis mig la byugs so kha cig go /zhes pa ngag tu sbyar ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du ā naṃ dza tuḥ/ ā naṃ dzuḥ/ ༈ā naṃ dzi tha/ ā naṃ dza thuḥ/ ā naṃ dza/ ༈ā naṃ dza/ ā naṃ dzi ba/ ā naṃ dzi ma/ pa ra smai rnams so/ ā naṃ dze/ ā naṃ dzā te/ ā naṃ dzi te/ ༈ā naṃ dzi ṣe/ ā naṃ dzā the/ ā naṃ dzi dh+we/ ༈ā naṃ dze/ ā naṃ dzi ba he/ ā naṃ dzi ma he/ āt+ma ne rnams so/ /a rtsa mchod pa byed pa la'o/ /tsa'i dbyangs a ni gnyis don no/ /arts ṇap gnyis brjod/ dang po'i ha sa r dang ts gnyis kar dbyi nus thog ma ring ān arts a zhes pa byung*/ drangs ā na rtsa/ mchod pa byas so/ /de bzhin du/ ā na rtsa tuḥ/ ā na rtsuḥ/ ༈ā na rtsi tha/ ā na rtsa thuḥ/ ༈ā na rtsa/ ༈ā na rtsa/ ā na rtsi ba/ ā na rtsi ma rnams so/ ༈yang ā na rtse/ ā nā rtsā re/ ā na rtsī te/ zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyang go sla'o/ ༈tsiny gsog pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings tsi ny ny rjes 'brel bā rti ka las tsiny yi sa dang ṇa sogs dag gi ki nyid yang na'o/ /zhes 'grel par lung drangs te/ tsi ni ki ru bsgyur ba yin no/ 'di la nyer bsgyur ni r sngon du 'jog pa yang khyad par ro/ /tsi ṇap bzhagatsi ki ru bsgyur/ gnyis brjod ki dang po slar yang tsi ru logasngon du nir bzhag/r rnams bcad

de s de yang shr gyur pa tsa la drangs/ ki phyi ma la 'phel ba byung āy drangs/ ni sh+tsi kā ya/ ngag tu bkod pa'i dper brjod ni/ ni sh+tsi kā ya tsi raṃ rā dzā/ ring du gnas par gyur zhig rgyal po'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ a tus sogs dang*/ dbyangs dang po can dang*/ iṭ yod pa rnams la byings mtha' ki yi e de yar bsgyur zhing mtshams sbyar bas/ kya yig tu 'gro ba yin/ de la srog tu gang bcug pa'i rnam 'gyur 'byung ba shes dgos/ thap la iṭ med na yon tan tsam dang*/ yod pa'i lugs rnam grangs cig la yon tan a yr bsgyur ba dang*/ ṇap phyi ma la yon tan dang 'phel ba gdam kha'o/ /ni sh+tsi kya tuḥ/ ni sh+tsi kyuḥ/ ༈ni sh+tsi kyi tha/ ni sh+tsi ka yi tha/ ni sh+tsi ke tha/ ni sh+tsi kya thuḥ/ ni sh+tsi kya/ ༈ni sh+tsi kā ya/ ni sh+tsi ka ya/ ni sh+tsi kyi ba/ ni sh+tsi kyi ma zhes pa rnams te kha cig 'di yang gnyis don gyi tshig can du 'dod pas/ ni sh+tsi kye la sogs pa yang sbyor te/ de'i tshe dha yang ḍha'o gzhung las ni pa ra smai'i rkyen kho na bshad do/ ༈ /byings 'di la tsi zhes pa ki ru ma bsgyur na/ nir yang mi byed/ te tsi tse ces pa dang*/ tsi phyi ma la i yon tan dang 'phel ba dang*/ yr bsgyur pa'i khyad par spyi dang 'dra ba nyid de/ tsi tsā yatsi ts+ya tuḥ/ tsi ts+yuḥ/ ༈tsi ts+yi*/ tsi tse*/ tsi ts+ya thuḥ/ tsi ts+ya/ ༈tsi tsā ya tsi tsa ya tsi tsi ba tsi tsi ma zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈gra h nye bar 'dzin pa la'o/ /zhes pas gra hā/ ṇap zhes pa bzhag/gnyis brjod h snga ma phyis gra gong ma'i ga yig dza yig tu bsgyur/ dz g h dza yi ra btags ṛ ru log ste/ saspra sa ra ṇa yin pas dbyangs a dang bcas pa bsgyur ba'o/ /slar yang ṛ a/ u pa dhā ring drangs dza

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo 'grel mchog tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 296 -- PAGE 295 - mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 1 -
